articleTitle: Kramers-Kronig imaging of diffuse media and embedded objects
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Kramers-Kronig technique is used to reconstruct the impulse-response of a diffusive media with picosecond resolution. We demonstrate the ability to image an object within clothing at a distance of 3 m from the detection system.

articleTitle: Measurement of pressure dependent nonlinear refractive index of inert gases
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear refractive index of Ar, Kr, N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> Ne, Xe, and air has been determined from the spatially dependent nonlinear spectral phase of weak femtosecond pulses propagating in sample gases under pressure between 0.05 mbar and 1 bar.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive three-wave mixing for imaging resolution improvement
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Phase-sensitive three-wave mixing operated in the deamplification mode can produce angular phase amplification for multimode beams. A detailed analysis of this scheme indicates that super-Rayleigh imaging resolution is expected.

articleTitle: EUV detection of high-frequency surface acoustic waves
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use coherent extreme ultraviolet radiation to probe surface acoustic wave propagation in nickel-on-sapphire nanostructures. We observe no acoustic dispersion over SAW wavelengths down to 200nm, meaning the SAW propagation is unaffected by the nanostructure.

articleTitle: The sign of refractive index of surface plasmons in metal-dielectric-metal structures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have carefully examined the surface plasmon modes in the metal-dielectric-metal structures. By using the direction of energy decay to identify the sign of effective refractive index, we have obtained different results from previous reports.

articleTitle: Frequency measurement of a Sr optical lattice clock using a coherent optical link over a 120-km fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a precision frequency measurement using a phase-stabilized 120-km optical fiber link over a physical distance of 50 km. The absolute frequency of the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Sr optical lattice clock is measured to be 429228004229874.1(2.4) Hz.

articleTitle: Erasing frequency distinguishability using single-photon up-conversion
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The frequencies of two frequency non-degenerate single photons were converted to the same frequency by using the sum frequency generation process in periodically poled lithium niobate waveguides, while maintaining their temporal indistinguishability. As a result, the two converted photons exhibited a non-classical dip in a Hong-Ou-Mandel quantum interference experiment.

articleTitle: Efficient fiber-laser-pumped Ho:YLF oscillator and amplifier utilizing the transmitted pump power of the oscillator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel scheme for a compact and robust pulsed fiber-laser-pumped Ho:YLF oscillator and amplifier system, where the pump power transmitted by the oscillator is utilized to pump the amplifier.

articleTitle: Wavelength modulation in tunable diode laser photoacoustic spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Wavelength modulation waveforms were studied in tunable diode laser photoacoustic spectroscopy by way of simulations and experiments. The modulation waveforms were sinusoidal, triangular, shaped, and quasi-square waves. The quasi-square waveform gave the largest signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Effect of surface modes on photon propagation through dielectric bandgaps
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate Hartman saturation effect in multilayer dielectric stacks. We show that the experimentally observed jumps of photon transversal times due to adding single quarter-wave layers to structures is caused by appearance of surface modes.

articleTitle: Detection speeds for single-photon detectors based on photoconductive gain
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the limits on detection speed for single-photon detectors based on photoconductive gain. We outline how to apply this approach to a quantum dot, optically gated, field-effect transistor photodetector.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic energy up-conversion using ZnO nanorod double-quantum-well structures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report nanophotonic energy up-conversion operation in ZnO nanorod double-quantum-well structures assisted by the optical absorption of phonons via an optical near-field.

articleTitle: High-index-contrast buried-waveguide for intersubband ultrafast all-optical switches fabricated by wafer bonding technology
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricated high-index-contrast II-VI-based multiple-quantum-well channel-waveguides buried in a SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> cladding-layer, for the application to intersubband transition all-optical-switches at communication wavelengths. We demonstrated the sub-picosecond switching of the waveguides using intersubband absorption saturation recovery.

articleTitle: Optofluidic circular grating distributed feedback dye laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a surface emitting optofluidic dye laser using a second order circular grating distributed feedback resonator. The optofluidic dye laser offers a low-cost and integrated coherent light source for lab-on-a-chip spectroscopy systems.

articleTitle: Filamentation of femtosecond self-bending Airy beams
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report experimental observation of laser filaments generated by intense, femtosecond, self-bending Airy beams in air and water. The generated curved filaments act as streak cameras for the forward-emitted broadband conical radiation.

articleTitle: Efficient second harmonic blue generation from self-doubling of quasi-phase-matched PPLT parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High slope-efficiency ~25% for green-to-blue wavelength conversion, rendering 60 mW / 440 nm blue laser by 400 mW / 532 nm pump of 20 ns / 4 KHz, was demonstrated on 7.9 mum-period PPLT due to simultaneous phase matching of the 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup>-order QPM-OPO with the 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order QPM-SHG process.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser direct writing of waveguide lattices
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We review the basic principles of the femtosecond laser direct writing approach. This technology opens the possibility to specifically tune the light evolution in the linear as well as in the nonlinear regime.

articleTitle: Tip assisted laser induced surface nanolithograpjhy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel mode of AFM operation is demonstrated to be efficient for non-contact laser induced nano-lithography on the surface of polymers and of metals by means of two different mechanisms: localized heat transfer and electro-magnetic field enhancement.

articleTitle: Four-wave mixing and many-particle effects in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Four-wave mixing in semiconductor quantum wells has long been used to investigate many-particle effects. We introduce the theoretical concepts and illustrate some developments of the field, which D.S. Chemla helped to shape.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: High power, multi-segmented Nd:YAG laser, longitudinally pumped at 885 nm
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Power scaling by combining 885 nm upper laser level Nd:YAG pumping and multi-segmented laser rods is presented. An output power of 750 W (optical-to-optical efficiency of 58%) was demonstrated using polarization coupled diode stack pumping.

articleTitle: Bend-induced changes in group delay and comparison with S2 mode-content measurements
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Calculations show qualitative changes in relative index and group delay induced by typical coiling of fiber. Comparison with S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> measurement shows excellent agreement in relative group delay.

articleTitle: 1 µJ from a high repetition rate femtosecond optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier in the mid-infrared
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a mid-infrared optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier with a pulse energy of 1 muJ at 100 kHz repetition rate. Its output is compressed to 92 fs by a prism compressor and characterized by SHG-FROG.

articleTitle: Applications of external cavity quantum cascade lasers: Broadband mid-IR laser heterodyne radiometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Broadband thermal infrared heterodyne spectro-radiometry performed over a frequency range of more than 100 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> at lambda=8.4 mum using an external cavity quantum cascade laser as a tunable local oscillator will be reported.

articleTitle: Optical processing to enhance UWB transmission and reception
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The range and/or bit rates of impulse radio UWB systems can be improved by employing the optical processing. We consider optical pulse shaping at the transmitter and precise receiver synchronization and windowing using optical techniques.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon enhanced optical force on gold nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the pushing of gold nanoparticles by surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs). 2D FDTD simulations indicate considerably enhanced optical forces due to SPPs and gold particle-film interaction, in comparison to total internal reflection illumination.

articleTitle: Controlling energy and charge environment of single excitons in a photonic-crystal diode
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Single quantum dots embedded inside a photonic crystal diode are studied as a function of the reverse bias. The applied electric field strongly enhances the emission from excitonic lines as compared to the background emission.

articleTitle: High-order optical nonlinearities from collinear time-resolved two-dimensional spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The combination of collinear time-resolved two-dimensional spectroscopy and field-resolved detection allows for the measurement of optical nonlinearities of arbitrary order. Results are presented for intersubband transitions in a multiple quantum well sample.

articleTitle: Optofluidic method for revolving a trapped spherical particle
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a method for revolving a spherical particle on a 100 nm orbit using the interplay between an applied fluid force and an anisotropic optical trapping potential.

articleTitle: Plasmonic coupling of Ag nanoparticle arrays with sub-10 nm Gaps: Near-field origins
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Investigating with pseudo-spectral time-domain method, we show that resonant scattering characteristics of Ag nanoparticle arrays are attributed to near-field surface magnetic field, instead of enhanced electric field induced by plasmonic coupling.

articleTitle: Direct phonon excitation in semiconductors by ultrashort intense THz radiation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrashort intense THz radiation generated through laser filamentation in air is employed to directly excite the lattice of AlGaAs semi-insulating crystals. Incoherent as well as coherent phonons are shown to be excited in this way.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Polarized light-emitting diode with its InGaN/GaN quantum well coupled with surface plasmons on a metal grating
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The enhanced and partially polarized output of a green light-emitting diode, in which its InGaN/GaN quantum well couples with surface plasmons on an Ag grating structure, is demonstrated by comparing with the conventionally fabricated devices.

articleTitle: Demonstration of two-qubit quantum algorithms with a solid-state electronic processor
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the experimental implementation of two-qubit quantum algorithms in a superconducting circuit. Our processor incorporates local and fast flux biasing of two transmon qubits within a circuit QED architecture. An off-resonant cavity bus shields the qubits from the external environment and couples them to each other via virtual photon exchange. Meanwhile, integrated short-circuited coplanar waveguides proximal to each qubit allow nanosecond control of their frequencies. We demonstrate flux-controlled single-qubit z rotations and a qubit-qubit conditional phase (c-phase) interaction with a coupling strength tunable by two orders of magnitude. These operations are combined with frequency-multiplexed x and y rotations to form a set of gates universal for quantum computation. Dispersive frequency shifts of the cavity bus allow tomography of the two-qubit state, and accurate determination of state purity, fidelity and entanglement. The processor is first programmed to generate and detect entanglement on demand using sequences of five single-qubit operations and one c-phase. The four Bell states are generated with fidelities better than 90%, corresponding to a concurrence of 0.85 or an entanglement of formation of 0.8. Next, the Grover search algorithm is implemented by concatenating eight single-qubit and two c-phases operations. The fidelity of the algorithm output states to the theoretical ideal is ~ 80%, consistent with the observed T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> times ~ 1 us and the total duration ~ 130 ns of the algorithm sequence. We also program and execute the Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm, finding similar performance. Prospects for scaling the processor beyond two qubits will be discussed. Research supported by NSF, NSA and ARO.

articleTitle: Surface and bulk contributions to the second-order nonlinearity of gold
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use two-beam second-harmonic generation to separate the surface and bulk contributions to the second-order nonlinearity of gold. The results provide direct evidence of bulk contributions, nevertheless, surface-like contributions dominate the measured signals.

articleTitle: Perfect reflection of light by a dipolar emitter
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the coupling of tightly focused light to single molecules and metal nanoparticles. We find that a single emitter strongly attenuates such a light field and can even perfectly reflect a directional dipole wave.

articleTitle: Shortest pulse duration of mode-locked thin disk lasers: Ultrafast Yb:LuScO3 laser generates 227-fs pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The first mode-locked Yb:LuScO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> thin disk laser generates 7.2 W average power in 227-fs pulses, which are the shortest pulses obtained from any ultrafast thin disk laser. 10.1 W average power were achieved at longer pulse durations.

articleTitle: Critical coupling to surface phonon-polaritons in SiC
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe critically coupled surface phonon-polariton excitation in SiC, leading to maximum electric field enhancement. A double-scan of wavelength and incidence angle in the ATR configuration demonstrates critical coupling for two air gaps.

articleTitle: Silk fibroin biosensor based on imprinted periodic nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper presents a label free colorometric sensor fabricated by rapidly imprinting silk fibroin thin films with periodic nanoholes. The fabricated sensor is sensitive to index variations of Δn = 0.007.

articleTitle: Direct production of three entangled fields at different wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An Optical Parametric Oscillator entangles three modes of the field - pump, signal and idler - when operating above threshold. Complete measurement of the covariance matrix enables the test of several inseparability criteria.

articleTitle: Digital reconstruction of axially thick potentials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The holographic reconstruction of objects typically assumes that the object is axially thin. Here, we demonstrate a simple approach that works for axially-thick potentials which evolve dynamically. Results are verified by reconstructing linear scattering experiments.

articleTitle: Active fiber hydrogen sensors for low-temperature operation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a fiber hydrogen sensor for low-temperature operation. The low-temperature response time of palladium-coated fiber Bragg grating in high attenuation fiber is enhanced by 40 times with in-fiber laser heating.

articleTitle: Yb-doped rod-type photonic crystal fibers for single-mode amplification
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The competition among the guided modes in rod-type photonic crystal fibers with a low refractive index ring in the Yb-doped core is investigated with an amplifier model to demonstrate the effective higher-order mode suppression.

articleTitle: Planar lenses based on nanoscale slit arrays in a metallic film
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated planar lenses based on nanoscale slit arrays in a metallic film. Electromagnetic simulations of lens designs and confocal measurements on manufactured structures show excellent agreement, but deviate from simple theory.

articleTitle: A multi-functional fiber laser lidar for Earth Science & Exploration
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A multi-pixel laser altimeter using pseudo-random-noise-modulated fiber lasers has been developed under a NASA Instrument Incubator Program. We will present the instrument design, field campaign results and implementations for Earth Science Decadal Missions and Exploration.

articleTitle: High time for fibers - towards kW class laser systems with GW peak power
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We review the recent results for high peak power and high average power fiber based chirped-pulse amplification systems. Both current challenges and possible approaches for further power scaling are discussed.

articleTitle: Complimentary ultrashort laser pulse characterization using SHG FROG and MOSAIC
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A method for generating the MOSAIC trace from the SHG FROG dataset is shown. Examples will be presented illustrating enhanced visual sensitivity, applicability and complimentary qualitative pulse characterization using SHG FROG.

articleTitle: Widely voltage tunable quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new Quantum Cascade laser design with a “two-step” coupling between the injector and the active region provides a voltage tuning range of 200cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> for electroluminescence and 80cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> for laser spectra at room temperature.

articleTitle: Tomographic imaging in practical combustion devices based on hyperspectral absorption spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A hyperspectral tomography sensor has been developed to measure the distribution of temperature and chemical species. The spatial and temporal resolution enabled by this sensor is expected to resolve key issues in practical combustion devices.

articleTitle: Second-order optical nonlinearity in thermally poled silica waveguides written by femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Thermal poling was utilized to induce second-order nonlinearity in silica waveguides written by femtosecond laser pulses. Nonlinearity in the waveguides was found to be lower than non-modified regions.

Author Keywords: (350.3390) Other areas of optics: Laser materials processing

articleTitle: Fabrication of GaSb-based DFB lasers for gas sensing
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Regrowth-free gain-coupled GaSb-based DFB lasers suitable for gas sensing were fabricated. Threshold currents for 2.4 mum emission of 400 mum-long DFB devices were 45 mA with a total output power of nearly 11 mW in CW operation at 20degC.

articleTitle: 1D photonic crystal sensor integrated in a microfluidic system
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A refractive index sensor was designed as a 1D resonator incorporated in a microfluidic channel, where aqueous solutions were injected. A sensitivity of 480 nm/RIU and a minimum difference of Deltan = 0.002 were determined.

articleTitle: Generation of vectorial light beams using space-variant subwavelength gratings at 1064 nm
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The generation of vectorial beams at 1064 nm by the use of polarization transformer devices consisting of space-variant subwavelength gratings (SGs) is demonstrated experimentally. We discuss using such beams for plasmonic nanofocusing applications.

articleTitle: Optical injection-induced timing jitter reduction in gain-switched single-mode 1550 nm-VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate how optical injection changes timing jitter and pulse width in gain-switched single mode VCSELs at several repetition rates. Jitter reductions larger than 70% over a 0.4 nm detuning range are obtained.

articleTitle: CTF3 photo-injector laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nd:YLF laser system has been developed to drive an electron photo-injector. A chain of mode-locked 1.5 GHz oscillator, preamplifier, and two powerful diode-pumped amplifiers deliver 6.4 kW long IR bunches which are converted to 262 nm.

articleTitle: Compression of high energy ultrashort laser pulses in hollow planar waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that high energy ultrashort pulses can be compressed through self-phase-modulation in hollow planar waveguides. The beam is guided in one transverse dimension and propagates free in other, allowing scalability to higher energies.

articleTitle: Solitons in semiconductor microcavities operating in the strong coupling regime
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate theoretically the existence of polariton-solitons in semiconductor microcavity in the strong-coupling regime. Their relaxation time and required pump powers are at list one order less than those of their weakly coupled light-only counterparts.

articleTitle: Optical hyperspace for plasmons: Dyakonov states in metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that the subwavelength imaging behaviour observed in the magnifying superlens experiment [Smolyaninov et.al., Science, 2006] is due to Dyakonov plasmons. This previously unobserved state gives rise to subdiffraction plasmon beams on resonance.

articleTitle: Upconversion assisted auto-oscillations in erbium doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new model of auto-oscillations in high concentration erbium doped fiber laser has been developed with accounting for statistical nature of the excitation migration and upconversion, as well as resonance-like pump-to-signal intensity noise transfer.

articleTitle: All-optical gain-clamping dispersion-compensated Raman/EDFAs for WDM systems
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We design dispersion-compensated Raman/EDFA hybrid amplifiers recycling residual Raman pump for WDM systems. The first experimentally demonstration of broad band gain-clamped and gain flattened dispersion-compensated Raman/EDFA hybrid amplifiers by recycling residual Raman pump with a single FBG for WDM systems.

articleTitle: Spatial hole burning in actively mode-locked quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A theoretical study of active mode-locking in quantum cascade lasers including spatial hole-burning is presented. It is found that spatial hole-burning reduces the pulse duration at the expense of slight pulse instability and strongly structured pulse shapes.

articleTitle: PCF photon pair source bridging the visible and NIR
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a PCF photon pair source with signal and idler emission in the visible and near-infrared wavelength regions. Our joint spectral coincidence measurements indicate that the generation of spectrally decorrelated photon pairs is possible.

articleTitle: Sequential in vivo molecular imaging with a dual-axes confocal microscope
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate sequential three-dimensional in vivo imaging in one mouse, monitoring siRNA silencing with a dual-axes confocal microscope. This opens up new possibilities in developing therapeutics for genetic disorders through better assessment of treatment efficiency.

articleTitle: Pulse compression and slow-light enhanced three-photon absorption in GaInP photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate first observations of slow-light enhanced three-photon absorption(ThPA) in photonic crystal waveguides.The injected pulses demonstrate self-phase modulation(SPM) with scalings deviating from n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>(SPM) and n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>(ThPA).A thorough analysis suggests pulse compression leading to increased peak powers.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic endomicroscopy for intrinsic two-photon fluorescence imaging of epithelial cells and tissues
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An endomicroscope with enhanced signal collection efficiency was developed using customized double-clad fiber and aspherical compound-lens. Ex vivo two-photon fluorescence imaging of epithelial tissues was demonstrated for the first time with an all-fiber-optic scanning endomicroscope.

articleTitle: Interferometry with a photon-number resolving detector
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: With photon-number resolving detectors, we show compression of interference fringes with increasing photon numbers for both Michelson and Fabry-Pérot interferometers. We also theoretically show supersensitivity for nonclassical light.

articleTitle: Ultrafast terahertz probe of spin-density wave dynamics in organic conductor (TMTSF)2PF6
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photo-induced terahertz reflectivity change of the spin-density wave (SDW) gap in (TMTSF)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>PF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> is observed. We find an ultrafast (~ps) increase of terahertz conductivity indicating a destabilization of the SDW states by a weak photo-excitation.

articleTitle: Amplified-spontaneous-emission pumped raman fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a low-threshold Raman fiber laser at 1670 nm, pumped for the first time by the ASE of an EDFA. The output was 340 mW, 34% of the pump power, and the threshold (with another laser) 160 mW.

articleTitle: Efficient frequency doubling of a femtosecond Er-fiber laser using BiB3O6
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: BiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> has been used for second-harmonic generation of a femtosecond Er-fiber laser-amplifier at 56 MHz. An internal conversion efficiency of 23% was obtained for second-harmonic pulses with a duration of 64 fs at 782 nm.

articleTitle: High optical feedback-tolerance of distributed reflector lasers with wire-like active regions for high speed isolator-free operation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical feedback-tolerance of distributed-reflector (DR) laser with a wirelike distributed-feedback section and distributed-Bragg-reflector (DBR) section was investigated. Isolator-free 2.5-Gb/s-10-km transmissions and low RIN were demonstrated under -13.5-dB optical back-reflection with a power penalty of 2-dB.

articleTitle: Adiabatic sum-frequency conversion
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel technique to achieve both high efficiency and broad bandwidth in SFG process using adiabatic conversion scheme, adapted from NMR and light-matter interaction. The robustness and tunability of the scheme are discussed.

articleTitle: Fabrication of highly stacked quantum dot laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricated broad-area laser diodes containing highly stacked InAs quantum dots (QDs) using the strain-compensation technique; these diodes showed laser emission at 1529 nm in pulsed mode with a threshold current of 517.5 mA.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave and mode-locked laser operations based on Yb3+:(YGd2)Sc2(GaAl2)O12 disordered ceramic
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:(YGd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>)Sc<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>(GaAl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>)O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub> disordered ceramic has been fabricated. 2.9-W average power with an optical-to-optical efficiency of 44% was achieved in a continuous-wave operation. 112-fs pulse duration with 860-mW average power was also achieved in a mode-locked operation.

articleTitle: Accounting for system affects in depolarization lidar
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: When using lidar to measure small depolarization values, coupling of polarization planes in the system is of significant concern.We employ hardware polarization compensation to reduce system polarization cross-talk, improving depolarization estimates.

articleTitle: Phase-conjugate optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a new type of optical coherence tomography using only classical resources to achieve results that are typically associated with quantum-enhanced metrology: factor-of-two axial resolution enhancement and even-order dispersion cancellation.

articleTitle: Entanglement-based free space quantum cryptography in full daylight
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Many free space quantum key distribution systems are restricted to operation at night. Implementing spectral, spatial and temporal filtering techniques, we were able to establish a secure key transmission over several days using entangled photons.

articleTitle: Optofluidic assembly of red/blue/green semiconductor nanowires
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A full-color pixel consisting of CdSe, ZnO, and CdS nanowires has been heterogeneously integrated on a substrate with lithographic accuracy using lateral optoelectronic tweezers (LOET). Red (CdSe, 685 nm), blue (CdS, 496 nm), and green (ZnO, 518 nm) light emissions are obtained by selectively pumping the corresponding nanowires. Potentially the nanowires can be directly assembled on CMOS driver circuit for a low-power display.

articleTitle: Recent progresses of AlGaN and InAlGaN-based deep-UV LEDs
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated 222-282 nm AlGaN and InAlGaN-based efficient deep-ultraviolet (DUV) light-emitting diodes (LEDs) fabricated on low threading dislocation density (TDD) AlN. We achieved over 10 mW CW UV output power for 264-282 nm LEDs.

articleTitle: Controlled dispersion in photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe the basic features and state-of-the-art in controlling dispersion using hollow-core photonic bandgap fibers, with application in pulse compression and delivery. We present spectral measurements of group velocity dispersion in several different fiber designs.

articleTitle: Multifocal, multi-modal, photon counting, multiphoton microscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-speed nonlinear imaging systems capable of dynamically imaging multiple focal planes simultaneously, in multiple modalities (two photon excitation fluorescence, second harmonic generation, and third harmonic generation), are demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Mode imaging and dispersion analysis in Terahertz waveguides using Terahertz near-field microscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Mode structure, transmission loss and dispersion are characterized in low-loss (~1 dB/m) terahertz (THz) dielectric-lined hollow metallic waveguides. THz near-field probe imaging and spectroscopy is applied for precise mode imaging and selective mode probing.

articleTitle: Teleportation of quantum information between distant atomic qubits
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We teleport quantum information between two distant ytterbium ions trapped in different vacuum chambers separated by one meter. Full state tomography shows that the heralded probabilistic process employed has a fidelity of 90%.

articleTitle: Femtosecond surface plasmon interferometry with gold nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measure the ultrafast electron dynamics in gold via ultrafast surface plasmon interferometry. A new plasmonic microinterferometer with tilted slit-groove pair is used to unambiguously determine changes of real and imaginary parts of the dielectric function.

articleTitle: Simple analytical expression for the dispersion of plasmonic structures with coaxial geometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We derived a simple analytical expression for the modal dispersion of deep-subwavelength coaxial plasmonic structures. Our approach provides an intuitive picture that allows a qualitative understanding and a quantitative prediction of the complete dispersion behavior.

articleTitle: C2H2 absolutely optical frequency-stabilized and 40 GHz repetition-rate-stabilized, regeneratively mode-locked picosecond erbium fiber laser at 1.53 µm
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The optical frequency and repetition-rate of a regeneratively mode-locked picosecond fiber laser was simultaneously stabilized to a 1.5-mum C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> absorption line and a 40-GHz synthesizer, respectively. The optical frequency stability reached 2times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> for tau=10~100 s.

articleTitle: Absolute probes of surface chirality based on secondharmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose new second-harmonic-generation probes of surface chirality, based on circular polarizations or handed superpositions of radial and azimuthal polarizations. Because of normal incidence focusing, the techniques are not sensitive to anisotropy.

articleTitle: 101-element cascaded-microdisk resonators on a silicon chip
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose many-element cascaded-resonator devices with gapless inter-cavity coupling using spiral and double-notch microdisk resonators. We demonstrate such devices with up to 101 elements in a silicon nitride-on-silica substrate.

articleTitle: Strong photoluminescence from InGaN/GaN nanorods arrays studies by time-resolved photoluminescence
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report more than one order of magnitude stronger green photoluminescence from InGaN/GaN nanorods arrays compare to that from InGaN epilayer and its emission mechanism studied by time-resolved and temperature-resolved photoluminescence measurement.

articleTitle: Interplay between disorder and coulomb correlations in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate exciton dynamics in disordered quantum wells with optical two-dimensional Fourier transform spectroscopy (2DFTS). The lack of cross peaks in 2DFTS suggests that excitons localized in spatially separated regions are uncoupled.

articleTitle: All-fiber laser cavity dumping
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Cavity dumping of a fiber laser is demonstrated. A microstructured fiber with an electrically driven internal electrode is used for intracavity polarization rotation with nanosecond risetime. The optical flux can be dumped within one roundtrip.

articleTitle: Formation dynamics of excitons and electron-hole droplets in Si probed by THz time domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the formation dynamics of excitons and electron-hole droplets (EHD) in Si by broad-band THz time domain spectroscopy. A clear 1S-2P transition of indirect excitons and surface plasmon of EHD is observed.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast optics, Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semicondutors

articleTitle: GaAs nanoneedle photodetector monolithically grown on a (111) Si substrate by MOCVD
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: P-n junction GaAs nanoneedle photodetectors are monolithically grown on a (111) Si substrate by MOCVD with CMOS compatibility. A linear response of the photocurrent to the irradiance can be obtained under room temperature operation.

articleTitle: Discreteness in optics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Discrete optics opens up new opportunities in manipulating light flow. We provide an overview of recent experimental and theoretical developments in this area. The effects of discreteness on linear and nonlinear optical interactions are discussed.

articleTitle: On-chip sub-cellular resolution whole-animal manipulation for high-throughput in vivo screening
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a suite of technologies that can be combined to perform complex high-throughput whole-animal genetic and drug screens. When used in various combinations, these devices facilitate a variety of high-throughput assays using whole animals.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s buffered 2×2 optical packet switching using photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Contention resolution and forwarding of labeled optical packets at 40 Gb/s is demonstrated utilizing multiple InP based optical buffers and monolithic wavelength converters. Layer-2 packet recovery measurements are presented.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Recent theoretical progress in nanoplasmonics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We consider fundamentals and latest theoretical developments in the theoretical nanoplasmonics. Both fundamentals and recent developments such as SPASER and active nanoplasmonics are within the scope. We will also briefly review recent experimental data.

articleTitle: Lasers and electro-optics for ground-based astronomy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: To expand their science reach, terrestrial observatories have long demanded innovative optical technologies. Today, photonics enabling the active control, compensation, and detection of astronomical light are once again opening new vistas on our Universe.

articleTitle: Decimated cavity photonic crystal membrane lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report photonic crystal membrane nanolasers which employ a decimated photonic crystal cavity. Optically pumped lasing is achieved in decimated linear and star cavities showing that nonperiodic yet symmetric lattice structures provide sufficient optical confinement.

articleTitle: All quantum dot modelocked vertical external cavity surface emitting laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first entirely quantum-dot-based SESAM-modelocked VECSEL, using quantum-dot layers for gain and absorber. We obtain 22 mW average output power at 1053 nm wavelength in 10-ps pulses with 2.54 GHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Contrary behavior of absorption and dispersion
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A degenerate two-level system was investigated with circularly polarized probe and coupling lasers. An intensity dependent switch of an absorption peak to a dip was measured. The corresponding dispersion did not change.

articleTitle: Plasmonic-coupled nanostructure for improved surface plasmon resonance biosensing
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A three-dimensional (3D) composite nanostructure with enhanced normal electrical field is simulated and fabricated for surface plasmon resonance (SPR) biosensing. The device is used to measure specific binding events of different proteins.

articleTitle: Towards room temperature electrically pumped blue vertical cavity surface emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The authors report on strategies to achieve lasing in electrically driven vertical cavity surface emitting lasers at room temperature, namely the improvement of the quality factor of a microcavity suited for electrical injection, the use of a ZnO contact together with a dielectric current confinement layer and oxidized AlInN/GaN distributed Bragg reflectors.

articleTitle: Reducing phase errors during the inscription process of distributed feedback fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The fabrication of a reduced phase error, distributed feedback fiber laser in erbium-doped fiber is presented. Using the Trace Grating technique, the overall phase error has been reduced by a factor of 2.5.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave frequency doubling of near-infrared light using AlxGa1−xAs Bragg reflection waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Continuous-wave second harmonic generation in type-I phase-matched Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>As Bragg reflection waveguides is reported. Peak second harmonic power of 3.10 nW was measured for a pump at 1563.5 nm with an internal power of 174 muW.

articleTitle: Plasmonic metal-insulator-metal structures for interaction with silicon nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose to use plasmonic modes in a periodic metal-insulator-metal configuration with metallic gratings to enhance emission from silicon nanocrystals. The modification of emission with a change in grating periodicity is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Near-IR emission from metal-insulator-metal tunnel junctions based on surface plasmon interactions
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the observation of near-IR emission from Al-AlO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>-Au tunnel junctions and a blurred-up peak at high applied voltage. We argue that it results from an interaction with near-IR surface plasmons.

articleTitle: Single photon gun: Radiative decay engineering with metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a new approach to single-photon sources based on metamaterials with hyperbolic dispersion. Highly directional emission and dramatic reduction in spontaneous-emission lifetime due to the singularity in density-of-states leads to an ideal photon gun.

articleTitle: Above-millijoule continuum generation using polarisation dependent filamentation in atoms and molecules
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this work we experimentally demonstrate for the first time that input polarization control inducing one single filamentation is a very robust technique to achieve multi-millijoule output energies. We highlight an accurate filamentation dynamic control enhancing throughput energy of the supercontinuum generation above one-millijoule limit consistent with sub-10fs laser pulse generation.

articleTitle: Real-time studies of muscle cell contractions with second harmonic generation microscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Real-time second harmonic generation microscopy of live myocytes was achieved with a femtosecond diode-pumped Yb:KGd(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser. Negligible absorption allows for prolonged imaging during muscle contractions with no significant phototoxic effects or signal degradation.

articleTitle: Spectrometers based on anisotropic metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show a new spectrometer class achieved through resonant cones associated with dispersive anisotropic metamaterials. The anisotropic slab can be implemented by metal-insulator stacks, and a Ag/GaAs multilayer stack example is described.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser induced plasma diffraction gratings in air
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The creation of a volume plasma density grating in air by two intersecting high-intensity IR femtosecond laser pulses is demonstrated experimentally. The detailed characterization of the grating is conducted based on its diffraction properties.

articleTitle: Sub shot noise spatial correlation measurement for quantum imaging of weak objects
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report an experiment on sub-shot-noise spatial correlations measurement without any subtraction of background; this result is a crucial point for the realization of sub shot-noise imaging of weak objects.

articleTitle: Nonlinear terahertz excitations of optically dark para excitons in Cu2O
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A microscopic theory is applied to describe nonlinear terahertz excitations of optically-dark excitons in Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O. The theory is quantitatively compared to recent experiments. Signatures of Rabi flopping and ponderomotive contributions are discussed and disentangled.

articleTitle: Coherent optical and acoustic phonons coupled with the charge-ordering phase transition in La1/4Pr3/8Ca3/8MnO3
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy is used to investigate La<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/4</inf>Pr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3/8</inf>Ca<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3/8</inf>MnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. Coherent optical and acoustic phonons are observed strongly coupled with the charge-ordering phase transition. Phonon characteristics are well understood in a hypothesis related with charge-ordering gap opening.

articleTitle: Increasing the consistency and accuracy of spectral shearing interferometry via multiple shearing
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate improved accuracy and consistency for spectral-shearing interferometry using multiple shears. Using a new algorithm, different spectral shears are combined to perform accurate spectral phase measurements of complicated pulses from a hollow-core fiber system.

articleTitle: Bandwidth- and wavelength-tunable comb filter using PLC-based optical transversal filter
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate bandwidth- and wavelength-tunable comb filters with sharp-cutoff and low-dispersion characteristics using a 16-tap PLC-based optical transversal filter. Such filters have no limitation of the wavelength-channel number owing to the cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometer structure.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics of three-level, inhomogeneously-broadened atoms in an optical cavity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study theoretically and experimentally the strongly-coupled, nonlinear regime of a hot vapor of three-level atoms in an optical cavity. Interesting effects include lasing without inversion and polariton peak splittings.

articleTitle: Waveguide writing and characterization in Tellurite glass
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultra-fast laser-induced positive refractive index changes in bulk tellurite glass were investigated. The refractive indexes of waveguiding structures were measured using the far-field approach. Filamentation was observed for certain irradiation conditions.

articleTitle: Many-body two-quantum coherences in 2D Fourier-Transform spectra of semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-quantum coherences in two-dimensional Fourier-transform (2DFT) spectra are attributed to many-body interactions. 2DFT spectroscopy allows two-quantum coherences in semiconductors to be isolated. As a result, many-body coherences can be separated from biexciton coherences.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a 9cm side-emitting fiber laser line source with a tilted fiber grating output coupler
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an Er doped fiber laser line source whose output coupler is a 9 cm, 45deg tilted fiber grating. Our approach shows potential for improved efficiency and simplicity over previously described line sources.

articleTitle: Uniaxial stress dependence of yellow series np excitons in Cu2O
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed stress dependence of the energy of np excitons in Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O by linear absorption spectroscopy. The energy shift of np states agrees well with calculations using modified coefficients under symmetry considerations.

articleTitle: High repetition rate two-color pump-probe system directly pumped by a femtosecond ytterbium oscillator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By exploiting optical parametric generation in periodically poled lithium niobate driven by a Yb:KYW laser, we realized a two-colour pump-probe system in the near- and mid-infrared with 1-MHz repetition rate, 300-fs resolution and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> sensitivity.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical characterization of H-bonded chromophores in linear-dendritic block copolymers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A linear-dendritic block copolymer was synthesized by end-functionalizing PMMA homopolymer with dendrons that acted as H-bond acceptors for thiophene-based nonlinear optical chromophores. The polymer forms excellent quality films which can be spin coated and corona poled. Electro-optic measurements show r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">33</sub> = 25 pm/V at 1550 nm. The relative simplicity of the H-bonded scheme can be readily extended to more highly nonlinear chromophores.

articleTitle: Redirection of lateral emission using nanorod reflectors for power enhancement of GaN light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricate the nanorod arrays at the periphery of light-emitting mesa as the reflector. The nanorod arrays redirect the laterally propagated light. The output power is enhanced by 32.1% at 30 mA injection current.

articleTitle: Noncollinear red-green-blue light generation based on a hexagonally poled superlattice in lithium tantalite
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Noncollinear red-green-blue light generation from a single hexagonally poled superlattice in lithium tantalite was achieved. It resulted from the frequency self-doubling optical parametric amplification process in a single-pass quasi-phase-matching scheme.

articleTitle: Vacuum acceleration in a regime beyond Brunel absorption
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a new regime of vacuum acceleration in laser-plasmas driven by ultrafast pulses of relativistic intensity, in which space-charge separation leads to strongly enhanced laser absorption and 20 MeV electrons accelerated outward.

articleTitle: Picosecond coherent control of dressed states in a single quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate picosecond control of dressed states in a single quantum dot. The Rabi oscillations of the dressed states are directly resolved in the time domain through beating of the Autler-Townes doublet.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Three-photon lasing from ZnSe excited by a kilojoule-class Nd:glass laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Three-photon fluorescence and lasing from ZnSe was observed for a kilojoule-class, 100 picosecond pulse, Nd:glass laser excitation. In this work, the emission properties and its excitation energy dependence were investigated for low and high-energy excitation.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of germanium photodetectors and silicon wire waveguides with carrier injection structures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We integrated monolithically vertical p-i-n Ge photodetectors with variable optical attenuators (VOAs) based on Si wire rib waveguides with a carrier injection structure. The fabricated Ge photodetectors have a low dark current of 60 nA and a high responsivity of 0.85 A/W at -1 V and accurately detect the change in light power due to the Si-VOA.

articleTitle: Dynamic SMSR measurement of fast SG-DBR laser wavelength switching
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present for the first time measurement of the dynamic SMSR during fast laser channel transitions. A highly sensitive heterodyne method is employed in order to achieve signal to noise ratios in excess of 60 dB.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical switching in Silicon-based plasmonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and analyze 3- and 5-layer sub-wavelength Silicon-based plasmonic waveguide switches. Above-bandgap femtosecond pump pulses are used to modulate 1550nm signals with switching time ∼5ps and high on/off contrast ratio of 23dB.

articleTitle: Characterizing single photons by photon counting
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the ability to measure the non-Gaussian character of the single photon Fock states via direct measurements of the photon number statistics of displaced quantum states.

articleTitle: Two-photon detection in a MQW GaAs laser at 1.55µm
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first demonstration of two-photon photocurrent in a GaAs/AlGaAs multiple quantum well laser at 1.55 mum. We measure the device efficiency, sensitivity, as well as the two-photon absorption coefficient. The results show that the device has a strong potential for signal processing, autocorrelation and possibly two-photon source applications at sub-Watt power levels.

articleTitle: Ultrafast confocal microscope for functional imaging of organic thin films
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce a novel instrument combining femtosecond pump-probe spectroscopy with broadband detection and confocal microscopy. The system has 200-fs temporal resolution and 300-nm spatial resolution. We present spatio-temporal maps of excited-state dynamics in polyfluorene-polymethylethacrylate blends.

articleTitle: Observation of anti-Stokes fluorescence from GaN Film grown on Si (111) substrate
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Phonon-assisted anti-Stokes fluorescence has been observed in GaN film grown on Si (111) substrate. The donor-acceptor pairs and bound excitons have played primary roles in the generation of anti-Stokes fluorescence.

articleTitle: Optical nonlinearity of a colloidal “non-ideal gas” of nano-suspensions
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that many-body effects in stabilized nano-suspensions can have a profound effect on their optical nonlinearity. The nonlinear properties of these colloids can range from polynomial to exponential depending on their composition and chemistry.

articleTitle: Spontaneous Raman scattering in suspended InGaAsP waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the spontaneous Raman effect in suspended InGaAsP waveguides and report that the zinc blende Raman selection rules are relaxed in the waveguide geometry. The suspended semiconductor waveguide is an exciting platform for a range of linear and nonlinear optical experiments due to its enhanced light-guiding capability.

articleTitle: Organic electro-optic single-crystalline waveguide modulators, microresonators and nanowires fabricated by melt capillary growth
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We developed a new approach to fabricate high-quality single-crystalline high-index-contrast waveguiding micro- and nanostructures and demonstrated electro-optic modulation at 1.55 mum in waveguides grown from the melt of a recently developed organic material.

articleTitle: Design of nanoslotted photonic crystal waveguide cavities for single nanoparticle trapping
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We design and numerically simulate a photonic crystal waveguide cavity with a nanoslot structure for single nanoparticle trapping. A 135× enhancement of optical gradient trapping force compared to plain waveguide trapping devices has been achieved.

articleTitle: Plasmon waveguide interband cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the demonstration and development of plasmon waveguide interband cascade lasers operating in continuous wave near 6 microns and beyond.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal nanocavity laser with single quantum dot gain
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a photonic crystal nanocavity laser essentially driven by single quantum dot gain. A diluted quantum dot density (~0.4/cavity) resulted in clear single quantum dot feature and distinct phase transition in photon correlation measurements.

articleTitle: Slot waveguides for achieving 147-nm-wide and −31.3 ps/(m·nm) dispersion and near-zero flattened dispersion
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose on-chip slot-waveguide-based dispersion-flattening devices, which can exhibit either a highly negative dispersion of -31300 ps/nm/km over 147-nm bandwidth, or a near-zero dispersion of 0plusmn350 ps/nm/km over 306 nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Total-reflection active-mirror laser with directly liquid-nitrogen-cooled Yb:YAG ceramics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the efficient operation of directly liquid-nitrogen-cooled Yb:YAG active-mirror laser. A CW output power of 273 W with slope efficiency of 72% was demonstrated. High heat removal ability was ensured at 743 W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamics of partially-coherent spatial beams
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We consider the propagation of a partially-coherent spatial beam in both self-focusing and self-defocusing nonlinear media. Measurements of beam widths for both nonlinearities confirm theoretical predictions based on a nonlinear Gaussian-Schell model.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared pulse dynamics in Si nanophotonic wires near the two-photon absorption edge
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an experimental and simulation study of the pulse dynamics in SOI nanophotonic wires at mid-infrared wavelengths beyond the telecommunications band, and illustrate the significantly reduced role of two-photon absorption.

articleTitle: Efficient generation of transform-limited mid-infrared pulses based on sum-frequency generation in CdSe crystal
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have efficiently generated coherent mid-infrared pulses at 3.42 mum by mixing a CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser beam with its second-harmonic output beam in a CdSe crystal with the output peak power as high as 39.2 W.

articleTitle: Purcell-enhanced spontaneous emission of colloidal PbS quantum dots in slow-light silicon photonic crystal waveguides at the near-infrared
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present Purcell-enhanced spontaneous emission of colloidal near-infrared quantum dots in silicon photonic crystal waveguides. The lead sulfide quantum dots demonstrated slow-light enhancement from the large local density of states at the band edge.

articleTitle: Generation of 5.1 fs, 0.5 mJ pulses with an adaptive phase modulator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By improving the throughput of the 4f system and by increasing the input laser pulse energy, milli-joule level two cycle pulses were produced with a liquid crystal spatial light modulator for the first time.

articleTitle: Ultrafast imaging with electron pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Probing ultrafast dynamics with electron pulses reveals information not accessible by other methods. Here we present two experiments where we have used electron pulses to observe molecular dynamics and to measure localized electromagnetic fields.

articleTitle: Wide-range spectral shearing interferometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new scheme of spectral shearing interferometer providing a wide observation window has been demonstrated. Few-cycle pulse has been measured with a temporal observation/resolution ratio of >10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and a dynamic range of >10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>.

articleTitle: Field-free unidirectional molecular rotation following excitation by two ultrashort pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By varying the polarization and delay between two ultrashort laser pulses, we control the plane, speed, and sense of molecular rotation. This control may be implemented to individual components within a molecular mixture.

articleTitle: Negative index metamaterials for visible wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a metamaterial sample that demonstrates double-negative index behavior at the shortest wavelength to date. We also discuss the controlled resonance tuning of optical magnetism in materials by using of liquid crystals.

articleTitle: Cladding-modulated bragg gratings in silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A cladding-modulated Bragg grating implemented using periodic placements of silicon cylinders in the cladding along a silicon waveguide is proposed. Modeling results are verified experimentally, demonstrating coupling strengths differing by an order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Ultrafast pulse characterization of semiconductor single-section fabry-perot mode-locked lasers
