publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We used a time-domain modulation based technique to characterize the ultrafast pulse of the semiconductor single-section Fabry-Perot lasers. The pulse spectral phase is found time invariant and hence positively confirms the mode-locking operation.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 40-km-reach WDM-PON with capacity of 40-Gb/s based on wavelength-locked F-P LD
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 40-km-reach 32-channel gigabit wavelength division multiplexing-passive optical network (WDM-PON) based on Fabry-Perot laser diode with external ASE injection. The dispersion, back-reflection and crosstalk effects in WDM-PON are also investigated.

articleTitle: Characterization of isolated attosecond pulses from multi-cycle lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Through FROG-CRAB based on attosecond streaking, we characterized 140 attosecond single isolated pulses generated with a double optical gating using 9 fs lasers.

articleTitle: Active trapping of individual particles on an optofluidic analysis platform
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A feedback-based opto-electrical trap is demonstrated on a fully planar optofluidic analysis platform. The trap permits the prolonged observation of single fluorescent objects ranging from bacteria to nanoparticles in an optofluidic setting.

articleTitle: Spatial mode selector in silicon waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the design, fabrication and experimental characterization of the spatial mode selector that transmit only the second silicon waveguide mode. Nanofabrication results and near field measurements are presented.

articleTitle: THz generation from InN films based on interference between optical rectification and photocurrent surge
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: THz average output power as high as 2.4 microwatts is generated from InN films, with the mechanism being the interference between optical rectification and photocurrent surge.

articleTitle: A femtosecond Yb:KGd(WO4)2 laser for biological imaging of yellow fluorescent protein
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Real time multiphoton excitation fluorescence microscopy of enhanced yellow fluorescent protein was performed with low photobleaching using a femtosecond Yb:KGd(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser. Using a conventional Ti:S laser this was previously unfeasible due to low excitation efficiency.

articleTitle: Influence of the linewidth enhancement factor on the critical feedback level in a quantum dash laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Contributions of both the ground and excited states in the degradation of the coherence collapse threshold in a quantum dash laser are analyzed. The excited states are found to strongly alter the device's feedback sensitivity.

articleTitle: Gain compression and thermal analysis of a sapphire-bonded photonic crystal microcavity laser under various duty cycles
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Gain compression factor and thermal properties of a sapphire-bonded microcavity laser are extracted by analyzing wavelength shifts under different duty cycles. High thermal resistance of 21 K/mW and gain compression factor of 1.0x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-16</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> are obtained.

articleTitle: Design and deployment of a quantum cascade laser absorption spectrometer in an open-path sensor system for trace gas analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A widely tunable, external cavity quantum cascade laser was used in the deployment of an open-path sensor for the measurement of water vapor, ozone, ammonia, and carbon dioxide in the urban atmosphere of Beijing, China.

articleTitle: Cavity QED experiments with ion Coulomb crystals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Cavity QED experimental results demonstrating collective strong coupling between ensembles of atomic ions cooled into Coulomb crystals and optical cavity fields have been achieved. Collective Zeeman coherence times of milliseconds have furthermore been obtained.

articleTitle: Megabits secure key rate quantum key distribution
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Imperfect practical conditions limit communication speed of quantum cryptography. Here we implement differential phase shift quantum key distribution with up-conversion assisted hybrid photon detector to achieve 1.3 M bits/s secure key rate over a 10-km fiber.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional nanoscopy of biological samples
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated super-resolution imaging of protein distributions in cells at depth at multiple layers with a lateral localization precision better than 50nm. The approach is based on combining photoactivated localization microscopy with temporal focusing.

articleTitle: Periodically-poled silicon
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a new class of photonic devices based on periodic stress fields in silicon. Our approach creates quasi-phase matched second-order nonlinear processes that can be used, for example, for efficient midwave-infrared generation.

Author Keywords: (190.4390) Nonlinear optics: Nonlinear optics, integrated optics

articleTitle: Coherent combining of fiber amplifiers through atmospheric turbulence: A model
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a model, based on speckle propagation, of the remote coherent combining of fiber amplifiers through atmospheric turbulence. The simulations show why, and under what conditions coherent beam combining through turbulence is possible.

articleTitle: Ultra-wide THz-wave generation by DAST and BNA
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Organic nonlinear crystals are most promising materials for efficient THz wave generation using DFG as well as TDS. Two kinds of organic crystals : 4-dimethylamino-N-methyl-4-stilbazolium tosylate (DAST) and N-benzyl-2-methyl-4-nitroaniline (BNA) are investigated for ultrawide THz-wave generation. New THz applications will be presented using frequency-agile THz sources.

articleTitle: Improved THz imaging with a virtual-source based synthetic aperture focusing technique and coherence weighting
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We combine a virtual-source based synthetic aperture focusing technique with coherence weighting to overcome the limited depth-of-focus of high numerical aperture THz optics. Images show depth-independent spatial resolution and a 14 dB improvement in SNR.

articleTitle: A broadband terahertz metamaterial electrical modulator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate hybrid metamaterial devices that are able to electrically switch their resonances therefore the terahertz transmission properties at room temperature. The interrelated amplitude switching and phase shifting allow for fast broadband external terahertz modulation.

articleTitle: Intracavity phase modulation for phase noise and supermode noise spur suppression in mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using intracavity active phase modulation, we have verified the theory of Haus and Rana and realized timing jitter reduction from 304 fs to 150 fs integrated to Nyquist frequency on a 10.24 GHz actively mode-locked pulse train.

articleTitle: THz studies of charge and exciton dynamics in semiconductor nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have used terahertz time-domain spectroscopy to investigate carrier dynamics in a wide range of semiconductors. The technique allows discriminating between free charges and excitons and is perfectly suitable to study carrier-carrier interactions in nanostructured materials.

articleTitle: Soliton emission from a trapping potential
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spatial solitons trapped in a confining potential can undergo power dependent scattering. As the potential depends on the nonlinearity, solitons can accumulate transverse acceleration and eventually escape. We demonstrated this phenomenon in a reorientational medium.

articleTitle: Modeling asymmetric reflectance in semicontinuous metal films using generalized Ohm's Law
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Generalized Ohm's Law is used to model the phenomenon of broadband asymmetric reflectance recently observed in semicontinuous metal-dielectric films in the proximity of the percolation threshold. Qualitative agreement with experiment is achieved.

articleTitle: Design of optimal dispersive mirrors for femtosecond enhancement cavities and compressors by minimizing phase distortion power
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The optimization of phase distortion spectral power density is proposed as an alternative to GDD minimization of ultrafast cavity mirrors. This criterion is shown to minimize the detuning of cavity resonances from a uniform comb.

articleTitle: Imaging interferometric nanoscopy to the limit of available frequency space
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Imaging interferometric microscopy resolution to lambda/2(n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sub</sub>+1) (n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sub</sub>=substrate refractive index) is demonstrated using evanescent-wave illumination. Resolution to 150 nm (lambda/4.2) is achieved using a 633 nm source and a 0.4 NA lens.

articleTitle: Synthesis and shaping of picosecond pulses by frequency conversion of femtosecond pulses in engineered quadratic media
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Second-harmonic-generation in lithium-tantalate crystals with engineered quasi-phase-matching structures is exploited to synthesize with high efficiency narrow-bandwidth picosecond pulses of predetermined spectral and temporal shape starting from femtosecond ones.

articleTitle: Ultrafast modulation of optical metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The optical response of fishnet metamaterial can be modulated in femtosecond time scale. This modulation dynamics is mainly determined by the constituting dielectric medium, but the modulation magnitude is greatly enhanced through the plasmon resonance.

articleTitle: Exploring energy-time entanglement Using geometric phase
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using the photons produced by parametric down-conversion, we report an experimental observation of a violation of the Bell inequality for energy and time based purely on the geometric phases of the downconverted photons.

IEEE Keywords: Member and Geographic Activities Board committees

articleTitle: Modulation squeezing of a 10 Gb/s RZ and NRZ signal with a single SOA
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A characterisation of a SOA-based modulation suppressor for 10Gb/s RZ and NRZ signals is performed. Its effectiveness in colourless WDM PON is demonstrated obtaining error-free operation in a 20km-long link.

articleTitle: In-situ calibration of a translation stage by low-coherence tandem interferometer
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: For remote and in-situ calibration of translation stage, system comparing optical-path-differences of two distantly-located low-coherence-interferometers through a single-mode-optical-fiber has been developed. Results of 52 nm-deviation and 30 nm-standard deviation for 39 mm-displacement is achieved.

articleTitle: A comparison between digital and analog Pound-Drever-Hall laser stabilization
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We locked a laser to a cavity using an all-digital Pound-Drever-Hall feedback system. By performing the demodulation and feedback controller digitally the low frequency noise performance was improved compared to a conventional analog system.

articleTitle: Threshold and temperature dependence of quantum dot laser diodes approaching ideal performance
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Low threshold QD laser with threshold current density <10 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is experimentally shown and threshold current temperature dependence of a QD laser with an ideal delta function density of electronic states is analyzed.

articleTitle: Towards high quality photonic polarization entanglement distribution at 1.3-µm telecom wavelength
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Polarization-entangled photons at 1.3 mum from a fiber-coupled PPKTP waveguide are analyzed using a remotely located superconducting nanowire single-photon detector, yielding 97.5% quantum-interference visibility and 0.8 coincidence/s at 96 muW pump power.

articleTitle: Precise alignment of large-aperture compressor gratings for high-power lasers by using diffraction interferometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce novel method of precise compressor alignment for Petawatt-scale CPA lasers. The method is using compressor gratings as gratings of diffraction interferometer. It meets accuracy requirements (~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>) and allows simple procedures of alignment.

articleTitle: Experimental Generation of 1.6-THz repetition-rate pulse-trains in a Passive Optical Fiber Resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using an optical fiber ring cavity with a GVD coefficient as low as -0.02 ps<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/km, we experimentally generated pulse-trains with a repetition-rate in the THz range. We achieved the spectral and temporal characterization of this train.

articleTitle: Tuning the coupling of a single quantum dot to a photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present time-resolved spontaneous emission measurements of a single quantum dot that is temperature tuned around the band edge of a photonic crystal waveguide. 85% efficient coupling to the slow-light waveguide mode is obtained.

articleTitle: Determination of reabsorption-free emission cross sections of ionic transitions by the pinhole method
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The determination of emission cross sections requires an emission spectrum and the radiative lifetime. In highly ion-doped materials reabsorption can significantly affect these parameters. The pinhole method is a measurement technique providing reabsorption-free spectroscopic parameters.

articleTitle: Effective in plane launching and focusing surface plasmons by a plasmonic lens
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We implement in plane launching and focusing surface plasmons by fabricating Fresnel zone-plate like grating on a thin gold film. A subwavelength focal spot, with transverse FWHM=712nm, is observed at 830nm vacuum wavelength.

articleTitle: A comparative study of second-harmonic generation and diffraction experiments in ferroelectric domain-engineered crystals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that the nonlinear optical performance of periodically poled crystals can be exactly predicted by observing the far-field diffraction pattern. The diffraction pattern is shown to be equivalent to the second-harmonic generation tuning curve.

articleTitle: Laser-plasma generated electron beams for radiographic applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate use of laser-accelerated electron beams for high resolution long standoff, radiographic applications and detection of shielded dense materials. For first time, radiographs with sub-millimeter resolution; embedded gaps in dense materials are presented.

articleTitle: Fiber optic sensor system for stress monitoring in power cables
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Monitoring of stress in power cables is of great interest to determine the cable lifetime, especially under rough environmental conditions like in offshore wind energy plants. Standard single mode fibers are generally included in power cables for data transfer. In our approach we developed a sensor device which uses single mode fibers already included in the cables and a short pulse broadband light source. This allows measuring temperature and pressure via time resolved Raman backscattering photon counting as well as monitoring bending and torsion via fiber Bragg gratings.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon enhanced magneto-optic isolator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Here we present an integrated isolator design based on nonreciprocal coupling into a magnetooptic surface-plasmon waveguide that achieves an isolation >30 dB with an insertion <3 dB in a device length <100 mum.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical nonlinearities in hybrid metal-J-aggregate nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study for the first time the ultrafast optical nonlinearities of hybrid, metal-J-aggregate nanostructures using angle-resolved pump-probe-spectroscopy. Our results demonstrate that the strong coupling between surface plasmon polaritons and excitons drastically alters the polariton dynamics.

articleTitle: Terahertz open-aperture Z-scan in doped InGaAs
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have performed open-aperture Z-scan measurements on n-doped InGaAs using intense few-cycle terahertz pulses. We observe a significant bleaching of the terahertz pulse absorption attributed to terahertz-electric-field-induced intervalley carrier scattering.

articleTitle: Fabrication of antireflection nanostructures on GaAs by holographic lithography for device applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the fabrication of antireflection nanostructures on GaAs using holographic lithography. Measured results of the fabricated nanostructures are in good agreement with the calculated values using a RCWA model, effectively suppressing the surface reflection over visible and near-infrared ranges.

articleTitle: Polarization proximity effect in isolator crystal pairs
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally study the polarization dynamics (orientation and ellipticity) of near infrared light transmitted through magnetooptic yttrium iron garnet isolator crystal pairs using a modified balanced detection scheme. When the pair separation is in the sub-millimeter range, we observed a proximity effect in which the saturation field is reduced by up to 20%. Calculations using a 1D model suggest that the proximity effect originates from magnetostatic interactions between the dipole moments of the isolator crystals.

articleTitle: A tunable optofluidic microlens based on gradient refractive index
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A tunable opto-fluidic microlens configuration named liquid gradient refractive index (L-GRIN) lens is described. The variable light focusing is achieved through the diffusion based refractive index gradient within a microfluidic device.

articleTitle: Superheating of LIBS plasma electron temperature by addition of a CO2 laser pulse onto Fe, Pb and Al substrates for remote sensing applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 10.6 mum CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser pulse was used to enhance a remote LIBS emission. The temperature of the plasma was measured, and increased by 3,000 K due to the addition of the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser pulse.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulsed Raman gain in highly nonlinear As2Se3 chalcogenide fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report an experimental study of pulsed Raman gain in As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> chalcogenide fiber, for pump pulses between 1470nm and 1560nm, achieving the highest Raman gain at the longest pump wavelength, where two-photon absorption is lowest.

articleTitle: Super-broadly wavelength-tunable semiconductor nanowire lasers on a single substrate
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate lasing from semiconductor nanowires with wavelength continuously tunable from 500 to 700 nm on single substrate. This widest ever tuning range of any semiconductor lasers is achieved through spatial composition-grading of alloy semiconductors.

articleTitle: Unconditional continuous variable entanglement cascading
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A sequence of continuous-variable entanglement swapping is studied. We obtain the upper-bound of Gaussian cascaded entanglement and propose an unconditional protocol achieving it. We demonstrate entanglement can be unconditionally cascaded for any nonzero-squeezed entangled sources.

articleTitle: High-energy femtosecond chirped-pulse oscillator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the generation of high-energy femtosecond pulses in a chirped-pulse oscillator based on an ytterbium-doped large-mode-area photonic crystal fiber. Output pulses with 800 fs duration and more than 90 nJ energy are generated.

articleTitle: Optical sampling of several bandwidth-limited signals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an optical system for multirate undersampling of several bandwidth limited signals with unknown carrier frequencies within a very broad frequency range. The amplitudes and the phases of the signals were accurately reconstructed.

articleTitle: The use of polydimethylsiloxane concave microstructures arrays to enhance light extraction efficiency of InGaN quantum wells light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel approach to improve light extraction efficiency of InGaN-based light emitting diodes with polydimethylsiloxane concave microstructures arrays was demonstrated, which leads to enhancement of extraction efficiency by 1.60-times in good agreement with simulation.

articleTitle: Effects of molecular adsorption on optical losses of silver surfaces
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical losses of organic molecules adsorbed on the Ag(111) surface are studied by first-principles. Substantial modifications of Im(epsiv) in the near infrared and visible spectral regions are predicted, discussed, and compared to experimental results.

articleTitle: Amplification of a laser beam by a single molecule
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The amplification of light by a single excited molecule in free space is demonstrated in this paper. The extinction effect is the result of a destructive interference between the incident laser beam and the coherently scattered light from the molecule in the ground state. Thus, inversion of the population should lead to a phase shift of the scattered light and amplification of the laser light.

articleTitle: Modified surface plasmon antenna for localized field enhancement
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper, a modified antenna is proposed and its performance is evaluated using numerical simulations. The modified design combines the advantages of rod antenna and bowtie antenna, which make it useful for many potential applications.

articleTitle: Enhancement of polymer dye lasers by multifunctional photonic crystal lattice
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The light output of dye doped hybrid polymer band-edge lasers is increased more than 100 times by using a rectangular lattice photonic crystal, which provides both feedback and couples more pump light into the laser.

articleTitle: Two-photon fabrication of three-dimensional metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-photon-induced metal ion reduction technique is developed for fabricating 3D metallic micro/nano structures. The fabrication of continuous and electrically conductive silver structures with a minimum width of 100 nm are demonstrated. Moreover, the realization of self-supporting 3D silver microstructures is demonstrated. This technique will become a promising tool for realizing three-dimensional plasmonic metamaterials.

articleTitle: Coherently coupled exciton lasing
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Lowest reported threshold organic semiconductor VCSEL (4.9 µJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) is achieved when excitons coherently couple, upon sub-picosecond non-resonant optical excitation. Temperature dependence of λ/2n device, absent in . ≥/n cavities, indicates excitons undergo condensate-like phase transition.

articleTitle: New concept for ultra-broadband photonic integrator with fundamentally unlimited operation time window
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a concept for temporal integration of optical waveforms with no fundamental limitation on the device's operation time window and frequency bandwidth using a pulse multiplier concatenated with a fiber Bragg grating.

articleTitle: Photonic MEMS vibrating at X-band rates (11 GHz)
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally observe an opto-mechanical whispering-gallery [WG] resonator vibrating at 11 GHz. We use optical electrostriction to drive mechanical vibration at frequencies which scale inversely with optical wavelength, irrespective of micro-resonator size.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation in lithium niobate planar waveguides grown by liquid phase epitaxy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High quality lithium niobate planar waveguides, with LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> substrates, were grown using liquid phase epitaxy from K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O flux. The waveguides do not exhibit impurity absorption in the visible, yielding efficient second harmonic generation.

articleTitle: Efficient distributed self-mixing in silicon CMOS transistors
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 645-GHz focal-plane array fabricated in a 0.25-mum CMOS process achieves a responsivity of up to 80 kV/W and a NEP of 300 pW/pHz. The mixing mechanism is analyzed. Heterodyne detection is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation in pure silica core cut-off shifted single mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Flat and single mode supercontinuum generation spanning from 700 to 2350 nm was demonstrated using a nanosecond microchip laser and conventional cut-off shifted SMF. This configuration is attractive as a simple and low-cost light source.

articleTitle: Pulsed laser ignition thresholds of energetic multilayer foils
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ignition thresholds for energetic multilayer foils comprised of aluminum (Al) and platinum (Pt) layers are presented as a function of foil properties for laser pulse durations of 100 femtosecond (fs) and 30 nanosecond (ns).

articleTitle: All-optical characterization of large-signal modulation bandwidth of a monolithically integrated DFB-EA
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use an all-optical method to characterize the modulation bandwidth of a DFB-EA designed for 100 Gb/s Ethernet. In a large-signal wavelength conversion set-up, we show the device has an all-optical bandwidth of 83 GHz.

articleTitle: Location-resolved gas concentration detection using frequency-shifted interferometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use frequency-shifted interferometry to detect the concentrations of the same gas species at different locations and in different mixtures by accurately correcting the spectral shadowing effect. Different gas species are also detected.

articleTitle: Fabry-Perot measurements of InAs/GaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A scanning Fabry-Perot cavity is used to measure the photoluminescence of InAs/GaAs self-assembled quantum dots with linewidths as low as 1 GHz. This cavity is subsequently locked to the dot emission using PI control.

articleTitle: Atom “meta-optics”: Negative-index media for matter waves in the nm wavelength range
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Meta-optics is extended to matter waves. ldquoCo-movingrdquo magnetic fields in Stern-Gerlach interferometers allows producing negative group velocity of atomic wave packets, resulting into a negative refraction of the matter wave and atom ldquometa-lensesrdquo.

articleTitle: Low saturation fluence antiresonant quantum dot SESAMs for MIXSEL integration
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A detailed QD-SESAM growth study enabled the first modelocking of a VECSEL with similar spot size on gain and antiresonant SESAM. Antiresonant designs can strongly improve MIXSELs, a novel type of ultrafast integrated VECSELs.

articleTitle: Tuning of an optofluidic Micro Ring Resonator by electrowetting
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the tuning of an on chip Micro Ring Resonator (MRR) using water based droplet driven by electro-wetting. The results show that opto-fluidic devices can be controlled by electrical signal.

articleTitle: Self-filtering of noisy images via stochastic resonance
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear self-filtering and amplification of noisy, low-level images is demonstrated in a self-focusing photorefractive medium. Signal recovery depends sensitively on the parameters of the system and represents a new dynamical type of stochastic resonance.

articleTitle: Night vision enhancement technology with pyroelectric field driven liquid crystal display
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel night vision enhancement technology based on IR to visible light translation was demonstrated with a specifically designed liquid crystal cell sandwiched with pyroelectric and glass plates, which can be viewed by naked eyes.

Author Keywords: (040.6808) Thermal (uncooled) IR detectors, arrays and imaging

articleTitle: Bend-resistant, single-stage, S-band erbium-doped photonic crystal fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present design guidelines to achieve ~ 50-dB of gain with an average gain value of 26-dB over 70-nm bandwidth in a 7.2-m long erbium-doped depressed-cladding photonic crystal fiber amplifier showing bend-resistant functionality.

articleTitle: Progress in sub-micrometer periodicity of quasi-phase matching structures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the progress in fabrication of sub-micrometer ferroelectric domain gratings in KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>. Periods as short as 565 nm have been created in the bulk of the crystal by electric-field poling.

articleTitle: 147 fs, 51 MHz soliton fiber laser at 1.56 µm with a fiber-connector-type SWNT/P3HT saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricated a fiber-connector-type saturable absorber in which SWNTs and P3HT (poly-3-hexylthiophene) were coated on the connector end. The pulse width was 147 fs and the repetition rate reached as high as 51 MHz.

articleTitle: Practical issues of retrieving isolated attosecond pulse from CRAB
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The effects of streaking speed, time delay jitter, laser intensity variation and shot noise on the reconstruction of attosecond XUV pulse with PCGPA are studied.

articleTitle: Weak-resonant-cavity FPLD based down-stream amplitude squeezer for injection-locking RSOA transmitter in DWDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate dual low-facet-reflectivity FPLD amplitude squeezers to suppress extinction ratio of down-stream signal by 8.6 dB for injection-locking RSOA in DWDM-PON with error-free 1.25 Gbps up-stream transmission at receiving power of -25.5 dBm.

articleTitle: Effect of surface waves on gain-guided transverse-grating waveguides with large mode area
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate gain-guided transverse-grating waveguides with large modal area for optical lasers/amplifiers. We show that surface modes could sustain higher modal gain than the fundamental core mode, which hinders the single mode propagation of gain guiding. We propose a scheme to remove such surface modes.

articleTitle: Experimental implementation of time-coding quantum key distribution at telecommunication wavelength
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A time-coding quantum key distribution protocol at telecommunication wavelength is investigated over a 25 km channel. Measured 98% visibility and 2% QBER enable 200 km security range and 1 kbit/sec secret key rates.

articleTitle: A hollow triangular-core fiber: Investigation of its modal propagation and polarization control
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a hollow triangular-core fiber (HTCF) having low-fold symmetry in contrast to conventional cylindrical optical fibers. Near-field intensity variations, Fresnel diffraction patterns, and polarization modes of the HTCF were investigated.

articleTitle: High efficiency terahertz generation and detection in the organic nonlinear optical crystal OH1
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate highly efficient generation and detection of broadband THz pulses in the organic nonlinear optical crystal OH1. We achieved a photon conversion efficiency of 11 percent through optical rectification of 45 muJ laser pulses.

articleTitle: Optical microcavities on si formed by self-assembled InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot microtubes
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have investigated the fabrication and characterization of 3-dimensionally confined optical microcavities on Si formed by self-assembled InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot microtubes. Such microcavities on Si are free of defects and exhibit a Q-factor of 3,000.

articleTitle: Multiwatt high-efficiency CW single-mode visible lasers for ultrahigh-resolution displays
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An ultrahigh-resolution display (~33 megapixels) employs high-power CW visible lasers which are generated through three-wave external mixing of infrared fiber lasers. The lasers provide >6 W at red, green and blue wavelengths.

articleTitle: Single-shot optical sampling of ultrafast signals using a silicon-chip time lens
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate single-shot optical sampling using a time lens based on four-wave mixing in a silicon nanowaveguide. The eye diagram for an 80-Gb/s data is characterized at 1.3 TS/s sampling rate using a 5-GHz oscilloscope.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration on phase-erased demodulation for RZ-DPSK/CSRZ-DPSK signals and ODB/AMI-to-RZ format conversion
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report 40 Gbit/s phase-erased demodulation for RZ-DPSK/CSRZ-DPSK signals by exploiting cascaded second-order nonlinearities in a periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) waveguide. All-optical 40 Gbit/s ODB/AMI-to-RZ format conversion is also demonstrated in the experiment.

articleTitle: Temporal differentiation of optical signals based on polarization coupling and filtering
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose an all-optical differentiation scheme based on polarization coupling and filtering while perform it well at 12.5 Gb/s with error ∽0.07, which is applicable to high-speed optical signal processing at 40 Gb/s and above.

articleTitle: 620 mW single-frequency Nd:YVO4/BiB3O6 red laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a type-I critically phase-matched bismuth borate crystal, a record 620 mW single-frequency red laser at 671 nm is achieved from intra-cavity SHG of a pi-polarized single-end pumped Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> ring laser oscillating on the lambda~1342 nm transition.

articleTitle: Imaging plasmonic nanoparticles with a narrow-band single-photon source
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on interferometric imaging of single gold nanoparticles using narrow-band single photons resonant with the particle plasmon resonance.

articleTitle: Optical sum-frequency generation and Ferroelectric-like switching in Si-O polar structures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical sum-frequency generation and ferroelectric-like switching in Si-O polar structures comprised of Si nanocrystals (nc-Si) in mesoporous silica was reported and attributed to polar layers lying at the interfaces between one-side bounded nc-Si and host.

articleTitle: Enhancement of intra-tissue refractive index shaping (IRIS) of the cornea by two-photon absorption
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nanojoule femtosecond laser pulses were used to modify the refractive index of living corneas. By doping with Sodium Fluorescein to increase two-photon absorption, laser scanning speed could be greatly increased while inducing large RI modifications.

articleTitle: Entanglement distillation of two-photon polarization qubits using tunable local filters
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A tunable entanglement distiller for arbitrary two-photon polarization qubits is demonstrated using novel tunable local filters constructed with rotatable birefringent prisms. The distillation is confirmed by comparing the concurrences of the two-photon states.

articleTitle: Relaxation-oscillation-free continuous-wave optical parametric oscillator pumped internal to a semiconductor Disk Laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a continuous-wave optical parametric oscillator operated within a semiconductor disk laser, free of relaxation oscillations associated with neodymium-based systems. Parametric threshold occurred at 1.4 W primary (diode) pump power and 8.5 W yielded 205 mW idler.

articleTitle: Transient response in optical ENZ nanocircuit boards
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using analytical and numerical methods, we analyze the temporal response of optical nanocircuit boards formed by grooves in epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) metamaterial substrates. We discuss bandwidth, group velocity and signal delay in such ENZ-surrounded channels.

articleTitle: Plasmonic nano-cavities with high Q-factors
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report plasmonic Fabry-Perot nano-cavities formed by high aspect ratio metal mirrors on a metal surface. Quality factors from 100-200 were obtained, limited by plasmonic losses and fin scattering at short and long wavelengths respectively.

articleTitle: Bias-controlled coherent acoustic phonon generation in InGaN/GaN multiple-quantum-wells light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the control of coherent acoustic phonon generation by applying voltage across InGaN/GaN multiple-quantum-wells light emitting diodes (LEDs). The acoustic phonons oscillation can be switched off by increasing the reverse bias up to -25 V.

articleTitle: Directly measuring the spatiotemporal electric field of ultrashort Bessel-X pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using SEA TADPOLE with mum-range spatial and fs-range temporal resolution, we report the first direct spatiotemporal measurements of ultrashort Bessel-X pulses. We demonstrate their propagation invariance and superluminal velocity and verify our results with simulations.

articleTitle: Contrast enhancement of UV absorption and improved biochip imaging
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Biochip using UV absorption for selective DNA or proteins imaging may take advantage of sensitivity enhancement thanks to either multilayer structures or grating structures. We discuss the interest of coupled angular and spectral illumination.

articleTitle: Spatial and temporal interferences between four-wave mixing and six-wave mixing channels
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spatial and temporal interferences between four-wave mixing and six-wave mixing signals are observed by using phase-control between these nonlinear optical processes in a four-level atomic system. Atomic coherence is the key to observe such phenomenon.

articleTitle: High-density optical interconnect based on TIR and metal coated precise mirror attached waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a high density optical interconnect based on the TIR type and the metal coated type precise mirror attached waveguide on a printed circuit board. The structure and performance of 12-channel transmitter and receiver operating at 8-10 Gbps are presented.

articleTitle: Nonlinear light propagation in fractal waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study nonlinear beam propagation in a fractal waveguide array, created by optically-inducing nested periodic arrays in a self-defocusing photorefractive crystal. Nonlinear mode coupling and energy transport between the folded bands is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Tabletop coherent diffractive microscopy with soft x-rays from high harmonic generation at 13.5 nm
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate lensless diffractive microscopy with 92 nm resolution using 13.5 nm light from high harmonic generation. Fast image retrieval with Fourier transform holography is shown, and we present paths to refining the images to higher resolution.

articleTitle: Dual femtosecond laser based multiheterodyne low coherence interferometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a high-speed, high-resolution, non-mechanical time-domain method for low coherence interferometry, utilizing multiheterodyne detection via two mode-locked femtosecond lasers. Tomographic depth sensing over 150 mm with 5.9 kHz scanning rates and 8 mum depth resolution is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Simulations of all-optical packet switching with all-optical header processing using Fabry-Perot laser diodes at 10 Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-optical packet switching with all optical heading processing using one and two Fabry-Perot laser diodes are studied numerically. Both the header and data rates are at 10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Multiple scattering of light in three-dimensional photonic quasicrystals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Three-dimensional icosahedral dielectric photonic quasicrystals previously revealed highly structured transmittance spectra and unusual photon transport properties. Using a periodic approximant approach, we show that all these findings are consistent with multiple scattering of light.

articleTitle: High density spectral fringe analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Interpolation to an evenly spaced frequency domain is shown to introduce errors in phase retrieval from spectral interferograms with dense fringes. A simple method for performing phase retrieval without interpolation is presented.

Author Keywords: (120.2650) Instrumentation, measurement and metrology : Fringe analysis

articleTitle: Wavelength transparent and power level tolerant all-optical packet envelope detection circuit for packet switched networks applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We performed extensive characterization of all-optical packet envelope detection circuit for ultra-fast packet switched networks. Correct operation with RZ-format data pulses is experimentally demonstrated over a broad range of input packets' wavelengths and power levels.

articleTitle: A multi-TW few-cycle optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the generation of 8 fs, 125 mJ pulses in a noncollinear optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier with a temporal contrast reaching 10 orders of magnitude at 5 ps before the main pulse.

articleTitle: The role of native and transient laser-induced defects in the femtosecond breakdown of dielectric films
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experiments and modeling reveal that the dielectric breakdown of hafnia films is controlled by laser induced and native defects under multiple femtosecond pulse exposure. Transient processes occur on a 100 ps and 10 ms timescale.

articleTitle: Periodic index-modulated plasma waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a wire-obstructed cluster flow technique for making periodically modulated plasma waveguides in hydrogen, nitrogen, and argon with sharp, stable voids as short as 50 mum with a period as small as 200 mum.

articleTitle: Coherent control of shift currents in GaAs using chirped optical pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate coherent control of shift currents in GaAs by adjusting the relative phase between two orthogonally polarized, chirped optical pulses. The novel technique allows us to control the shape of the generated current transients.

Author Keywords: 320.7130 Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Submicron diameter micropillar cavities with high quality factor and ultra-small mode volume
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically demonstrated high quality factor (Q∼250,000) micropillar cavities with record low mode volume for a 340nm diameter titania/silica micropillar. It represents a three orders of magnitude Q/V enhancement compared to any previous micropillar cavities.

articleTitle: Nanosecond THz-OPO with a Novel QPM Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A nanosecond OPO pumped by a Q-switched Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser for terahertz generation in periodically poled lithium niobate with a new pattern is presented. Characteristic properties of the OPO including cascaded processes are discussed.

articleTitle: High-frequency active metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a systematic numerical study of metamaterials integrated with gain media to achieve composite metamaterials at terahertz and infrared wavelength with reduced losses. The impact of spatial dispersion on the effective permeability resonance restoration is emphasized.

Author Keywords: 03. Fundamentals of Metamaterials, Periodic and Random Media

articleTitle: Short wavelength distributed feedback quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a lateral grating, distributed feedback quantum cascade (QC) laser operating at 3.45 mum with the intended application of trace gas detection. It is the shortest wavelength, single mode QC laser.

articleTitle: Photon management in thin film solar cells
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We analyze the absorption enhancement in single and tandem solar-cells comprising nanostructures that increase the path of the photons inside the solar cell. For this purpose we exploit different physical phenomena in different material systems.

articleTitle: Observation of clamping of photoluminescence intensities from nonlinear degenerate electron gas in InN
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed that photoluminescence intensities clamped at certain values as the pump intensity was increased, due to the presence of nonlinear degenerate electron gas and saturation of photogenerated and localized holes in InN.

articleTitle: Tight focal spot and long depth of focus by radially polarized, narrow-width annular beams from photonic-crystal lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We found that tighter focal spots with longer depths of focus are achieved by radially polarized annular beams with controlled inner and outer radii, which could lead to high-tolerance, super-resolution applications in compact optical systems.

articleTitle: Coherent metamaterials from “optical ferromagnetism” to the lasing spaser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce a new class of coherent metamaterials where regular ensembles of meta-molecules show collective, coherent narrow-band response leading to unusual electromagnetic properties and potential applications in the lasing spaser.

articleTitle: Self-referenced spectral interferometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new femtosecond pulses characterization method is presented and experimentally demonstrated. Linear spectral interferometry becomes a self-referenced measurement by the self-creation of a reference pulse using pulse shaping optimization and non linear temporal filtering.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared atomic and molecular Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy emissions from solid substances
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The mid-infrared emission from laser-induced-breakdown processes on solid substances between 2-5.75 mum was probed. Atomic emission features from neutral atomic fragments and molecular emission features from partially dissociated molecular fragments have been successfully identified.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal cavities for sensing: Dielectric modes versus air modes
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Effective sensing with photonic crystal cavities requires optimization of modal quality factor and field overlap. For several unrelated cavities, we find the quality factor dominates, so that dielectric modes are strongly favored over air modes.

articleTitle: Deterministic phase-control and resonance-detuning in optical EIT-like coupled resonances towards dynamical storage of light
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report first observations of deterministic phase- and resonance-controlled all-optical analogue to electromagnetically induced transparency in coherently-coupled silicon photonic crystal nanocavities through thermo-optic tuning method, for realization of all-optical dynamical storage of light.

articleTitle: Tuning giant birefringence in multi-slot silicon optical waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally study the variation of giant modal birefringence in multi-slotted silicon nanophotonic waveguides, comprised of four air slots etched longitudinally along the waveguide, for different low index filling fractions. We compare experimental observations with the predictions of an analytically derived effective-medium theory, and FDFD numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Pump combiner for air-clad fiber with PM single-mode signal feed-through
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A pump combiner with single-mode PM signal feed-through designed for an air-clad photonic crystal fiber is demonstrated. Signal coupling is realized by a novel taper element allowing single-mode guidance at a taper ratio of 3.7.

articleTitle: Spatial wavelength-tunable emission between 350 nm and 715 nm from nanowires on a single substrate
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate extremely widely wavelength-tunable emissions from a single substrate of nanowires from 350 nm to 715 nm. This unprecedented tuning range is achieved by a novel method of controlling spatial alloy composition grading.

articleTitle: Mesoscopic imaging using multi spectral optoacoustic tomography (MSOT)
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The talk describes next generation high-resolution photonic tissue imaging that goes beyond the penetration limit of optical microscopy.

articleTitle: Observation of two-dimensional quasi-localized solitons with saddle-shaped diffraction and hybrid nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first demonstration of 2D quasi-localized solitons near a saddle point of diffraction surfaces. These solitons arise from a balance between saddle-shaped diffraction and hybrid nonlinearity in optically-induced ionic-type photonic lattices.

articleTitle: Fabrication of three-dimensional photonic crystal template using two-layer integrated phase mask
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper, we report a new design and fabrication of an integrated two-layer phase mask for five-beam holographic fabrication of three-dimensional photonic crystal templates.

articleTitle: Full characterization of femtosecond pulses at 1225–1350 nm produced by a high power fiber optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a fiber optical parametric oscillator operating at 1225 to 1350 nm in wavelength with 100 mW of average power. Characterization using SHG-FROG reveals linearly-chirped compressible pulses with duration of 250 fs.

Author Keywords: (060.4005) Fiber optics and optical communications: Microstructured fibers
(190.4970) Nonlinear optics: Parametric oscillators and amplifiers

articleTitle: Filament assisted third harmonic generation at interface
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Filament assisted third harmonic generation is studied at interface. The third harmonic energy induced by the filament crossing the rear surface keeps constant because of intensity clamping during filamentation.

articleTitle: Mode structure of large mode area all-solid photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We analyze optical properties of all-silica photonic bandgap fibers with an ultra low ratio of the cladding rods diameter to the center-to-center distance of the rods. Optical properties similar to those of LMA holey fibers are revealed both numerically and experimentally.

articleTitle: Phononic metamaterials with negative dynamic mass density
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dynamic mass density of a composite can differ from its static counterpart when there are relative motions between the components. Realizations of negative dynamic mass density composites and their theoretical underpinnings will be presented.

articleTitle: Application of quasiperiodic and random quasi-phase-matching to high-harmonic-generation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The utility of quasiperiodic and random quasi-phase matching is demonstrated theoretically for shaping the spectral emission of high harmonic generation. Demonstrated are simultaneous enhancement of arbitrary spectral regions and enhancement of an extremely wide bandwidth.

articleTitle: 100× frequency magnification using a time-lens-based spectral imaging system
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate frequency magnification by a factor of 105 using a spectral imaging system with two four-wave mixing based time-lenses. We achieve a 1-GHz frequency resolution.

articleTitle: Sub-diffraction limited CARS microscopy— A theoretical investigation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The possibility of obtaining sub-diffraction limited spatial resolution with label-free imaging, based on coherent anti-Stokes Raman (CARS) microscopy, is investigated numerically. Like STED, CARS emission is strongly suppressed by applying an additional light field.

articleTitle: Routing light with nematicons: Light localization and steering in liquid crystals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Liquid crystals in the nematic phase support light self-confinement via reorientational nonlinearity and nonlocality, yielding robust spatial solitons which can trap, switch and route optical signals. We review the major achievements in the field.

articleTitle: Terahertz-wave detection using an organic DAST crystal covering ultra-wide frequency-range at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Rapidly responding, high-sensitivity terahertz (THz)-wave detection with an organic DAST crystal was demonstrated using nonlinear frequency up-conversion to near-infrared light. Detection of THz-wave signals from 16.4-THz to 26.3-THz was achieved at room temperature.

articleTitle: Dispersionless saturable absorber mirrors for ultrashort pulse generation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Theoretical and experimental results are presented for the potential to eliminate group delay dispersion of resonant SESAMs over broad spectral bandwidths through the design of a single dielectric cap layer of carefully selected refractive index.

articleTitle: Optofluidic Bragg grating sensor for monolayer detection
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An exposed Bragg grating incorporated into a planar waveguide was used to form a refractive index sensor. The high sensitivity to subtle changes allowed the study of surface functionalisation and binding within a microfluidic system.

articleTitle: Characterizing isolated attosecond pulses from a hollow-core waveguide using multi-cycle driving pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We temporally characterize 200 attosecond FWHM pulses created by high harmonic generation of 15 femtosecond pulses. Simulations of the interferometric two-color crosscorrelation data and an iterative algorithm were used to extract the pulse duration.

articleTitle: High repetition rate diode pumped CPA thin disk laser of the Joule class
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An Yb:YAG diode pumped CPA laser system based on thin disk technology has been set up. The system works at 100 Hz repetition rate emitting 1 ps pulses with several hundred mJ energy. Scalability allows upgrade to the Joule level.

articleTitle: Fluorescence monitoring of microchip capillary electrophoresis separation with monolithically integrated optical waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond-laser-written waveguides were integrated with fluidic microchannels in a commercial lab-on-a-chip. High-spatial-resolution monitoring of fluorescently labeled DNA molecules during capillary electrophoresis separation is demonstrated, as an intermediate step toward point-of-care diagnostic bioassays for DNA analysis.

articleTitle: Efficient generation of entangled photon pairs from a single quantum dot embedded in a photonic crystal cavity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a formal theory of single quantum-dot coupling to a planar photonic crystal that supports quasi-degenerate cavity modes, and use this theory to describe, and optimize, entangled-photon-pair generation via the biexciton-exciton cascade.

articleTitle: Excitons in the family: Working with Daniel Chemla
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Daniel Chemla was an inspirational scientist, natural mentor and visionary leader. I share my experiences working with Daniel and others at Bell Labs from 1984 through the 1990s on "all excitons all the time."

articleTitle: Fiber-optic multiphoton in vivo flow cytometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the use of a double-clad fiber probe to conduct two-photon excited flow cytometry in a live mouse. High detection efficiency of GFP-expressing cells is demonstrated, and the initial dynamics of injected circulating cells is observed.

articleTitle: Silicon microring based elastic polarization converter
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We designed a silicon microring based elastic polarization converter, which can realize arbitrary polarization conversion between any two of linear, circular, and elliptic polarization states. Simulation results show good polarization converting characteristics at resonance condition.

articleTitle: Coherent lattice vibrations in small diameter single-walled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on coherent phonon oscillations of non-resonantly excited RBMs at the excitation as high as 300 meV above the E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> transition level for (6, 5) and (7, 3) tubes in isolated CoMoCAT SWNTs.

articleTitle: Polarization dependence of photo-ionization in glasses and applications to direct-write photonics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Waveguides were written in glass using the femtosecond laser direct-write technique. The refractive index changes induced were found to be polarization dependent. We propose that photo-ionization rates are the origin of this polarization dependence.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Mode-locked thulium-doped fiber laser with carbon nanotube saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report mode-locking of an all-fiber thulium/holmium (Tm/Ho) co-doped laser with a saturable absorber based on a fiber taper embedded in carbon nanotube/polymer composite (FTCNTPC). 750 fs soliton pulses are generated at wavelength around 1890 nm.

articleTitle: Fourier domain pump-probe Optical Coherence Tomography imaging of melanin
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first molecular image of melanin using a novel extension of OCT, pump-probe OCT. Melanin, an abundant endogenous chromophore, could provide general contrast in OCT imaging and means to diagnose and/or monitor melanomas.

articleTitle: Optical control of photon-pair entanglement from a semiconductor quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that polarization-entangled photon pairs can be obtained deterministically from a semiconductor quantum dot by optically tuning the fine-structure split exciton states into degeneracy.

articleTitle: Observing angular deviations in specular reflection of light
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measure the direction of a TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> Gaussian beam reflected from an air-glass interface. We report experimental evidence of an angular deviation of the beam axis from the Reflection Law for a light ray.

articleTitle: AlGaN/GaN plasmon-resonant terahertz detectors with on-chip patch antennas
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate room temperature terahertz detection by AlGaN/GaN heterojunction field effect transistors (HFETs) integrated with an on-chip microstrip patch antenna. Polarization dependent photoresponse is observed in accordance with the design of the antenna.

articleTitle: Concurrent optical coherence tomography and line-scanning laminar optical tomography
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a hybrid optical tomography system combing optical coherence tomography (OCT) and line-scanning fluorescence laminar optical tomography (FLOT). This system could be used for concurrent depth-resolved tissue-structural and molecular imaging.

articleTitle: Single longitudinal mode, 3 MHz frequency stable, 11mJ, type II doubly resonant OPO/OPA for CO2 DIAL
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: For CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> differential-absorption LIDAR, the single-mode output of a type-II PPLN entangled-cavity nanosecond doubly-resonant OPO emitting at 2.05 mum is amplified to 11 mJ, with 3 MHz rms frequency stability and a M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> < 1.9.

articleTitle: External modulation of Terahertz Quantum Cascade Lasers using electrically-driven active metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
