abstract: We demonstrate a tunable filter based on an array of silicon-on-insulator microring resonators. The resonance wavelength, extinction ratio and bandwidth can be simultaneously controlled by thermal tuning.

articleTitle: Femtosecond nonlinear optics with a single nanoantenna
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Second and third harmonic emission from a single optical antenna is observed when excited with 8-fs laser pulses. Nonlinear emission mapping and direct measurements of the plasmon dephasing time of single nanoantennas are performed.

articleTitle: Electro-optic modulation in high-efficiency crystalline OH1 optical waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a novel organic thin-film crystal OH1 with high electro-optic figure of merit n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>r = 530 pm/V at 1319 nm, suitable for high-speed electro-optic modulation and hybrid integration with glass or silicon-on-insulator.

articleTitle: High order harmonic generation with enhanced near-field by localized surface plasmon
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a novel method that requires no extra cavities in high harmonic generation with the aid of localized surface plasmon. The harmonics up to 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> was observed by injection with gases onto gold nanostructures.

articleTitle: Photonic metamaterials by direct laser writing
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a planar magnetic metamaterial fabricated using 3D direct laser writing and silver chemical vapor deposition as well as a negative-index bi-anisotropic metamaterial metallized via silver shadow evaporation. Calculations and experiments show good agreement.

articleTitle: Staged laser ion acceleration
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report experimental results proving the possibility to use laser-driven ion acceleration in an additive manner. The observed proton spectra show well-defined characteristic modulations and this process was found to work extremely stable and controllable.

articleTitle: Observation of degenerate and non-degenerate lateral-mode patterns in mid-IR Quantum Cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate near-field lateral mode patterns of quantum cascade wide-ridge lasers using a spatially-resolving spectrometer. The results support box-model theory and, show that lateral mode pattern can be made either degenerate or non-degenerate in frequency.

articleTitle: All planar integration of high-Q, Er-doped silicon-rich silicon nitride microdisk with SU-8 waveguide for on-chip, Si-based light source
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-planar integration of a light source with coupling waveguide on a Si chip is achieved using high-Q, Er doped silicon-rich silicon nitride (SRSN) microdisks and SU-8 waveguide. As-fabricated microdisks show Q-factors of 1–1.5×104 for both TE- and TM-like modes. Upon integration with single-mode SU-8 waveguide and clad with a polymer layer, Q-factor decreases to 5,000 for the TE-like mode, and 1,000 for TM-like mode. We obtain sharp Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> WGM emission coupled into the waveguide when the disk is pumped 1470 nm LD, indicating the promise of SRN:Er for compact, integrated Si- based light source.

articleTitle: Dynamic of the optical matrix element in type II GaAsSb/GaAs quantum dots for laser applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present time resolved photoluminescence supported by k⋅p modeling of type II quantum dots. In the measured spectra two effects were observed; an initially fast decay time rises dramatically as the number of carriers is depleted, which reduces the optical matrix element, and at the same time, a strong red shift of the emission wavelength is observed.

articleTitle: Precision spectroscopy with a scanning diode laser and measurement of microcavity dispersion
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a simple method that enables fast, broadband spectroscopy at sub-Megahertz resolution over >4 THz bandwidth using a mode-hop-free tunable diode laser and a frequency comb. This scheme is utilized to measure microresonator dispersion.

articleTitle: 3D fluorescent particle tracking with nanometer scale accuracies using a double-helix point spread function
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate parallel three-dimensional (3D) tracking of multiple fluorescent microspheres with nanometer scale accuracies by engineering the 3D point spread function of a wide-field microscope to present a double-helix along the optical axis.

articleTitle: Megabit per second quantum key distribution using practical InGaAs APDs
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first gigahertz clocked decoy-protocol quantum key distribution (QKD) system, with a record secure key rate of 1.02 Mbit/s over a fiber distance of 20 km and 10.1 kbit/s over 100 km.

articleTitle: Cavity solitons in a vertical cavity semiconductor optical amplifier: From single to cluster states
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimental results on the formation and control of single and cluster states of cavity solitons in a vertical cavity semiconductor optical amplifier. A parameter region where cluster states are inhibited is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Space qualification of solid state lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: General design principles for developing space based diode pumped solid state laser systems will be presented. Major issues affecting the design, development, system engineering, ground testing, operational simplicity and long term reliability will be discussed.

articleTitle: Controlling the speed of light in semiconductor waveguides: Physics and applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We review the physics of slow and fast light effects in semiconductor optical waveguides. Recent experimental and theoretical results on enhancing the phase shift using optical filtering are presented and applications in microwave photonics are discussed.

articleTitle: Monitoring electron spin decoherence in correlations of sequential weak measurement by Faraday rotation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show in theory that the electron spin decoherence, excluding the inhomogeneous broadening effect, can be seen in the third-order correlation function of sequential weak quantum measurement by Faraday rotation.

articleTitle: Quantum teleportation of wavepackets in a non-Gaussian state
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate quantum teleportation of wavepackets in a non-Gaussian state, so-called “Schrödinger kitten”, for the first time.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation by electro-poling in femtosecond laser induced micro-structured silver containing glass
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Laser structuring and electro-poling has been carried out in silver containing glasses. The second-order NLO response after direct laser patterning has been investigated in the scope of developing further practical use of the material.

articleTitle: The effect of pump-pump four-wave mixing on gain of two-pump phase sensitive optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Based on coupled-mode equations, we develop a pump interaction model for two-pump phase sensitive optical amplifiers. This model takes dominant pump-pump and signal-pump four-wave mixing sidebands into account, and can be used to determine the optimal wavelength separation when amplifiers' parameters such as pump power, fiber nonlinearity coefficient, length, and dispersion profile are given.

articleTitle: Dispersion engineered higher-order mode fibers for wavelength-tunable femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate tuning of the output spectrum of an HOM fiber module by changing the dispersion curve. Spectral feature wavelengths can be changed systematically by changing the location of the zero-dispersion wavelength.

articleTitle: Stimulated stokes and anti-stokes Raman scattering processes of coherent G-mode vibrations in single-walled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent G-mode vibrations in SWNTs were studied with spectrum-resolved pump-probe experiments. Detection wavelength dependence of G-mode amplitude was explained by SARS and SSRS. We could drive one process by controlling the dispersion of ultrashort pulses.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Tunable delay of entangled images
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that non-degenerate four-wave mixing in an atomic vapor can be used as a quantum delay line for multi-spatial-mode twin beams. This makes it possible to delay continuous variable entangled images without significant degradation.

articleTitle: GaAs-based transverse junction superluminescent diode at 1.1um wavelength region
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report GaAs-based transverse-junction-superluminescent-diodes, characterized as transverse-carrier-flow spread in quantum wells horizontally instead of vertical well-by-well injection. These devices overcome the problem of non-uniform-carrier-distribution and operate at a bio-optical window of 1.1-µm wavelength regime.

articleTitle: Electro-optic sampling of widely tunable THz transients with electric fields of up to 108 MV/cm
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel Er:fiber/Ti:sapphire hybrid laser generates phase-locked few-cycle terahertz transients tunable from 1 to 107 THz and electric fields of up to 108 MV/cm. 8-fs pulses from the fiber laser serve as electro-optic probe.

articleTitle: Enhancement in electron injection and transport of organic light emitting diodes using MnO
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An insulator MnO as an electron injecting and transporting material introduced into organic light-emitting diodes to increase electroluminescence efficiency also can eliminate the problem of the oxidation of reactive dopants to improve stability of devices.

articleTitle: Design of a sub 100-femtosecond x-ray streak camera
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The temporal resolution of existing streak cameras are limited by electron transit time dispersion. Here we present a state-of-art design compensating this to achieve a breakthrough of 100 fs time resolution.

articleTitle: Ultrafast hydrogen migration in hydrocarbon molecules in ultrafast intense laser fields
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrafast hydrogen migration processes within hydrocarbon molecules in ultrashort intense laser fields were investigated by detecting the fragment ions generated through the two-body and three-body Coulomb explosion pathways using the coincidence momentum imaging method.

articleTitle: Microfabricated out-of-plane scanning microlens for Raman Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a microfabricated out-of-plane scanning microlens for miniaturized Raman Spectroscopy. The out-of-plane actuation is electrostatic driven and achieves 90 mum scan range at 1 k Hz. A Raman spectrum analysis on drug, Tylenol, is reported.

articleTitle: AMO experiments at the LCLS X-ray laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This tutorial will explore the opportunities for novel AMO Physics at X-ray Free Electron Lasers such as LCLS, which begins operations in 2009.

articleTitle: Emission enhancement and redistribution via Bloch Surface Waves
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a strong enhancement and intensity redistribution of dipole emission by a Bloch Surface Wave at the surface of a periodic silicon nitrite multi-layer.

articleTitle: Multi-stage optimization of ultrabroadband high-energy optical parametric chirped pulse amplification
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a procedure for simultaneous optimization of efficiency-bandwidth product and superfluorescence noise suppression in ultrabroadband high-energy optical parametric chirped pulse amplification. Gain dependence of parameters makes stage-by-stage signal chirp optimization necessary in multi-stage amplification.

articleTitle: Optical coupling of nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to GaP waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this work NV coupling to GaP waveguides on a diamond surface is demonstrated. The NV-waveguide coupling strength and waveguide loss are measured. This approach may be useful for NV-based quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Functional measurement of biological parts
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a parts perspective using biological components to form complex systems and discuss: connectivity, network formation, and motility. Challenges associated with characterization and assembly are discussed relative to assay development and instrumentation advances.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh time resolution nonlinear spectroscopy of polymer/fullerene blends
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report ultrafast nonlinear spectra of polymer/fullerene blends measured with unprecedented 10-fs-time resolution. Our results suggest that an extremely fast exciton transport from the optically excited polymer to the fullerene acceptor precedes charge separation.

articleTitle: Uni-traveling carrier phototransistor
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a novel phototransistor using uni-traveling carrier photodiode structure in base and collector layer and obtained RF optical gain of 29dB at 1GHz and 9dB at 20GHz in 10µm by 10µm optical window device.

articleTitle: Self-referencing of optical frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel technique that allows for intrinsic stabilization of an optical frequency comb to zero offset. This method greatly simplifies carrier-envelope phase control and experiments in extreme nonlinear optics.

articleTitle: Coupled carrier-phonon dynamics in light emitting quantum-dot heterostructures: switch on dynamics and carrier heating
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Microscopic calculations of the dynamics of electrically injected carriers, coupled to LO-phonons in Stranski-Krastanov-grown quantum-dot-emitters are presented. Even though the phonon distribution remains in equilibrium, a substantial carrier heating occurs.

articleTitle: Quantum path interferences in high-harmonic generation: Ionization effects and spatial structure
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the influence of microscopic and macroscopic ionization effects on the intensity-dependent quantum-path interferences in high-harmonic generation. The resulting interference structures were analyzed in different gases and in spatially resolved harmonic spectra.

articleTitle: Internal quantum efficiency and non-radiative recombination coefficient of GaInN/GaN multiple quantum wells with different dislocation densities
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Room-temperature photoluminescence measurements are performed on GaInN/GaN multiple quantum wells grown on GaN-on-sapphire templates with different threading-dislocation densities. The internal quantum efficiencies as a function of carrier concentration and the non-radiative coefficients are obtained.

articleTitle: Origin of non radiative recombination in GaInNAsSb/GaNAs quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We quantify contributions to threshold-current in state-of-the-art 1.55 mum GaInNAsSb lasers and the affect of layer design and nitrogen level. Non-radiative current is independent of nitrogen content (3.0-3.3%) but linked to the GaNAs barriers.

articleTitle: Atmospheric absorption spectroscopy using supercontinuum lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A supercontinuum absorption spectroscopy (SAS) approach for measurement of atmospheric constituents is extended to offer increased capability of detecting concentrations of gaseous species. An atmospheric path length greater than 600 m is utilized in the multi-wavelength differential absorption setup. A multi-wavelength algorithm for analysis of the spectra measurements obtained from the return of the supercontinuum source is used to determine the concentrations of species, with comparison to MODTRANtrade 5 simulation spectra. Further developments to the SAS approach and measurements are presented.

articleTitle: Generation of high-energy sub-20-fs DUV pulses in noble-gas-filled hollow fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Generation of high-energy sub-20-fs DUV pulses is reported by compression of 248.5 nm pulses in noble-gas-filled hollow fibers. Bandwidths of 7 nm and 10 nm with energies of 0.45 mJ and 0.25 mJ were achieved in helium and neon, respectively.

articleTitle: Efficient ultrafast ultraviolet generation based on frequency-doubling in short-period periodically-poled KTiOPO4
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We efficiently generated ultrafast coherent ultraviolet radiation based on second harmonic generation in periodically-poled KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> with the shortest period of 2.55 mum. The highest output power was measured to be 20.1 mW at 377.1 nm.

articleTitle: Broadband and high power monocycle terahertz pulse generation by χ(2) cascaded processes in LiNbO3
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a novel technique for the generation of high power monocycle terahertz pulse beyond the excitation pulse width limitation. Optical pulse may get modulated by emitted intense THz electric field. This causes excitation pulse compression and consequently gives rise to the enhancement of generation efficiency and its bandwidth. We experimentally demonstrate this chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> cascaded processes using tilted wavefront excitation beam by LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> from Ti:Sapphire and Yb doped fiber laser.

articleTitle: Room temperature degenerate four-wave mixing due to ultrafast radiative decay of confined excitons
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Degenerate four-wave mixing spectrum and the temperature dependence are investigated in a CuCl thin film with high crystalline quality. The signal at room temperature is firstly observed.

articleTitle: Tailored soliton statistics in supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Stochastic simulation of supercontinuum generation in fiber with two zero dispersion wavelengths reveals that the long wavelength soliton probability distribution can be tailored to have Gaussian, uniform, or rogue wave characteristics depending on initial energy.

articleTitle: Ultrashort optical pulse propagation in metal nanoparticle covered dielectric surfaces
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We characterize the behavior of optical pulse propagation in surfaces covered with silver metal nanoparticles and quantify the dispersion introduced as the pulse propagates.

articleTitle: Terahertz absorption in non-polar, non-hydrogen-bonding liquids
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present results from our investigation into the liquid-lattice structures of n-pentane (C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>) through n-hexadecane (C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">34</sub>). We observe alternating absorption values, at single frequencies, which are surprising and provide information about long-range correlations in liquids.

articleTitle: Accessible light bullets
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel type of stable (3+1)D solitary self-trapped wave-packet arising from the interplay between local and nonlocal (in time and space) nonlinearities, which can be generated under experimentally feasible conditions.

articleTitle: Sequential time-bin entanglement generation using periodically poled KTP waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated non-degenerate sequential time-bin entanglement using periodically poled KTP waveguide at a repetition rate of 1 GHz. The wavelengths of signal and idler are 895 and 1310 nm. The two-photon-interference-fringe visibility is 79%.

articleTitle: Gigabit/s modulation of twin-electrode high-brightness tapered laser with high modulation efficiency
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Simultaneous high modulation speed and high modulation efficiency operation of a two-electrode tapered laser is reported. 1Gb/s direct data modulation is achieved with 68mA applied current swing for a 0.95W output optical modulation amplitude.

articleTitle: Vapor deposited small molecules as an organic nonlinear optical cladding for silicon on insulator technology
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon-organic hybrid waveguide fabricated by vapor deposition of a small molecule with a large third-order nonlinearity on a silicon-on-oxide slotted waveguide. The resulting organic cladding has a high third-order susceptibility, high optical quality, and it homogenously fills the slot where the optical mode propagates.

articleTitle: Sideband opto-mechanical cooling of a silica microresonator in a cryogenic environment
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Sideband opto-mechanical cooling of vibrational modes in a silica microresonator is demonstrated in a cryogenic environment. Average phonon occupation numbers as low as 25 are obtained for mechanical modes with frequencies near 100 MHz.

articleTitle: Improved bulk-heterojunction polymer solar cells with paraphenylenevinylene and fullerene
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report bulk-heterojunction solar cells consisting of poly [2-methoxy, 5 ethyl (2' hexyloxy) paraphenylenevinylene] (MEH-PPV) as a donor and [6,6]-phenyl-C61-butyric acid methyl ester (PCBM) as an acceptor with improved performance after optimization of device parameters.

articleTitle: Near-field imaging of coupled surface-wave layers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coupled Multi-layered surfaces are presented to manipulate evanescent fields and offer subwavelength near-field imaging. Positive and negative interfaces alternation will successfully tailor the poles of surface waves, resulting in superior electromagnetic-optical characteristics.

articleTitle: Comparative study of pump-induced refractive index changes in aluminum and phosphate silicate Yb-doped fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The influence of fiber glass composition on dynamics of pump-induced refractive index changes in Yb-doped silicate fibers is reported. The Yb-ions polarizability difference responsible for the effect is determined for fibers with different Yb-ion lifetimes.

articleTitle: Terahertz waveguide emitters with subwavelength confinement
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The generation of terahertz radiation within subwavelength waveguides is studied in time- and frequency-domain. Such waveguide emitters enable the efficient launching of terahertz waves within compact terahertz optical systems.

articleTitle: All-fiber Raman lasers with highly nonlinear photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Writing Bragg gratings inside the core of a photonic crystal fiber (PCF), we demonstrate an all-fiber Raman laser fully made with a highly nonlinear PCF. The laser delivers an output power of 4 Watt.

articleTitle: Measuring particle size distributions via the polarization dependence of second harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a method to determine particle size distributions in powders, based on the polarization dependent second harmonic generation (SHG). Unlike existing methods, dilution is not required and is largely insensitive to the optical alignment.

articleTitle: Coherent mid-infrared broadband generation in non-uniform ZBLAN fiber taper
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe and numerically demonstrate asymmetric coherent continuum generation in mid-infrared by a fundamental soliton propagating in non-uniform fiber taper via dispersive wave emission in a stabilized regime near continuously shifting second dispersion zero.

articleTitle: Terahertz imaging of aircraft composites
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Damaged aircraft composites were prepared simulating voids, delaminations, puncture holes, burns and paint removal. Terahertz time domain spectroscopy in reflection configuration was assessed as a non-destructive evaluation (NDE) technique and compared to traditional NDE techniques.

articleTitle: High efficiency THz pulse generation in new stilbazolium salts
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The THz generation efficiency in two new stilbazolium salts pumped by laser sources at telecommunication wavelengths is increased compared to DAST, the benchmark material for this application.

articleTitle: Optical time-domain measurement of Brillouin dynamic grating spectrum in a polarization maintaining fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the distributed measurement of Brillouin dynamic grating spectrum in a polarization maintaining fiber based on time-domain analysis. By synchronized propagation of the pump and the probe pulses, the local spectrum of Brillouin dynamic grating is acquired together with the local Brillouin gain spectrum in a single experimental setup. The temperature sensitivity as high as -370 MHz/degC is observed with a spatial resolution of 1.5 m.

articleTitle: Variable ratio power splitters using computer-generated planar holograms on 2×2 multimode interference couplers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Variable ratio power splitters using computer-generated planar holograms on 2times2 multimode interference (MMI) couplers are presented. The coherent wave at the device input is transformed to the desired output using computer-generated refractive index perturbations on multimode channel waveguides at half the beat length. Devices are fabricated on the silicon-on-insulator platform and characterized at the wavelength of 1.55 mum. We demonstrate different splitting ratios by changing the hologram etch depth and the hologram length.

articleTitle: Compact gas sensing system based on mid-infrared LED and resonant detection with quartz tuning fork
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A Winston cone is used to concentrate the emitted radiation of a mid-infrared LED onto a small spot on the side of one prong of a quartz tuning fork acting as a detector. The Winston cone is used as an absorption cell as well, thus providing a very compact and cost efficient mid-infrared sensing system.

articleTitle: Multiexcitons in colloidal semiconductor nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The study of multiexcitons in colloidal quantum dots (CQDs) is a timely topic, as these multiexcitons have practical applications in gain devices, photovoltaic cells and as single photon light sources. However, these excitons decay primarily via nonradiative Auger relaxation at a time scale of 10-100 ps, due to the enhancement of many-body interactions inside dots with a typical diameter of 3-4 nm surrounded by low dielectric medium. Despite the predicted limitations, the present study unambiguously showed an emission of neutral biexciton (BX), triexciton (TX) and quandraexciton (QX) in a time-integrated micro-photoluminescence (mu-PL) spectrum of quasi-type II CdTe/CdSe CQDs. These CQDs offer the option of Auger relaxation suppression and an extension of multiexcitons' lifetime. This upturn should permit charge extraction in photovoltaic cells and inversion of population in a gain device.

articleTitle: Laser heated nanodroplet PCR on a Petri dish
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the development of a real-time PCR system driven solely by laser heating with nanoliter droplets on a polystyrene Petri dish.

articleTitle: Quadrature detection and cancellation of absolute wavelength in a prism-pair interferometer for high-accuracy refractive index measurements of glasses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Uncertainty of refractive-index measurements of optical-glasses are further reduced in a prism-pair interferometer by a quadrature-detection and a shared light-source. Uncertainty of 1.50 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> is confirmed by an interlaboratory comparison based on other methods.

articleTitle: Frequency combs - at the frontier of precision measurements
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The principles and techniques for generating optical frequency combs from the THz region to the extreme ultraviolet will be reviewed. A growing list of applications includes precise spectroscopy of atoms and molecules, optical atomic clocks, and precision astronomy.

articleTitle: Passive phase locking of 169 lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We phase lock an array of 169 Nd:YAG lasers using Fourier filtering in a common degenerated resonator. We observe a wide variety of stable phase structures that are in exact agreement with calculated ones.

articleTitle: Brillouin gain coefficient measurement of Bismuth oxide-based photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Brillouin gain coefficient of a 1.16-m-long bismuth oxide-based photonic crystal fiber is measured by using a beat lock-in probe detection scheme to overcome the limitation caused by considerable pump beam back-reflection at splicing points. g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</sub> is found to be ~4times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> m/W.

articleTitle: Random-phase-matching in periodically-poled material
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that randomness in the periodicity and the duty-cycle of inverted domains in a periodically-poled crystal can result in substantial enhancement in non-phase-matched second harmonic generation. The result is corroborated by experiment.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal control of THz pulses by shaping the laser beam transverse profile in a non linear rectifying crystal
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that spatiotemporal properties of Terahertz (THz) pulses generated in a ZnTe crystal are controlled in the intermediate field by shaping the transverse spatial profile of the near infrared (NIR) femtosecond (fs) optical pump.

articleTitle: Fiber delivery of 25 fs laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond laser pulses came of age and found applications in many fields of lifesciences resulting in an increased interest in the dispersion-managed guiding of very short optical pulses. We demonstrate the delivery of 25 fs, 1.1 nJ pulses from a Ti:sapphire laser through 1.6 m optical fiber.

articleTitle: Lasing in metal-clad nano-cavities
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Metallic nano-cavities employed in recently demonstrated metallic cavity nano-lasers are examined. An overview is given of results from devices employing metal-insulator-metal structures with sub-wavelength dimensions, and progress in further miniaturization to tens of nanometers reported.

articleTitle: Phase locking and beam combining of lasers with intra-cavity polarization elements
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: New configurations for phase locking and beam combining very large laser arrays with intra-cavity polarization elements are presented. We demonstrated efficient phase lock of 24 Nd:YAG lasers and beam combining of 5 lases.

articleTitle: Controlled zero-n̅ bandgaps in negative refraction photonic superlattices for wavefront control and open resonances
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimental measurements of tuned zero-<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> bandgaps in photonic crystal superlattices supported by precise nanofabrication and rigorous 3D ab initio simulations, these zero-order gaps have potential for wavefront control for arbitrary phase delay lines.

articleTitle: Terahertz-comb-referenced spectrum analyzer
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new method for precise frequency measurement of continuous-wave terahertz (THz) wave is proposed by using a THz frequency comb of photocurrent in a photoconductive antenna for THz detection. Effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by measurement of a test source. Precision of the frequency measurement was 2.2times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> within the range of 75-110 GHz.

articleTitle: Pockels effect in short period silicon germanium superlattices
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce a method for calculating Pockels coefficients in SiGe superlattices. We show that the Pockels effect in (Si)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>(Ge)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> superlattices is half as strong as in GaAs. This opens a path to efficient CMOS-compatible modulators.

articleTitle: The effects of increasing AlN mole fraction on the performance of AlGaN based ultraviolet light emitting diode active regions
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Time-resolved photoluminescence and transmission electron microscopy results suggest that the density of point defects may have a more significant role than threading dislocations in the performance of UVLED AlGaN active regions emitting at shorter wavelengths.

articleTitle: High quality factor 1D photonic crystal cavities in silicon
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a tapered photonic crystal cavity approach we designed cavities with theoretical Quality factors Q=2times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> and measured experimental Q=7.5times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>. Non-linear broadening of the cavity resonance has also been observed.

articleTitle: Thermo-optic stabilization of optofluidic photonic crystal resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the temperature sensitivity of silicon-based optofluidic photonic crystal double-heterostructure resonators. We systematically study the optical properties of these resonators as function of temperature, specifically demonstrating the potential for creating temperature-insensitive photonic crystal devices.

articleTitle: Parallel-coupled dual racetrack ring silicon modulator for advanced modulation formats
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and analyze a parallel-coupled dual racetrack-ring silicon modulator. Our simulations show that a wide variety of advanced modulation formats such as QPSK and 16-QAM can be achieved in such a structure.

articleTitle: Future flexible OLED displays for army applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Organic light emitting diodes have been fabricated on an active matrix backplane from an 180C processed amorphous Si thin film transistors on polyethylene naphthalate (PEN) substrates. Organic light emitting diodes have been fabricated on the active matrix backplane. The presentation will include organic material development from ARL in the context of future Army applications.

IEEE Keywords: Active matrix organic light emitting diodes

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope phase stabilization of amplified pulses using an all-electronic servo loop
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel all-electronic carrier-envelope phase stabilization for amplified pulses with kHz-bandwidth is demonstrated. Residual carrier-envelope phase noise exhibits two major contributions: one glitch-like mechanism from the pump laser and carrier-envelope phase noise inherited from the oscillator.

articleTitle: Femtosecond-laser induced sub-200 nm structures in TiO2
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Sub-wavelength periodic surface structures in titanium dioxide with periods of 170 and 90 nm were generated with 150 fs pulses at 800 and 400 nm, respectively. Formation mechanisms and conditions for large-area patterning are discussed.

articleTitle: Quantum wells and nanophotonics: Physics, applications and limits
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We summarize recent work in germanium quantum well physics and devices, in nanophotonic and nano-metallic structures for enhanced photodetection, and in fundamental limits to optical components, for applications such as slow light and optical interconnects to silicon.

articleTitle: Time-to-space mapping system using double electrooptic deflectors fabricated on a single LiTaO3 substrate with “U” shaped microstrip line
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 2 ps temporal resolution of time-to-space mapping using double quasi-velocity-matched electrooptic deflectors operating at 16 GHz repetition frequency. Deflectors were fabricated on a single stoichiometric LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> substrate with ldquoUrdquo shaped modulation microstrip line.

articleTitle: Trapped ion qubit operations with ultrashort pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe an experiment to achieve ultrafast qubit operations on trapped <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">171</sup>Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ions. We plan to use a series of short optical pulses to perform bit rotations and multi-bit entangling gates independent of ion temperature.

articleTitle: Silicon-nitride surface passivation of sub-micron silicon waveguides for low-power optical switches
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We achieved a two-orders-of-magnitude improvement of free carrier lifetimes in sub-micron silicon-on-insulator waveguides by applying a stoichiometric Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> coating. Such surface passivation is critical for low-power operation of carrier-injected optical switches.

articleTitle: Low bend loss in tightly-bent optical fibers through adiabatic bend transitions
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate low bend loss for tightly bent optical fibers by winding the fiber around a mandrel designed to follow an adiabatic transition path into the bend.

articleTitle: Second-harmonic generation from single core-shell CdTe/CdS quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed second harmonic generation from semiconducting CdTe/CdS nanocrystals with a diameter below 15 nm. Their submicron size, high nonlinearity and orientation sensitive SHG response are adapted for ultrafast, high resolution probing of optical near-fields.

articleTitle: Inter- and intrapulse dynamics and feedback control for laser machining
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate in situ observation of percussion drilling in stainless steel at axial rates of 40 kHz. The melt cycle is directly observed and imaging feedback is used to improve cut accuracy.

articleTitle: Generation of high energy, ultrashort pulses in the near-IR with an OPA system based on BIBO
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a two stage, white-light seeded, collinear, femtosecond optical parametric amplifier based on BIBO crystal, sub-30-fs signal pulses with energies exceeding 200-muJ, corresponding to 5-fold pulse shortening and ~30% internal conversion efficiency, are generated.

articleTitle: Subwavelength imaging with non-magnetic anisotropic bilayers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show the features of a non-magnetic subwavelength imaging system achieved with an anisotropic bilayer. The two anisotropic layers can be implemented with metal-insulator stacks, and the resonance condition is not required for either layer.

articleTitle: Control of optical pulse at visible region using pulse trapping in photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Control of optical pulse at visible region is directly demonstrated using pulse trapping by soliton pulse in photonic crystal fibers. Wavelength of trapped pulse is continuously blue-shifted from 0.53 to 0.45 um by power control.

articleTitle: Optical antennas for vector near-field imaging
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new method for nano-engineering the optical antenna properties of scanning probe tips by combining focused ion beam milling with nano-CVD is presented. We demonstrate the capabilities by probing specific vector-field components of plasmonic nanostructures.

articleTitle: Nonlinear inter-core coupling in triple-core photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We model and investigate experimentally the propagation of light in a triple-core photonic crystal fiber (PCF) in the nonlinear regime. Two separate nonlinear effects are identified, giving rise to two separate nonlinear ranges.

articleTitle: The influence of thermal confinement and temperature-dependent absorption on resonant infrared ablation of frozen aqueous and alcohol targets
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The mechanism of matrix-assisted resonant infrared laser ablation of frozen aqueous and methanol solutions of polymer was investigated by performing plume shadowgraphy and ablation yield measurements. A picosecond, tunable free-electron laser was tuned to two wavelengths in the target matrices, one (2940 nm) that was resonant with the -OH stretch in both water and methanol, and the other (3450 nm) that is resonant with the -CH stretch in methanol. The plume images showed gross similarities, differing only in the time required for the shockwave to appear and in the velocity of the shock front. Typically, 15-25 mus after the ablation laser pulse arrives the primary material ejection commences and lasts for hundreds of mus. In all three cases, the ablation plume appears to consist entirely of vapor with no droplets or solid particles. The ablation yield is either linear or quadratic in fluence. This dependence can be understood if we consider thermal diffusion in the targets and the temperature dependence of the absorption coefficient.

articleTitle: Quantum information with trapped ions
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We will discuss the implementation of high fidelity entangling operations based on a global interaction of a single laser beam with a string of trapped ions.

articleTitle: 10.5 watts time-averaged power mid-IR supercontinuum generation with direct pulse pattern modulation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An all-fiber-integrated supercontinuum laser having time-averaged power scalable up to 10.5 W with diffraction limited beam quality is demonstrated. The SC pulses can be generated with arbitrary modulation patterns having on/off durations as short as 10 muS.

articleTitle: Picosecond pulse generation using low-driving-voltage MZM driven with step recovery diodes
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated synthesis of picosecond pulse train from a continuous-wave laser source using low-driving-voltage Mach-Zehnder modulator (MZM) asymmetrically large-amplitude driven with step-recovery diodes, without using high-power driver amplifiers. 2-GHz, 5.2-ps pulse train was successfully generated.

articleTitle: Nonlinear refractive indices in undoped and Yb-doped KT(WO4)2 T=Y, Yb, Gd, Lu crystals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear index was investigated in undoped and Yb-doped monoclinic double-tungstates for EparN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> and EparN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub> polarized 819 nm light. Anisotropic n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> with maximum for EparN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> in all investigated compounds is proportional to the rare earth ion polarizability.

articleTitle: Optical control of surface-tension effects in complex nanofluids
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study coupling between light and nano-particle suspensions, through surface-tension effects in capillaries. Increasing light intensity far-away from the interface causes huge changes in the fluid level, manifesting optical control over mechanical properties of fluids.

articleTitle: Temporal pulse compression in high-index doped silica glass integrated waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By exploiting the excellent nonlinear properties of a novel silica based low-loss high index glass (Hydex reg), we demonstrated low peak power, efficient ps pulse compression in a 45 cm spiral waveguide.

articleTitle: High energy regenerative thin disk amplifier with sub 200 fs pulses and 10 W average power
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An Yb:KYW femtosecond regenerative amplifier with combination of two partially overlapping gain spectra from a single thin disk, producing 500 muJ sub 200 fs pulses at a repetition rate of 20 kHz, is presented.

articleTitle: Impact of the residual disorder on the slow light regime in 1D and 2D photonic crystals structures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate the effect of residual disorder on the dispersion curve of light near a band edge. A Fourier space imaging technique accurately distinguishes the propagating regime from evanescent regime in planar photonic crystal.

articleTitle: Multi-THz bandwidth RF spectrum analysis of femtosecond pulses using a Chalcogenide photonic chip
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultra-broad bandwidth (3.75 THz) RF spectrum analysis of femtosecond optical pulses is reported for the first time, enabled by the use of a short 6 cm length Chalcogenide waveguide designed for high nonlinearity and broadband low dispersion.

articleTitle: Parametric optical magnetism and the complex Mathieu equation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The motion of a bound electron driven by moderately intense light is shown experimentally to give rise to intense parametric magnetism and theoretically to undergo ultrafast growth of nonlinear magnetic susceptibility governed by a complex Mathieu equation.

articleTitle: Injection seeded high precision frequency stabilization for Q-switched solid state oscillators in LIDAR-applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A Pound-Drever-Hall technique modified by a sample and hold circuit is presented and applied to Nd:YAG ring oscillator emitting 8 W average power at 400 Hz yielding frequency stability of better 285 kHz.

articleTitle: Octave-spanning Raman comb stabilized to an optical frequency standard
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is shown that adiabatic manipulation of a Raman process allows us to produce an optical-frequency-comb from single-frequency lasers. The carrier-envelope-offset frequency of the generated octave-spanning Raman comb is stabilized to an optical-frequency-standard.

articleTitle: Direct manipulation of nanoparticles and DNA in sub-wavelength optical nanochannels
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Here we demonstrate two novel approaches to on-chip optofluidic transport. We show the trapping of polystyrene microspheres using SU-8 waveguides down to 75 nm polystyrene nanoparticles and linear lambda-DNA using silicon slotted waveguides.

articleTitle: Nanoprobe-based characterization of femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and develop a nanoprobe-based technique for characterizing femtosecond laser pulses. A preliminary demonstration based on the measurement of the interferometric autocorrelation trace through two-photon fluorescence from a nonlinear nanoprobe is reported.

articleTitle: Thermal properties of post-size controlled 12-fold quasi-photonic crystal microcavity for electrically-driving
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricate 12-fold quasi-photonic crystal microcavity with size-controlled post for electrically-driven structure by fine-tuning wet-etching time. Improved thermal properties of microcavities with different post sizes are investigated both in finite-element method simulations and experiments.

articleTitle: Ultrafast laser filamentation control techniques for remote applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two methods of filamentation control for remote applications were studied. The first one consisted in an adaptive optic system, implemented in a specially designed focusing beam expander, which corrected for wavefront aberrations. Using this setup we are able to generate extraordinarily strong nitrogen signals at a distance as far as 90 m using 40 mJ laser pulses. Moreover, the filaments produced were used in a remote sensing scheme to detect and identify multiple targets such as trace hydrocarbon gases, solid metallic targets and aqueous aerosol clouds. The other method consists in a filament regularization method where a circular aperture of variable diameter is centered on the laser propagation axis, prior to filamentation. Longer filaments with higher ionization densities were produced in air and studied via the backscattered N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> fluorescence. 3D + time stochastic numerical simulations has shown that the optimum aperture size corresponds to the case of multiple filament ‘squeezing’ around the propagation axis forming the regularized elongated structure with higher overall amount of plasma.

articleTitle: Coherent betatron radiation from laser-wakefield accelerated bunches of monoenergetic electrons
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: X-rays generated by 0.1 - 0.5 GeV electron beams generated using a 100 TW laser are shown to have a low emittance, be spatially coherent and have a peak brightness comparable to 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> generation synchrotron sources.

articleTitle: Ferroelectric PVDF-based surface plasmon resonance-like integrated sensor at terahertz frequencies for gaseous analytes
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Plasmon-like excitation at the interface between fully polymeric fiber sensor and gaseous analyte is demonstrated theoretically in terahertz regime. Sensor sensitivity of 1.3middot10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> RIU to the changes in the gaseous analyte refractive index is predicted.

articleTitle: Optical trapping and fluorescence collection using a dual-wavelength diffractive optic
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon diffractive element that serves as an optical tweezer in the near infrared and as a fluorescence collector in the visible. The 1.3 NA lens is achromatic and has high diffraction efficiency.

articleTitle: Coherent dynamics of one and two-photon states in a strongly coupled single quantum dot-cavity system
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Heterodyne spectral interferometry is employed to perform four-wave mixing spectroscopy on a strongly-coupled system of an exciton confined in a single quantum dot and a photon mode of a pillar microcavity. The coherent dynamics of one and two photon states are directly observed and the validity of the Jaynes-Cummings model is tested.

articleTitle: Phase separation in a two-species atomic bose-einstein condensate with an interspecies Feshbach resonance
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We consider a mixture of two-species atomic Bose-Einstein codensates coupled to a bound molecular state at zero temperature via Feshbach resonance. This system is shown to be able to support rich sets of phase separations.

articleTitle: Efficiency enhancement of GaN/InGaN vertical-injection light emitting diodes using distinctive indium-tin-oxide nanorods
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Distinctive indium-tin-oxide nanorods are demonstrated using glancing-angle deposition. The nanostructured material exhibit enhanced transmission and is employed to enhance the light-output-power of GaN/InGaN vertical-injection light emitting diodes by 20% at an injection current of 350mA.

articleTitle: Femtosecond nonlinear frequency conversion using BiB3O6 crystals from 250 nm in the UV to 3000 nm in the near-IR
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Relevant properties of BIBO are reviewed and experimental results are presented on both parametric up- and down-conversion of femtosecond pulses, from the high-energy, low-repetition-rate (1-kHz) to the low-energy, high-repetition-rate (56-76-MHz) regime, demonstrating its unique versatility.

articleTitle: Surface-emitting photonic crystal terahertz semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate single-mode, surface-emitting terahertz lasers at lambdaap110 mum employing photonic-crystal resonators. The devices employ metal-metal waveguides, and the photonic-crystal lattice is implemented by the sole patterning of the top metal contact, without deep-etching the semiconductor in the photonic crystal holes. The device emission wavelength correctly tunes with the photonic crystal characteristics. In addition, we elucidate the crucial role played by the boundary conditions of the photonic-crystal resonator.

articleTitle: Improved mode-beat stability of a multisection quantum dot semiconductor laser by fiber optical feedback
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The mode-locking beat stability of a monolithic mode-locked quantum-dot laser is improved by an auxiliary mode-comb. A tenfold enhancement of the beating carrier red-shift and a substantial improvement of the RMS timing jitter is achieved.

articleTitle: Scientific and technical accomplishments of THz photonics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: THz photonics combines optics and ultrafast lasers with electronics to generate subps THz pulses. The use of such pulses for science and technology will be illustrated. Opportunities in research and applications will be described.

articleTitle: Production of infrared pulses from a laser wakefield electron accelerator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Production of intense infrared pulses with 250-µJ pulse energy from a laser wakefield accelerator is demonstrated. It is strongly correlated with the production of self-injected monoenergetic electron beam.

articleTitle: Photon-counting photobleaching measurements and the effect of dispersion in two-photon microscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The effect of dispersion of the excitation pulse in two-photon microscopy is examined with a photon-counting microscope in both stationary and scanning modalities, and it is demonstrated that transform-limited pulses provide the best signal yield despite increased bleaching rates.

articleTitle: White light emission from organic diode with electroluminescent quantum dots and organic molecules
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An organic light-emitting device is used in combination with quantum dots and blue-light emitting organic molecules to produce flexible white light. Quantum dots are excited via direct electronic injection, unlike previously reported.

articleTitle: An expanded k-space evanescent coupling technique for characterizing photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an expanded k-space evanescent coupling technique for characterizing the dispersion and loss of photonic crystal waveguides (PCWG) by measuring the Fabry-Perot spectrum of a closed waveguide using a highly curved taper.

articleTitle: Stable circularly-polarized emission from vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A vertical cavity surface emitting laser (VCSEL) comprising a polarization-selective chiral reflector was designed, fabricated, and tested. Stable, single-mode, circularly-polarized (CP) lasing oscillation was achieved, for the first time, in a VCSEL cavity.

articleTitle: Red He-Ne laser exposure enhances Hydrogen Peroxide production and induces the “by-stander” effect and modulations in metabolic activity in malignant human brain cancer
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Enhanced generation of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, modulations in metabolic activity, and the ldquoby-standerrdquo effect from malignant human brain cancer cells due to red He-Ne laser exposures have been quantified and found to be light exposure dose dependent. The findings herein support evidence for an important role for light induced H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> to mediate biomodulations.

articleTitle: Planar plasmonic terahertz guided-wave devices
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe the realization of planar plasmonic THz guided-wave devices, including straight waveguides, Y-splitters and 3dB-couplers, using periodically perforated metal films. These perforated films behave as effective media whose waveguiding properties can be broadly engineered.

articleTitle: Near field imaging with assembled nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is shown theoretically that a near field probe composed of several nanoparticles with optimized positions can perform much faster and with the better contrast and resolution than a probe composed of a single nanoparticle.

articleTitle: Narrowband all-fibre source of heralded single photons
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an all-fibre source of near time-bandwidth limited, heralded single photons at 1570 nm. An output of 9.2 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> heralded photons per second was achieved with a heralding fidelity of 52%.

Author Keywords: (270.5585) Quantum optics. Quantum information and processing

articleTitle: Single-walled carbon nanotube saturable absorber mode-locked Yb:LuScO3 laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Mode-locking of the disordered cubic sesquioxide crystal Yb:LuScO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> using a reflection-type single-walled carbon nanotube saturable absorber is demonstrated under diode pumping and compared with passive mode-locking by a commercial SESAM.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Efficient routing of single photons with one atom and a microtoroidal cavity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate robust and efficient routing of single photons using a microtoroidal cavity QED system. Single photons from a coherent input are sorted to one output of the fiber with excess photons redirected to the other.

articleTitle: Wide temperature range high power broad area 975nm DFB lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 100 mum stripe 975 nm DFB lasers are shown to operate with spectral width < 0.35 nm to 100degC. Narrow (14deg) vertical far field and reasonable conversion efficiency (39,5%) were achieved. A comparison with reference FP lasers is presented.

articleTitle: Characterization of free-carrier nonlinearities in porous silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the measurement of free-carrier nonlinearities in nanoporous silicon waveguides at 1550 nm. Although the waveguide is approximately 70% porous, it exhibits stronger and faster free-carrier effects than those of crystalline silicon waveguides.

articleTitle: Beam shaping of GaN/InGaN vertical-injection light emitting diodes via high-aspect-ratio nanorod arrays
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The enhanced light extraction and collimated output beam profile from GaN/InGaN vertical-injection light emitting diodes are demonstrated utilizing high-aspect-ratio nanorod arrays. The nanorod arrays are patterned by self-assembled silica spheres, followed by inductively-coupled-plasma reactive-ion-etching.

articleTitle: Proposal of fabricating a woodpile photonic crystal nanocavity by a two-directional etching without wafer bonding
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultra-high-Q modes are designed in woodpile photonic crystal by modulating the unit cell size along a waveguide in complete photonic band gap. We propose to fabricate the nanocavities with a two-directional etching without wafer bonding.

articleTitle: Lasing in chaotic and random scattering media
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Application of the ab-initio self-consistent (AISC) laser theory to multi-mode chaotic and random lasing media is presented.

articleTitle: Transformation optics of plasmonic metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Plasmonic metamaterials provide a convenient experimental platform for demonstration of principles of transformation optics. Results of imaging experiments using plasmonic metamaterials have been confronted with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Electrically controlled single quantum dot switching in photonic crystal resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The reflectivity of a photonic crystal cavity is modified using a single coupled quantum dot. We demonstrate electrical modulation by controlling the state of the quantum dot using a lateral electric field.

articleTitle: Coarse-to-fine: A layered sensing approach to situational awareness
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Military operations in the future will involve a variety of nation-state and non-nation-state adversaries. The ability to operate in complex domains will require sophisticated information gathering and exploitation tools. The Air Force Research Laboratory is working on such technologies. This paper highlights a subset of those technologies that operate in the electro-optical domain. The approach to sensor implementation and the types of sensors being developed will be overviewed, and potential new sensing technologies will be identified.

articleTitle: Fiber based source of frequency entangled photon pairs in the telecom band
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Frequency entangled photon pairs generated by using four wave mixing in a Sagnac fiber loop are presented. Coincidence detection shows the quantum interference in the form of spatial beating with a visibility of (95plusmn2)%.

articleTitle: Magneto-optical Kerr effect probed using ultrafast high-order harmonic EUV light
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use tabletop high harmonics to detect the EUV transverse magneto-optical Kerr effect from a permalloy sample. We measure large asymmetries, up to 6%, around the M absorption edges of Fe (54 eV) and Ni (67 eV).

articleTitle: High-power, widely-tunable, continuous-wave polycrystalline Cr2+:ZnS laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
