abstract: We present 10 W room-temperature, pure CW, polycrystalline Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnS laser, broadly tunable over 1940-2780 nm, with maximum output power of 7.4 W at 2410 nm, and above 5 W over 2120-2590 nm.

articleTitle: Fourier spectroscopy of fragmentation of D2+ irradiated with attosecond pulse trains
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The kinetic energy release of the D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> fragment ion from D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> molecule is measured using an interferometric autocorrelation technique. The interference fringes of the omega, 3omega, and 5omega fields emerge on the D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> fragment signals.

articleTitle: Two-photon excitation and emission in quantum dots coupled to photonic crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present calculations and proposals for two-photon transition rate enhancement in quantum dots coupled to photonic crystal cavities. Cavity-assisted two-photon absorption and emission are efficient methods to coherently excite quantum dots and generate indistinguishable single photons.

articleTitle: Bulk metamaterial with hyperbolic dispersion
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated bulk (51 mum thick) photonic metamaterial based on anodized alumina membranes filled with silver. The material is highly anisotropic and follows the hyperbolic dispersion law at lambda>0.84 mum.

articleTitle: Strong coupling between optomechanical resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate strong coupling between two stacked micro-optomechanical silicon nitride disks. The induced frequency splitting almost spans a full free-spectral range. Mechanical oscillations excited by repulsive/attractive gradient forces modulate the coupling modulation at several MHz.

articleTitle: Q-switched Tm3+:YAG rod laser with crystalline fiber geometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimental results on TIR-pumped Q-switched Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YAG lasers pumped at 804 nm. Up to 5.6 mJ pulse energy is achieved (25.9 kW peak power at 216 ns pulse width).

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Coherent ultrafast optical control of an electron spin initialized to a pure state in a charged self-assembled quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the optical initialization and ultrafast coherent control of an electron spin in a self-assembled dot, showing a spin Rabi oscillation and time-resolved precession of the electron spin coherence.

articleTitle: Internally frequency-doubled PPLN femtosecond optical parametric oscillator tunable in the visible
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Statically tunable femtosecond pulses in the red are generated by internal doubling of a PPLN-based OPO in BiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>. Cavity-delay tuning across 665-785 nm at average power of 260 mW in 140-fs pulses is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Time-evolution of carriers after multiphoton ionization of bulk dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using the unique characteristics of multiphoton ionization with focused femtosecond pulses, we report on a pump and probe metrology to analyze carrier dynamics inside dielectrics. We characterize the sub-picosecond trapping of carriers inside fused SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Using surface plasmons to enhance the speed and efficiency of superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report our design and fabrication of superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors integrated with gold plasmonic nanostructures, which can enhance the absorption of TM-polarized light, and can enlarge the effective area without sacrificing detector speed.

articleTitle: Polarized single photons from colloidal quantum dots in chiral microcavities at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report elliptically-polarized fluorescence from colloidal semiconductor quantum dots in a chiral 1-D photonic bandgap microcavity composed of a planar-aligned cholesteric liquid crystal. Antibunched fluorescence proves a polarized single photon source operating at room temperature.

articleTitle: Degree of mode localization in Random lasing from ZnO nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an experimental procedure to directly extract the degree of localization of random laser modes in ZnO powders. Strongly localized and extended modes are found to coexist within the same ensemble area.

articleTitle: Magneto-optical Kerr effect tomography of an electron spin state in a semiconductor quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose an magneto-optical Kerr effect tomography(MOKET) of an electron spin state in a semiconductor quantum dot. This method can measure the quantum spin coherence between spin up and down states.

articleTitle: Stable, high-power, continuous-wave, single-frequency source at 532 nm using MgO:sPPLT crystal
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a compact, high-power, cw green source based on single-pass SHG of a Yb-fiber laser in MgO:sPPLT, providing 7.58 W, single-frequency output at 532 nm in TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oo</sub> profile(M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup><1.29) with peak-to-peak power stability of 9% over 13 h.

articleTitle: Observation of second-harmonic whispering-gallery modes in ZnO nanotetrapod
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the formation of second-harmonic whispering-gallery modes (SH-WGMs) on the tapered ZnO nanotetrapod legs. The SH-WGMs have strong dependence on the polarization of the fundamental infrared excitation beam relative to the crystal axis.

articleTitle: Pump beam recycling for an enhancement of the output power of Terahertz-wave parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have implemented a recycled pump beam technique on a terahertz parametric oscillator (TPO). The TPO with a recycled beam produces a terahertz beam that is several times stronger than that of the conventional TPO.

articleTitle: One-way quantum computation using a quantum nondemolition entangling gate
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a Ucirc = exp(ikappaxcirc<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) gate as an example of one-way quantum computation. The coefficient kappa is controlled via the local oscillator phase of a homodyne measurement. The squeezing below the shot noise limit is observed.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive near-field study of surface plasmon polaritons launched by chains of subwavelength holes in gold films
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A chain of subwavelength sized holes in a gold film is used to launch surface plasmon polaritons. We investigate how the field pattern close to the chain evolves into diffraction orders in the far field.

articleTitle: Two-photon resonant excitation of a doubly excited state in He atoms by high-harmonic pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the two-photon resonant excitation of the doubly excited 2p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>S state in helium atoms by the combination of 29.5- and 32.6-eV harmonic photons. Our ab-initio calculation confirms the nonlinear excitation by high harmonics.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of few-cycle optical parametric chirped pulse amplication at mid-IR wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a design for a novel carrier to envelope phase stable OPCPA source in the mid-infrared. The obtained results indicate pulses of 56 fs duration, with pulse energies of 9.6 muJ at a central wavelength of 3.3 mum.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical measurements of coherent acoustic phonon attenuation in silicon
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report measurements of the attenuation of ~100 GHz coherent acoustic phonons in silicon and results are compared with existing theory. The results have implications for nanoscale thermal transport models and novel acoustic imaging schemes.

articleTitle: Directive emission from high-Q photonic crystal cavities through band folding
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new design is proposed for tailoring the farfield of high-Q photonic crystal nanocavities. We achieved experimentally a six-fold improvement of the collection efficiency. This will improve single photon sources based on photonic crystals considerably.

articleTitle: A simple implementation of optical Two-Dimensional Fourier Transform Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a simple experimental technique to perform optical Two-Dimensional Fourier Transform Spectroscopy. This technique derives from a modified pump-probe geometry with a pair of collinear, phase-locked pump pulses.

articleTitle: Polarization maintaining passively mode-locked Er-doped ultrashort soliton fiber laser using single wall carbon nanotube polyimide film
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-polarization maintaining Er-doped ultrashort soliton fiber laser using single wall carbon nanotube polyimide film and variable output coupler is constructed and investigated. A 580 pJ and 46 fs ultrashort pulse is generated after compression.

articleTitle: Electroluminescence from silicon-based photonic crystal microcavities with PbSe colloidal quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An electrically injected silicon photonic crystal microcavity light source operating at room temperature is demonstrated. The active gain medium consists of PbSe colloidal quantum dots which are embedded in the photonic crystal and whose emission peak is at 1.55 mum. The resonant modes of the microcavity are observed in the device output spectra.

articleTitle: Tomography of a heralded N00N state with losses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first complete characterization of a heralded two-photon N00N state in the presence of losses, including the one-photon and vacuum components. Reconstruction shows large vacuum and one-photon components resulting from loss.

articleTitle: Femtosecond high-power thin-disc laser oscillators
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of pulses with twenty-five microjoules of energy generated from a thin-disk oscillator at repetition rates below three megahertz with the potential to drive high field experiments. First micromachining experiments are presented.

articleTitle: Experimental evidence of single-phonon mediated inter-level excitonic transitions in a semiconductor quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Resonance fluorescence of a single InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot enables us to show direct evidence of population up-conversion to an excited state in a quantum dot, which we attribute to single-acoustic-phonon processes at low temperature.

articleTitle: Microcavities for cavity-QED in single-crystal diamond
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical microcavites fabricated by etching whispering gallery mode and photonic crystal structures in a high-index gallium phosphide layer and an underlying single-crystal diamond substrate are studied experimentally and theoretically.

articleTitle: Anti-Stokes photoluminescence from n-type free-standing GaN based on competing two-photon absorption and phonon-assisted absorption
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Mechanisms for anti-Stokes photoluminescence observed at room temperature from n-type free-standing GaN grown by MOCVD have been attributed by us to the competition between two-photon absorption and phonon-assisted absorption.

articleTitle: Ultrafast switching of nanostructure in fused silica
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond switching of anisotropic nanostructure indicating birefringence with a time constant of plusmnb200 fs was observed. Such anisotropy has evolved by lowering threshold for defect formation and enhanced coherency of the electron plasma wave.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh resolution optical coherence tomography using Cr4+:YAG fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a CW 265-nm broadband source from Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG double-clad fiber, ultrahigh resolution optical coherence tomography was demonstrated with a 73-dB S/N ratio. A 3 mum TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> thin film was used to verify its 3.5-mum axial resolution.

articleTitle: Infrared multimillijoule single-filament supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Single 4-mJ supercontinuum filaments supporting 8-fs pulses are generated by focusing ultrashort pulses from a four-stage KTP-OPCPA into a noble-gas cell. The use of a 1.6-µm wavelength permits efficient energy scaling in the single-filament regime.

articleTitle: A passively mode-locked femtosecond soliton fiber laser at 1.5 µm with a CNT-doped polycarbonate saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a new 1.5 mum passively mode-locked fiber laser incorporating a CNT-doped polycarbonate as a polymer saturable absorber. A 115-fs, 39-MHz soliton pulse was successfully generated with an average output power of 3.4 mW.

articleTitle: Characterizing particulate and droplet size distributions: Exhaust emissions to cloud research
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Phase Doppler interferometry applied to spray research has improved combustion efficiency with emissions reductions and led to insights in atmospheric and meteorological research. Laser-induced incandescence is demonstrated as a means for monitoring combustion particulate emissions.

articleTitle: Weak coupling of monolayer lead sulfide quantum dots to silicon photonic crystal cavities at near-infrared wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimental analysis of weak coupling for monolayer lead sulfide quantum dots coupled to silicon photonic crystal cavities between 4 K and room temperature, as well as power-saturation measurements of dots at 4 K.

articleTitle: Negative radiation-pressure response of a left-handed plasmonic metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the design, fabrication and opto-mechanical characterization of a left-handed plasmonic metamaterial which exhibits a negative photon-pressure response in the visible frequency range.

articleTitle: Long-wavelength BTJ-VCSELs with improved modulation bandwidth and temperature range
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: InP-based, long-wavelength VCSELs utilizing a buried tunnel junction (BTJ), emitting at 1.55 mum with improved active region and reduced parasitics are demonstrated. A superior modulation-bandwidth >10 GHz is achieved up to 85degC. Potential bit-rates of 12.5 or even 17 Gb/s are feasible for cost-effective 100 G Ethernet solutions at metro-range.

articleTitle: Two-electrode tapered laser at 1060 nm with record-high (19 W/A) modulation efficiency at 700 Mbps
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have obtained a high power of 3 W CW, 57% maximum wall-plug efficiency, a record-high modulation efficiency of 19 W/A at 700 Mb/s, more than 1.6 W optical modulation amplitude and 19 dB extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Optical wave transport and localization in disordered photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Effects of disorder on linear wave propagation in photonic crystal waveguides are investigated. In-plane translational and vertical symmetry of the crystal are broken by disorder. High-Q cavity excitation mechanism based on polarization mixing is introduced.

articleTitle: THz anti-resonant reflecting tube waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We successfully demonstrated a simple plastic tube waveguide with an air core for low loss THz waveguiding. Our study on the attenuation spectra indicated its anti-resonant reflecting waveguiding nature.

articleTitle: Nonlinear photon z-pinching in filamentary self-compression
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Self-pinching of the photon fluence of millijoule laser pulses propagating inside filaments is discussed. This effect causes local contraction of the beam diameter and is proven to lead to axial pulse self-compression.

articleTitle: High quality synthetic single crystal diamond for novel optical applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Recent breakthroughs in single crystal diamond synthesis by chemical vapor deposition have lead to reproducible material of exceptionally high quality and of practical size, for a range of novel laser and photonics applications.

articleTitle: High-resolution photoacoustic imaging
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a high-resolution photoacoustic imaging apparatus based on a ring transducer which allows focused laser and ultrasonic beams to be launched collinearly from a monolithic device.

articleTitle: Intensity noise of mode-locked Yb-doped fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Intensity noise is characterized at all mode-locking regimes over a wide range of parameters. Onset of noise outburst is reported beyond a threshold pump power. Moderate-power operation is preferable for seeding amplifiers for minimum-noise operation.

articleTitle: Progress in the growth, characterization and device performance for nonpolar and semipolar GaN-based materials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This work provides motivation and background for work on nonpolar and semipolar GaN-based materials and then highlight UCSB work on growth of nonpolar and semipolar GaN on foreign substrates and on freestanding GaN substrates. UCSB work on nonpolar and semipolar GaN lighting emitting devices, including record 405 nm LED performance, the first nonpolar and semipolar GaN-based laser diodes, the first AlGaN clad-free GaN-based laser diodes, and progress in blue, green, and yellow emitters and report on the first demonstration of a normally-off nonpolar GaN-based transistors are summarized.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a multimode waveguide-cavity biosensor based on fringe visibility detection
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fringe visibility modulation from a two-mode waveguide coupled to a single mode ring resonator exposed to glucose:H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O demonstrates a visibility change of 1.57/wt%, compared to a transmission change of 0.19/wt% for single mode waveguide coupling.

articleTitle: Amplitude modulation of terahertz quantum cascade lasers by external interband-excitation light
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have investigated light-current characteristics of terahertz quantum cascade lasers under external light injection. The light injection induces the modulation of the output power that is explained by the characteristic properties of the laser.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse shaping by Ag nanoparticle arrays: Plasmon-enhanced absorption saturation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have examined a femtosecond pulse shaping phenomenon induced by self-organized Ag nanoparticle arrays. Significant pulse shortening was observed as plasmon resonance occurs between the array and femtosecond pulses.

articleTitle: Flat supercontinuum in suspended and immobilized short SF6 PCF taper
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate low threshold, octave spanning spectrally flat, supercontinuum generation in a short length of tapered SF6 glass photonic crystal fiber. The short fiber is held stably and robustly with a polydimethyl-siloxane (PDMS) matrix.

articleTitle: Effects of optical feedback in InAs/GaAs monolithic quantum dot passively mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The impact of optical feedback on the performance of a monolithic InAs/GaAs quantum dot passively mode-locked laser is experimentally investigated. We show that a feedback level greater than -25 dB can be detrimental to mode-locking operation.

articleTitle: Proposed Bell's inequality test using entangled photon holes
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose an experimental test of Bell's inequality using entangled photon holes rather than entangled photon pairs. The experiment involves feeding entangled photon holes into a time-bin based two-photon interferometer.

articleTitle: Optical activity in achiral metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate strong optical activity (and circular dichroism) for both microwave and photonic achiral planar metamaterials. The effect arises from extrinsic chirality resulting from oblique incidence of light onto the metamaterial structures.

articleTitle: 70nm resolution in sub-surface two-photon optical beam induced current microscopy through pupil-function engineering in the vectorial focusing regime
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimental evidence for the resolution-enhancing effect of an annular pupil-plane aperture in two-photon semiconductor microscopy in the vectorial-focusing regime. At an illumination wavelength of 1550nm we achieved a resolution of 70nm (λ/22).

articleTitle: Polarization switching in 1.3-µm quantum dot vertical cavity surface emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This work for the first time, experimentally demonstrates the polarization switching in 1.3-mum quantum dot VCSEL. The polarization switching in quantum dot VCSEL is achieved by adjusting the optical injection power.

articleTitle: Two-photon joint temporal density measurements via ultrafast single-photon upconversion
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed the technique of two-photon joint temporal density measurements for temporal state characterization, thus facilitating two-photon generation with high temporal entanglement or nearly factorizable outputs by controlling the ultrafast pump bandwidth.

articleTitle: Quasi-super-continuum generation using ultrahigh-speed wavelength-tunable soliton pulses based on 1.06 µm ultrashort pulse laser system
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quasi super continuum generation at 1.1-1.4 mum is demonstrated using ultrahigh speed wavelength tuning of femtosecond soliton pulses for the first time. The center wavelength, bandwidth, and spectrum shape can be changed arbitrarily.

articleTitle: Demonstration of laser operation at room-temperature of an Sb-based mid-infrared multi-quantum-well structure monolithically grown on a Silicon substrate
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the fabrication and characterization of mid-infrared Sb-based lasers grown on Silicon substrates. We demonstrate room-temperature operation with low threshold current densities (~1.5 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), and pulsed mode up to a duty-cycle of 10%.

articleTitle: Slow light in dispersion-engineered photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Slow light photonic crystal waveguides can be dispersion-engineered with an unprecedented degree of control over the group index, propagation loss and injection efficiency. Ultrasmall optical switches and substantial enhancement of nonlinear effects are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Recent advances in non-Gaussian control of optical continuous variables
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present recent experimental progress in non-Gaussian control of optical continuous variables of traveling light, including generation and control of mesoscopic quantum superposition states and non-Gaussian entanglement control of continuous variables.

articleTitle: Phonon interaction on a single quantum dot emission line
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We studied the coupling between the lattice vibrations and the electronic states of a single electrically pumped InAs/GaAs quantum dot. The experimental observed spectra agree excellent with theoretical modeling considering real QD structural parameters.

articleTitle: Measuring angular dependent effective properties of metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measure the angular dependent response of a Swiss-cross metamaterial that has an effective index of n=-1.9 at normal incidence. It is experimentally shown how the effective properties depend on the incidence angle.

articleTitle: Laser particle acceleration
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The production of highly energetic beams of both electrons and ions is a major part of the experimental programme at the Central Laser Facility (CLF), STFC Rutherford Appleton Laboratory. Every year sees a significant number of experiments done in both areas. This has been complemented by theoretical studies that have been carried out at the CLF and UK universities. In a recent consultation on plans to build a 10 PW upgrade to the VULCAN facility, laser-driven particle acceleration formed a very significant part of the science case that emerged from this consultation. In this talk, I will review the experimental progress that has been made in particle acceleration, and I will also examine what theoretical investigations suggest the future of this field will be.

articleTitle: Effect of low temperature on surface plasmon polaritons in silver films
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have studied the effect of low temperature on the surface plasmon polariton loss and DC resistivity in silver films. We infer that a sizable loss reduction can be obtained in films of higher quality.

articleTitle: Compact, 1W, 10 kHz, Q-switched, diode-pumped Yb:YAG laser with volume Bragg grating for LIDAR applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We developed a compact, narrow-linewidth diode-pumped Yb:YAG laser with volume Bragg grating delivering stable TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub>-mode Q-switched pulses at 1030 nm with average output of 1 W at 10 kHz and linewidth of < 0.08 nm.

articleTitle: In-vivo measurement of the retinal movements using Fourier domain low coherence interferometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a new instrument developed for the study and diagnosis of glaucoma. This device is based on Fourier domain low coherence interferometry for in vivo measurement of the retinal movements, to assess in real-time the biomechanical properties of the eye. By measuring the displacement of the retina in a live rat, we show that the instrument has a spatial resolution of 200 nm at 200 Hz sampling rate. We found that the amplitude of the retinal movement due to cardiac pulsation is 15 mum. The system has the potential to become a useful clinical tool for evaluating the biomechanical properties of the eye.

articleTitle: Fast wavelength tuning of external cavity quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a fast wavelength tuning of a Littrow-type EC-QCL. This configuration allows for coarse broadband and high resolution mode-hop-free wavelength scanning at >1 kHz rates. Example EC-QCL measurements of mid-infrared ammonia spectra are demonstrated.

articleTitle: All-PM monolithic fs Yb-fiber laser, dispersion-managed with all-solid photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-in-fiber SESAM-modelocked self-starting fiber laser is demonstrated. Cavity dispersion is managed by a spliced-in PM all-solid photonic bandgap fiber. The laser directly delivers 1.25 nJ pulses of 280 fs duration.

articleTitle: Intersubband absorption loss in high-performance mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We calculate intersubband absorption loss and report measured waveguide loss for two high-performance mid-infrared quantum cascade laser designs. Intersubband absorption loss accounts for a major component of waveguide loss for these structures.

articleTitle: Dielectric tunable metamaterials with negative permeability in terahertz range
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present metamaterials for the terahertz range consisting of micromachined thin strontium titanate platelets. They display electromagnetic resonances with negative permeability around a frequency which is tunable as the intrinsic material permittivity depends upon temperature.

articleTitle: Background-free, 3D vibrational imaging by stimulated Raman scattering microscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and experimentally show that stimulated Raman scattering can realize novel 3D nonlinear-optical Raman microscopy that is immune to nonresonant background signals. We demonstrate high-contrast molecular imaging of polystyrene beads and plant cells.

articleTitle: Mechanistic studies of resonant infrared laser ablation of polystyrene
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the phenomenon of resonant-infrared laser ablation of polymers using polystyrene as a model material. Ablation is initiated by a picosecond free-electron laser tuned to various infrared wavelengths that are resonant with vibrational modes of a polystyrene target. Time-resolved plume imaging, coupled with etch-depth measurements and finite-element calculations of the temperature rise indicate that ablation begins after a superheated surface layer reaches a temperature of nearly 1000C and undergoes spinodal decomposition. The majority of the ablated material is then expelled by recoil-induced ejection as the pressure of the expanding vapor plume compresses the laser-melted volume.

articleTitle: On-chip cytometry using lensless digital holography
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We illustrate a high-throughput on-chip cytometry platform that records the holographic diffraction pattern of cells/bacteria without using any lenses. These digital in-line holograms contain finger-print information of each cell/bacteria type enabling unambiguous recognition of different micro-objects using pattern recognition.

articleTitle: Pulse-pumped CW tunable Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A cryogenically-cooled CW tunable Ti:sapphire laser, pumped by a frequency-doubled pulsed fiber laser, was demonstrated. Output power > 8 W with an M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> value < 1.05 and a 160-nm tuning range with < 0.07 nm linewidth were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Airy beam propagation through unbiased photorefractive media
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe the propagation of 1D Airy beams through an unbiased photorefractive crystal. For ordinary polarization, the beam diffracts, while for extraordinary polarization it experiences nonlinearity through charge diffusion and has its diffraction suppressed.

articleTitle: All fiber narrow linewidth high power bismuth doped fiber amplifier at 1179 nm
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigated the performance of Bi-doped fiber amplifier at 1179 nm, in both low and high input signal regime, when pumped at 1090 nm. The amplifier efficiency and the saturation power both depend on the fiber cooling.

articleTitle: Solitonic interactions in actively multi-bound soliton fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate the interactions between solitons in multi-bound states generated from an active mode-locked fiber laser and within the ring cavity. Their phase difference and corresponding interactions between solitons are studied.

articleTitle: Directional micro-cavity lasers with Limaçon-shaped chaotic resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate Limaccedilon-shaped microcavity lambda=10 mum lasers with directional emission. Their performance is robust with respect to variations of the deformation factor near its optimum value epsiv=0.40. Excellent agreement between experiments and theory is achieved.

articleTitle: A technique for measuring B-integral in chirped-pulse amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a simple method for measuring the B-integral of CPA systems based on temporal diffraction. Two identical pulses sent into the amplifier under study create time replicas used to retrieve the B-integral accumulation.

articleTitle: Two-color driven high-order harmonic source for x-ray laser seeding
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By two-color pumping and a small pressure induced shift we demonstrate, it is possible to substantially increase the number of X-ray laser schemes reachable for seeding with high-order harmonics created by a Nd:glass laser system.

articleTitle: Optical phase noise extraction and amplification technique and its application to optical phase noise monitoring for (D)PSK systems
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose an optical phase noise extraction and amplification (OPNEA) technique. By applying OPNEA to phase noise monitoring for (D)PSK, 13-dB dynamic range and 0.2-dB/degree sensitivity were achieved with a 50-120-degree phase deviation.

articleTitle: Insulator-to-metal transition of gold films observed by interferometric picometrology
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We obtain the complex refractive index and dielectric properties of ultra-thin gold films as a continuous function of thickness from 0.2 nm to 10 nm using picometrology. The atom-to-bulk transition of gold is observed.

articleTitle: Probing optomechanical correlations between two optical beams down to the quantum level
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum effects of radiation pressure are expected to limit the sensitivity of second-generation gravitational-wave interferometers. Though ubiquitous, such effects are so weak that they haven't been experimentally demonstrated yet. Using a high-finesse optical cavity and a classical intensity noise, we have demonstrated radiation-pressure induced correlations between two optical beams sent into the same moving mirror cavity. Our scheme can be extended down to the quantum level and has applications both in high-sensitivity measurements and in quantum optics.

articleTitle: Probing laser disturbed doubly excited states with isolated attosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-electron excitation and autoionization in helium atoms were studied experimentally using isolated attosecond pulses for the first time. The population of the resonance state was modified by intense near infrared laser pulses.

articleTitle: A low-noise, octave-spanning optical frequency comb generated by a mode-locked fiber laser with an intracavity electro-optic modulator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a fast control of an octave-spanning fiber-based frequency comb with an intracavity electro-optic modulator. The servo bandwidth of both repetition and carrier-envelope offset frequency is greater than 200 kHz.

articleTitle: Sub-picosecond optical switching in the near-infrared using negative index metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the ultrafast non-linear optical properties of a negative-index metamaterial. In particular, we achieve sub-picosecond optical switching allowing for terabits per second modulation at telecommunication wavelengths.

articleTitle: Integrated quantum information science with photons
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum technologies based on photons will likely require integrated optics architectures for improved performance, miniaturization and scalability. We demonstrate high-fidelity silica-on-silicon integrated optical realizations of key quantum photonic circuits.

articleTitle: Novel Ce:BiIG epitaxial thin films for magneto-optical applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the growth and characterization of novel Ce<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.2</sub>Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>-(Ce:BiIG) epitaxial thin films fabricated via pulsed laser deposition. Our results suggest the highest Faraday rotation ever obtained in magneto-optical garnet thin films (0.55 degrees/mum, @1550 nm).

articleTitle: Isolated attosecond pulse contrast measurement and CEP optimization for optical streaking in molecules
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A method to access and control isolated attosecond pulse contrast is presented, based on scanning the carrier-envelope phase (CEP). The optimized pulses produced time-resolved streak-field photoelectron data in molecules (SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>, N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>).

articleTitle: 160-Gb/s OTDM de-multiplexing based on a pulsed-pump parametric wavelength exchange
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the experimental demonstration of pulsed-pump wavelength exchange for all-optical time de-multiplexing of 160-Gb/s RZ signals. Power penalty ≤ 2.7 dB at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> was achieved for all de-multiplexed 10-Gb/s RZ signals.

articleTitle: Spatial filtering by using cascading plamonic gratings
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper, cascading plasmonic gratings were investigated. The angle dependent reflection spectrum of the proposed structure displays a resonance peak at a specific angle. The FWHM of the resonant peak is smaller than 2deg. The angular dispersion of the cascading plasmonic gratings is about dthetas/dlambda=0.15deg/nm. The cascading plasmonic gratings can be used as a spatial filter which can improve the spatial coherence of a light source.

articleTitle: White light generating nonradiative energy transfer directly from epitaxial quantum wells to colloidal nanocrystal quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present white light generating nonradiative Forster resonance energy transfer at a rate of (2 ns)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> directly from epitaxial InGaN/GaN quantum wells to CdSe/ZnS heteronanocrystals in their close proximity at chromaticity-coordinates (x,y) = (0.42,0.39) and correlated-color-temperature CCT = 3135 K.

articleTitle: Coherent control of the polarization of ultrafast terahertz pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The polarization of ultrafast terahertz pulses generated in a laser induced plasma can be controlled by the relative phase of the fundamental and the second harmonic optical fields.

articleTitle: Mode-resolved measurement of the linewidth enhancement factor of multiple longitudinal-mode lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The linewidth enhancement factor of a Fabry-Perot laser is measured using the traditional Hakki-Paoli gain measurement and two proposed modifications to techniques used for single longitudinal mode lasers.

articleTitle: Femtosecond dynamics of a midinfrared quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The optical gain dynamics in an InGaAs/AlInAs quantum cascade laser is studied by midinfrared pump-probe experiments and electro-optic sampling. We find an extremely fast gain recovery time of <1 ps.

articleTitle: Low-loss and bendable THz fiber with tailored dispersion
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A polymer THz fiber made of Topas and having a Photonic Crystal Fiber structure is demonstrated. It has low broadband loss and the dispersion of the fiber can be tailored by adjusting the structural parameters.

articleTitle: TM01 mode operation of an Yb-doped double-clad fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A radially polarized beam was amplified up to 1.1 W by passing through an Yb-doped double clad fiber pumped by a semiconductor laser, maintaining both the polarization and intensity patterns of the input beam.

articleTitle: Spectroscopic properties and gain cross section of Er, Yb doped Y2O3 transparent ceramic for eye-safe laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the spectroscopic characteristics and gain cross section of Er, Yb doped Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> transparent ceramic which is a potential material for eyes-safe laser.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transitions metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Polarization rotation in a nanosecond Yb3+ rod-type fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We evidenced the polarization rotation in an Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> rod type fiber amplifier injected by a subnanosecond microlaser. Simple numerical simulations account for the observed phenomena.

articleTitle: Quantifying binding of focal adhesion proteins using fluorescent spectral microscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A central challenge of modern biology is the need to understand how the interactions of protein machines affect cellular physiology and the pathology. Optical imaging and spectroscopy afford unprecedented opportunities in studying these dynamical processes in vivo. Time-resolved fluorescence resonance energy transfer microscopy has been developed to study mechanotransduction processes. Specifically, we demonstrate for the quantification of dissociation constants of focal adhesion proteins in vivo. We also observed the effects of mechanical environment on modifying these interactions.

articleTitle: Differential mode-locked cavity for measurements of minute displacements
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A laser cavity with interwoven pulse trains provides a unique environment for intracavity interferometry. In a linear configuration 3 nm displacement is converted to 1 kHz shift in beat frequency.

articleTitle: Bright photoluminescence from non-tapered InN nanowires grown on si by molecular beam epitaxy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have achieved superior quality non-tapered InN nanowires on Si(111) by molecular beam epitaxy, which are free of dislocations and exhibit bright photoluminescence at room-temperature and significantly reduced spectral broadening (linewidth~18.5 meV at 77 K).

articleTitle: Semiconductor guided-wavewavelength conversion devices
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fabrication processes for periodically inverted AlGaAs and AlGaP waveguides have been developed and used for fabrication of quasi-phase-matched wavelength conversion devices. We have succeeded in achieving considerably high conversion efficiencies in AlGaAs-based devices and the first observation of a quasi-phase-matched parametric interaction in a GaP-based device.

articleTitle: Enhancement on top emission of organic light-emitting diode via scattering surface plasmons by nano-aggregated outcoupling layer
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A stable self nano-aggregated bathocuproine film was fabricated and introduced atop of conventional organic light emitting diode for enhancing top emission leading to 2.7 times enhancement on top emission due to scattering surface plasmon energy.

articleTitle: Spontaneous micro-lens formation and reduction of multiphoton ionization inside dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By repeated optical breakdown with focused femtosecond pulses, we decrease the refractive index of fused silica by few percent. The subsequent micro-lens formation is associated with a reduction of multiphoton absorption in all dielectrics.

articleTitle: Single detector single shot high resolution iImaging
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate single detector real-time line imaging with up to 1 mum resolution at 1 line/50ns capture rate. Experimentally we demonstrate real time line imaging of <25 mum particles and patterns such as fingerprints.

articleTitle: Influence of crystal orientation on coupling between orthogonal modes in a Nd:YAG laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a drastic coupling reduction between orthogonal modes of a Nd:YAG laser when the gain crystal is cut along the <100> axis instead of <111>. Our measurements are accurately described by a simple theoretical model.

articleTitle: Reconciling two views of IR filamentation in air: Bessel beams or plasma-confined beams?
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Filaments prepared by letting a beam collapse, or by launching a <200 mum beam from vacuum to atmosphere, are compared. The two types of filaments show different properties, characteristics of different theories about their nature.

articleTitle: All-optical injection, control, and detection of ballistic spin and charge currents in group IV semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ballistic charge currents are injected into Ge and Si and pure spin currents into Ge using quantum interference techniques and are spatially and temporally resolved for the first time.

articleTitle: 1-GHz femtosecond optical parametric oscillator pumped by a 76-MHz Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a ~1 GHz femtosecond optical parametric oscillator synchronously pumped by a 76-MHz Ti:sapphire laser using a cavity longer than the fundamental synchronous cavity length. Near-transform-limited pulses with average durations of 227 fs are generated.

articleTitle: A spatial light modulator for terahertz radiation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We characterize the operation of a 4times4 electrically-driven terahertz metamaterial spatial modulator, and demonstrate high modulation uniformly at each pixel with minimal cross-talk. This modulator will enable high-speed terahertz imaging in a single-pixel imaging system.

articleTitle: CW terahertz spectrometer with high-precision frequency control
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We realized a continuous-wave terahertz spectrometer based on optical heterodyning of two near-infrared distributed-feedback diode lasers. Using active frequency stabilization we achieve 1 MHz resolution and a signal-to-noise ratio up to 80 dB.

articleTitle: Characterization of the large index modification caused by electrical discharge in optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper, the index anisotropy of a Corning SMF-28 fiber LPG was characterized before and after an electric discharge had been applied. The discharge parameters are typical of those used for splicing. Index anisotropy is measured through the phase retardation between light polarized along the longitudinal z axis (fiber axis) and the transverse y axis when propagating through the fiber from the side along the x axis.

articleTitle: Dispersive shock waves with negative pressure
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally observe a spatial optical shock with negative pressure/self-focusing nonlinearity on a partially-spatially-incoherent light. We examine its basic nonlinear properties and observe statistical wave damping.

articleTitle: Spatially coherent, phase matched, high-order harmonic beams at 50 kHz
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By tightly focusing a high repetition rate (50 kHz), compact, femtosecond laser system with low pulse energy (25 muJ), we demonstrate fully phase matched, fully spatially coherent, 50 kHz high harmonic beams for the first time.

articleTitle: Quantum-rod sensitized four-dimensional optical data storage
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum rods (QRs) are incorporated into polymers that are doped with azo dyes via an energy transfer process. The polarization-dependent refractive-index change allows four-dimensional optical data storage as well as other polarization-controlled photonic applications.

articleTitle: Local anisotropic polarizability in mesoscopic structures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a method for describing optical properties of inhomogeneous media at mesoscopic scales. When the volume of interaction varies, the effective polarizability tensor introduces a new length scale characterizing the structural morphology.

articleTitle: Spin transport of indirect excitons in GaAs/AlGaAs coupled quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spin transport of indirect excitons in GaAs/AlGaAs CQW was observed by measuring the spatially resolved circular polarization of exciton emission. This originates from the long spin relaxation time and long lifetime of indirect excitons.

articleTitle: Enhanced birefringence of inhomogeneous slabs
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that the presence of an interface changes the local field distributions in inhomogeneous materials. The loss of field symmetry leads to a significant surface-induced birefringence of an inhomogeneous medium.

articleTitle: Broadband four-wave mixing and supercontinuum generation in multi-component-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a new system based on a microstructured optical fiber having a multi-component glass rod in the core center. This system is used for ultra-broadband four-wave mixing (>110 THz) and supercontinuum generation.

articleTitle: 45 watts average power, 3 ps, 1.3-GHz repetition rate Yb-fiber amplification system
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Pulses from harmonically-mode-locked fiber laser were amplified in Yb-fiber to average power of 45 watts in good-quality 3-ps-pulses, at 1.3-GHz repetition rate in a near diffraction-limited-beam. 15-watts-average-power at 520 nm is produced by second-harmonic generation.

articleTitle: Second harmonic and Raman imaging of ultrafast laser written LiTaO3 waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper presents the fabrication of waveguides in lithium-tantalate using a 250-kHz repetition-rate ultrafast laser. Micro-Raman and second-harmonic microscopy studies indicate the preservation of optical nonlinearity in guiding regions formed by the laser-induced lattice compression.

Author Keywords: (350.3390) Other areas of optics: Laser materials processing

articleTitle: Cloaking at optical frequencies using dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate cloaking at optical frequencies. A dielectric carpet cloak is designed to hide object under a curved reflecting surface by mimicking the reflection from a flat surface, enabling broadband invisibility with low loss.

articleTitle: Er:YAG is a 2.5-level laser at 300°K
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose the ldquolevel parametersrdquo lscr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> and lscr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> to quantify the concept of two-, three- and four-level laser, for comparing different laser media, operating temperatures, and choices of pump and laser transitions.

articleTitle: Solid-state SHG green laser for laser TV
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A compact, highly efficient and high-power SHG green laser has been newly developed for the first laser TV dasiaLaserVuepsila. Technical basic concepts and features of this laser are briefly summarized.

articleTitle: Optically coupled rod-type fiber system: Oscillator versus oscillator-amplifier behaviour
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A Q-switched laser system which couples two ytterbium doped fibers is presented. Depending on the pump intensity this system yields either short or long nanosecond pulses. The gain competition accounts for the observed phenomena.

articleTitle: Optical monitoring of a wavelength-scale mechanical resonator via cavity scattering
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate sensitive optical readout of the motion of a wavelength-scale mechanical resonator via its scattering within a high-finesse optical cavity. Static calibration, dynamic monitoring and feedback cooling are presented.

articleTitle: Flexible Terahertz Metamaterials On Polyimide Substrates
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Flexible resonant terahertz metamaterials built on ultrathin highly flexible polyimide substrates have been designed, fabricated and measured. Our results provide a path forward for creating multi-layer non-planar metamaterials at terahertz frequencies.

articleTitle: Joint photon statistics of photon-subtracted squeezed light
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the joint photon-number statistics of a locally photon-subtracted two-mode vacuum squeezed state of light. Comparison to the unsubtracted statistics shows a successful photon subtraction and the expected shift by one photon number.

articleTitle: Surface-plasmon enhanced fluorescence in CdSe/ZnS semiconductor quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report surface-plasmon enhanced fluorescence in CdSe/ZnS semiconductor quantum dots via linear and nonlinear excitations. 2times and 10times fluorescence enhancements have been achieved for linear and nonlinear excitations, respectively.

articleTitle: High refractive index contrast in fused silica waveguides by tightly focused, high-repetition rate femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new domain of optical waveguide writing with record refractive index contrast (0.022) and small mode diameter is reported in fused silica by strong focusing of a 500-kHz repetition rate femtosecond laser with oil-immersion optics.

articleTitle: High-Q surface-plasmon whispering-gallery microcavity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a high-Q surface-plasmon-polariton (SPP) whispering-gallery microcavity with SPP Q factors up to 1,376 ± 65 in the near infrared. The SPP eigenmodes are accessed evanescently using a tapered optical waveguide.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength imaging using metallic wire arrays
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Tapered arrays of metallic wires can manipulate fields on the sub-wavelength scale. Two types of nanoscale imaging applications using terahertz and mid-infrared waves are enabled: image magnification and radiation focusing.

articleTitle: Resolution enhancement through focal field polarization control in third harmonic generation microscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Increased spatial resolution through control of the focal field polarization state in a laser scanning third harmonic generation (THG) microscope is demonstrated. THG polarization tomography is used to characterize the focal field polarization state.

articleTitle: Light storage using an Atomic Frequency Comb
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate the quantum storage capability of a thulium doped crystal by using the Atomic Frequency Comb (AFC) protocol. Preliminary results gives a 9% efficiency. Potential improvements are discussed based on a simple model.

articleTitle: Terahertz semiconductor metamaterials for magnetostatic and thermal tunability
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We studied a metasurface constituted of a periodic array of semiconductor split-ring resonators. The resonance frequencies were found to be continuously tunable in the terahertz regime through an external magnetostatic field or temperature control.

articleTitle: InP/AlGaInP 730nm emission quantum dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe growth and wafer design improvements to reduce 300 K threshold current density to 165 Acm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> for 2 mm long laser with uncoated facets and, using sophisticated optical and electrical characterisation, we demonstrate how this is achieved.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulses with 1.1 GHz repetition rate generated from a CW laser without mode-locking
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 471-fs pulses are generated by injecting a 33-ps pulse train, obtained from pulse carving a 1.55-mum CW DFB laser, into a time-lens loop. High repetition rate of 1.1 GHz is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Directly photoinscribed thick Bragg gratings in Ohara WMS-15 glass-ceramic
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Volume gratings were UV inscribed in WMS-15 glass-ceramic at 193 and 248 nm without additional processing. Weak, easily bleached gratings resulted from fluences below 0.3 kJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Stable gratings with Deltan ~ 6times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> were formed at higher fluences.

articleTitle: Multilayer walk-off corrected nonlinear optical devices - Engineering of quasi-noncritical phase-matching to all wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multilayer walk-off corrected nonlinear crystal composites not only can correct the spatial walk-off, but also can compensate the phase-mismatching caused by incident angle deviation. The noncritical phase-matching-like properties can be engineered to all wavelengths.

articleTitle: InP 2D photonic crystal lasers integrated onto SOI waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the fabrication of InP-based 2D photonic crystal lasers operating around 1.5 mum at room temperature integrated and evanescently coupled to SOI waveguides. Laser operation is obtained from a line defect structure accurately aligned on top the SOI circuitry.

articleTitle: Optical loss reduction in HIC chalcogenide glass waveguides via thermal reflow
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A rapid thermal reflow technique is applied to high-index-contrast, sub-micron waveguides in As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> chalcogenide glass to reduce sidewall roughness and associated optical scattering loss. Up to 50% optical loss reduction after reflow treatment is achieved.

articleTitle: VCSEL-based Oxygen Sensor for combustion optimization in gas/oil furnaces
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The first VCSEL-based O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> sensor for gas/oil furnace applications employing a diffuse reflector is presented which circumvents alignment and interference problems. Optimized data processing is used for long-term stable operation and allows for real-time measurement.

articleTitle: Fiber raman amplifiers with suppressed polarization impairments
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By using two-section fiber where the first section has no spin and the second one is periodically spun, we demonstrate reduced polarization dependent gain and polarization mode dispersion in a distributed fiber Raman amplifier.

articleTitle: 30W, 1178nm Yb-doped photonic bandgap fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-power, high-efficiency ytterbium-doped solid-core photonic-bandgap fiber amplification at the long-wavelength edge of the Yb gain band is reported. Amplified-spontaneous-emission-free, 30W non-polarized and 25W linearly-polarized 1178nm outputs have been achieved with ≪58% slope efficiencies.

articleTitle: High efficient kHz repetition rate injection seeded picosecond optical parametric generator in LBO
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a high efficient kHz repetition rate ps OPG in LBO with total conversion efficiencies of >50% in the near infrared. Injection seeding reduced the spectral bandwidth from typically 40 nm to 0.4 nm.

articleTitle: The Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter (LOLA) on NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) mission
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter instrument on NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter mission, scheduled to launch in April 2009, which will provide a precise lunar high-resolution global topographic map using laser altimetry.

articleTitle: Signal-to-noise ratio of Gaussian-state ghost imaging
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The signal-to-noise ratios of pseudothermal and biphoton ghost imagers are derived and compared by means of a unified Gaussian-state analysis.

articleTitle: Ultra-sensitive photonic crystal fiber refractive index sensor
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce a refractive index sensing geometry exploiting modes beyond cutoff in a selectively infiltrated PCF. We demonstrate a detection limit of 4.6 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup> RIU and sensitivity of 30,100 nm/RIU, a one-order-of-magnitude improvement over previous PCF sensors.

articleTitle: Ultrafast light blade
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Anisotropic sensitivity of isotropic medium to femtosecond laser radiation is observed. The phenomenon is explained by unusual anisotropy at the interface produced by ultrashort light pulses with tilted front and referred as ultrafast light blade.

articleTitle: Intermodal four-wave mixing in structured-core photonic crystal fiber: Experimental results
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Structuring the core of a photonic crystal fiber is used to fulfill the phase-matching condition required for broadband intermodal four-wave mixing. Experimental data show efficient red generation on LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> mode from 1064 nm pumping.

articleTitle: Multiple-pass tapered fiber-optic sensor with logarithmic detection
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report doubling of sensitivity for tapered fiber-optic sensors with logarithmic detection when light passes through the tapered region twice. Further sensitivity enhancement is possible with multiple passes through the taper.

articleTitle: High dynamic range optical system for direct detection of exo-planets by unbalanced nulling interferometer and adaptive optics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
