publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spin flip in a 2D electron gas is realized with a 2 ps, off-resonant laser pulse. Complete spin flip leads to spin precessions that are symmetric with respect to the arrival time of the pi-pulse.

articleTitle: Tunable Narrow-band Terahertz Generation at Quasi-phase matched crystals using femtosecond laser pulse
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Terahertz pulse were generated in periodically poled lithium niobate and lithium tantalate around 1.4 and 0.6 THz with band-width off 20 GHz. The generated intensity was rapidly increased depending on temperature decreasing of the crystal.

articleTitle: All-optical modulation of four wave mixing in a Rb-filled hollow-core photonic band-gap fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate efficient modulation of four-wave mixing in a Rb-waveguide system via application of a weak ldquoswitchingrdquo field. We observe 3 dB attenuation of the signal field with only 3600 photons of ldquoswitchingrdquo energy.

articleTitle: A single ion interacting with single spontaneous parametric down-conversion photons
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a tunable, frequency-stabilized, narrow-bandwidth source of frequency-degenerate, entangled photon pairs, which can address the two D-P transitions in <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sup>Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ions. We also demonstrate single ion-single photon interaction by the detection of quantum jumps.

articleTitle: High repetition rate bismuth borate optical parametric oscillator pumped by a cavity-dumped Nd:YLF laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a bismuth borate optical parametric oscillator pumped by cavity-dumped Nd:YLF laser delivering low jitter 9.5ns millijoule pulses at 1 kHz tunable from 720 to 900 nm that is ideally suited for photoacoustic medical imaging.

articleTitle: Amplitude modulation of quantum cascade laser with vertically coupled cavities
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We developed a three terminal mid-infrared quantum cascade laser. The third terminal allows one to electrically modulate the optical losses and thus the laser output-independently of the laser's driving current.

articleTitle: Optical properties of 1-D active fibonacci quasicrystals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quasicrystals based on the excitonic resonances of GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wells were grown with spacings that satisfy a Fibonacci sequence. Linear and nonlinear reflectivity and photoluminescence measurements were performed, agreeing quite well with theory.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband second-harmonic generation in slant-stripetype periodically-poled RbTiOPO4
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that the retracing behavior based in slant-stripe-type periodically-poled RbTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> can be used to efficiently achieve second-harmonic generation within an ultra-wide spectral range of 1.7-4.0 mum.

articleTitle: Pulse characterization and arbitrary waveform generation via spectral phase comb shaping
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spectral phase comb shaping is shown to be a powerful concept for phase-only generation and in-situ characterization of arbitrary optical pulse sequences, where the temporal shape of every pulse in the train is controlled independently.

articleTitle: Recent progress in electrically pumped blue GaN-based VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Recent progress on fabrication technology and demonstration of current injection GaN-based blue VCSELs are presented. Performance of current injection blue VCSELs with threshold current of 1.4 mA and emission wavelength of 462 nm are described.

articleTitle: Spectroscopic sensing at the quantum limit by active cavity impedance matching
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an active cavity impedance matching control technique using radio-frequency amplitude modulation homodyne interferometry, and show it can be used for absorption spectrometry at the quantum limit for both narrow and broadband molecular transitions.

articleTitle: Adjustable polarization mode dispersion compensation using 3D hollow waveguide Bragg reflector
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An adjustable polarization mode dispersion compensator with a variable tapered-3D-hollow-waveguide Bragg-reflector has been demonstrated exhibiting a giant-birefringence of 0.01 and a 13-psec tuning in differential-group-delay for a 3-mm-long compact device.

articleTitle: Engineering anti-bunching via photon blockade in photonic crystal cavity-quantum dot systems
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Methods to improve single photon generation via photon-blockade in a photonic-crystal cavity with a strongly coupled quantum-dot are presented. With realistic system parameters, significant improvement in second-order-auto-correlation g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (0) (from 0.93 to 0.79) is achieved.

articleTitle: Broadband heterodyne NSOM characterization of propagation loss in waveguide bends
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use a heterodyne NSOM with superluminescent diode illumination to measure the loss in an SOI waveguide around a bend. For a bend of radius 10 mum, we measure loss of 0.09 dB.

articleTitle: Investigation of the self-injection locked behaviour of a continuous wave Nd:YAG ring laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: External redirection of light from one propagation direction of a ring laser back into the opposite direction forces uni-directional operation. We investigated this so-called self-injection locking effect and achieved single-frequency operation.

articleTitle: Making a direct electrical contact to InGaN/GaN nanorod LEDs: High output power density
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We realize a new scheme for making a direct contact to a two-dimensional (2D) nanorod LED array using the oblique-angle deposition. More importantly, we demonstrate highly efficient carrier injection into the nanorods.

articleTitle: High-average-power cryogenically-cooled picosecond Yb:YAG amplifier seeded by a fiber CPA system
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a 300-W-level picosecond laser based on a cryogenically-cooled Yb:YAG amplifier seeded by a fiber CPA system. High-average-power picosecond second harmonic generation is also presented.

articleTitle: Slow and stopped images
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the slowing and stopping of transverse images in a hot atomic vapor. The images are shown to be robust to decohering mechanisms. The hot vapor is also shown to preserve quantum fields.

articleTitle: Gain-assisted surface plasmon microcavity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The enhancement of cavity Q factor of a gain-assisted surface plasmon microcavity is experimentally demonstrated. This is believed to be the first experimental demonstration of gain-assisted cavity Q enhancement in a surface plasmon microcavity.

articleTitle: A compact kHz-repetition-rate 2-mJ sub-200-fs cw-pumped Yb,Na:CaF2 amplifier
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a novel broadband Yb-doped crystal close-loop cooled at -130degC we demonstrate a 2-6-W multi-kilohertz amplifier delivering sub-200-fs pulses with energies up to 2 mJ. This technology is straightforwardly scalable toward a kHz-repetition-rate multi-mJ output.

articleTitle: Optical coherence tomography based on intensity correlations of quasi-thermal light
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show theoretically that the longitudinal resolution of conventional optical coherence tomography can be improved by a factor of radic2 when a two-photon (as opposed to a single-photon) sensitive detector is used, and we present preliminary supporting results.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal pulse-train solitons
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose spatiotemporal solitons that consist of trains of short pulses. The pulses are collectively trapped in the transversal directions by a slow nonlinearity and each pulse is self-trapped temporally by a fast nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Optical parametric amplification in the NIR in a gaseous medium by use of a hollow fibre
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate efficient parametric generation of ≫ 4 µJ, 80 fs pulses centered at 1:3 µm in a gas-filled hollow fibre. The measured bandwidth supports few cycle, passively CEP-locked infrared pulses for EUV and attosecond physics.

articleTitle: Growths of InGaN quantum wells light-emitting diodes on nano-patterned AGOG sapphire substrate using abbreviated growth mode
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nanoheteroepitaxy of InGaN-based light-emitting diodes on patterned AGOG sapphire by using abbreviated growth mode, leads to significant reduction in dislocation density and 24% increase in efficiency

articleTitle: Power scaling of Yb-free, Er-doped fiber laser with resonant clad pumping
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report resonantly cladding-pumped Yb-free Er-doped fiber laser delivering ~48 W of CW output at 1590 nm with ~57% efficiency. It is believed to be the highest power ever reported from Yb-free, Er-doped LMA fiber.

articleTitle: Level Crossing in toroidal on-chip microcavities
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Level crossing between optical whispering-gallery modes is studied in toroidal microcavities. We photograph azimuthal and radial envelope patterns of crossed optical modes. We also investigate anti-crossing between modes and polarization evolution.

articleTitle: Properties of the exciton inner ring at ultra-low temperatures and high magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the properties of the exciton inner ring in coupled quantum wells at ultra-low temperatures (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">bath</sub> = 175 mK) and in high magnetic fields.

articleTitle: Resonance spacing tuning in traveling-wave resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose an interferometric coupling scheme for tuning the spacing between resonances in a traveling-wave resonator. 62pm (8 GHz) tuning of resonance spacing is demonstrated in SOI micro-ring resonators integrated with thin-film micro-heaters.

articleTitle: Long-range surface plasmon polariton waveguides for visible light applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report long-range plasmonic waveguides with a dye-compatible cladding material, exhibiting visible-light propagation lengths up to 0.5 mm. Experimentally determined propagation lengths are compared to simulations and a strategy for further improvements is identified.

articleTitle: Space-time distortion elimination for shaped ultrafast laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report design parameters to eliminate or minimize the spatial distortion for shaped femtosecond pulses after a Fourier-transform pulse shaper, theoretically and experimentally. We conclude that all distortions are avoided with correct pulse shaper setup.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal characterization of nonlinear propagation of femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear propagation through optically transparent media is characterized using spatially resolved spectral interferometry. Spatio-temporal coupling given by the nonlinear effect is quantified and several methods are compared to show their respective advantages.

articleTitle: InGaAs quantum well nanoneedles on silicon with long wavelength emission for silicon transparency
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report novel single-crystalline wurtzite InGaAs/GaAs core-shell quantum well nanoneedles with photoluminescence below the 1.12 eV silicon bandgap, grown on GaAs or Si. This long wavelength enables integration with silicon waveguides and CMOS devices.

articleTitle: Microwave frequency transfer by propagation of an optical frequency comb over optical fibre
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The repetition rate of a mode-locked laser is transferred over 50 km of spooled fibre with instability below 5 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-15</sup> tau<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1/2</sup>, rendering this technique suitable for disseminating state-of-the-art microwave oscillators and optically-derived microwave references.

articleTitle: Very short polarization splitting/combining using two horizontally-slotted waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a very short polarization splitter/combiner using two horizontally-slotted waveguides. A 46.7-mum conversion length is achieved with 22 dB extinction ratio. The bandwidth is 18 nm for ER>20 dB.

articleTitle: Functionalized fiber optic devices for surface enhanced Raman scattering detection and optical trapping
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This work demonstrates two fiber optic devices: one device detects in situ surface enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) from remote analytes, and the other is designed to perform three-dimensional trapping of small particles.

articleTitle: Stable entire-length measurement of fiber strain distribution by Brillouin optical correlation-domain reflectometry based on polarization scrambling scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a stable entire-length measurement of fiber strain distribution by suppressing the fluctuation of Brillouin gain spectrum based on a polarization scrambling scheme. In the experiment, strain distribution along the entire length of a 100-m fiber was successfully measured with 40-cm spatial resolution and 19-Hz sampling rate.

articleTitle: Tunable and passively Q-switched Nd:YVO4 laser using a chirped volume Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser was locked with a chirped volume Bragg grating. Tuning was performed from 1063 nm to 1065 nm by grating translation with 4 W maximum output power. With Cr:YAG, Q-switched pulses with 17 ns, 8 muJ were achieved.

articleTitle: 13.2 nm table-top inspection microscope for extreme ultraviolet lithography mask defect characterization
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a reflection microscope that operates at 13.2-nm wavelength with a spatial resolution of 55 plusmn 3 nm. The microscope uses a table-top EUV laser to acquire images of photolithography masks in 20 seconds.

articleTitle: Tapered fibres embedded in silica aerogel
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We embedded thin (down to 2 mum diameter) tapered fibres in silica aerogel with low loss. The aerogel is rigid but behaves refractively like air, protecting the tapered fibre without disturbing light propagation along it.

articleTitle: Long time revival of femtosecond laser plasma filaments in air
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the revival of short lived femtosecond laser induced plasma channels in air by a nanosecond laser pulse up to several milliseconds after plasma recombination. Such revived plasma channel is generated over 50 cm using a Bessel-like nanosecond laser beam.

articleTitle: Power scaling of CCC fiber based lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate robustly single-mode power scaling in fiber laser systems built using 35-mum core Yb-doped double-clad chirally-coupled-core (CCC) fibers. Up to 250 W have been demonstrated up to date and further power scaling is in progress.

articleTitle: Measurements and calculations of two-beam coupling in air
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We performed experiments demonstrated an effective energy-exchange between filament-forming beams intersecting in air. Theory considering the impulsive stimulated Raman response as the relevant nonlinear mechanism reproduces data well and points toward techniques for optimization.

articleTitle: Fidelity of a conditional quantum teleportation protocol based on imperfect detection of collective spontaneous emission
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We employ quantum trajectory theory to model temporally resolved photodetection of collective emission from a pair of atoms to investigate the performance of a conditional quantum teleportation protocol. We include effects of imperfect photodetection.

articleTitle: Er:LiCAF as potential vacuum ultraviolet laser material at 163 nm
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Vacuum ultraviolet fluorescence from micro-pulling down method-grown Er:LiCAF is found to have 163-nm peak emission with 1.3-mus lifetime, making it one of the shortest emission wavelengths from solid-state materials reported.

articleTitle: Improved sensitivity spontaneous raman scattering multi-gas sensor
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a backward-wave spontaneous-Raman multi-gas sensor employing a hollow-core photonic-bandgap-fiber to contain gasses and increase interaction length. Silica Raman noise and detection speed are reduced using a digital spatial filter and a cladding seal.

articleTitle: Heterodyne optical sampling for picosecond ultrasonics and nanoscale heat transfer
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel ultrafast pump-probe system, allowing for a drastic reduction in acquisition time, typically a few tens of minutes for 20,000 frames. We present acoustic waves and heat transfer measurements in nanometric layers.

articleTitle: Polarization dependent pulse compression through hollow fiber for mJ-level, Sub-5fs pulse generation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 4.3 fs, 1 mJ pulses at 1 kHz are generated through hollow fiber seeded with circularly polarized laser beam. This technique provides an effective energy upscaling approach for hollow fiber compression technique.

articleTitle: Phase-stabilized 167 MHz repetition frequency carbon nanotube fiber laser frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The frequency comb generated by a high repetition frequency erbium-doped fiber ring laser using carbon nanotube saturable absorber is phase-stabilized for the first time. The comb's stability is compared a photonic crystal fiber acetylene reference.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical control of terahertz surface plasmon polariton in subwavelength hole-arrays at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate ultrafast optical control of surface plasmon assisted terahertz (THz) transmission in a subwavelength metallic hole array on a semiconductor substrate. The transient photoconductivity of the substrate allows modulation of the THz resonance amplitude via optical excitation with a time scale of ~10 ps.

articleTitle: Slow and fast light in optical fibers: Review and perspectives
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fiber slow light systems are at a turning point moving from a laboratory research to real applications. The possibility to shape the spectral resonance in Brillouin slow light leads to optimized configurations and innovative solutions.

articleTitle: A widely tunable chirped-grating distributed-feedback laser for spectroscopic applications
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 65-nm quasi-continuous tuning range is reported for a 3.5-mm-wide optically pumped type-II chirped-grating distributed-feedback laser at 3.2 mum. Methane absorption spectra demonstrate the utility of this source for atmospheric-pressure molecular spectroscopy.

articleTitle: 2D confinement and reduction of polarization dependence in hollow waveguide with high index contrast grating
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A tunable hollow waveguide with distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) mirror and a high-index-contrast-grating (HCG) mirror has been proposed. We numerically show the possibility of 2D-confinement and reduction in polarization-dependence of the proposed hollow waveguide.

articleTitle: Conformal coating of tailored photonic crystals fabricated using multiphoton lithography
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Titania sol-gel and silver electro-less deposition processes were utilized to apply conformal coatings to multiphoton lithographically fabricated polymer photonic crystal templates, resulting in enhanced refractive index and stop band reflectivity.

articleTitle: Nanoscale optical field localization by resonantly focused plasmons
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A plasmonic resonant nano-focusing-antenna has been experimentally integrated with a Si waveguide to effectively convert an incoming waveguide mode to a localized plasmon mode and focus light in an ultrasmall volume in all 3 dimensions.

articleTitle: Ultrafast dynamics of band-edge photonic crystals lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Temporal characteristics of band-edge photonic crystal lasers were explored with high resolution up-conversion system. The InGaAs/InP photonic crystal laser operates at room temperature at 1.55 mum with temporal responses indicating modulation speeds greater than 25 GHz.

articleTitle: Recent advances in microstructured fibers for power delivery
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report recent advances in the development of fibers for the delivery of both single and heavily multimode laser beams in spectral regimes spanning the visible to mid-IR.

articleTitle: Fused microfiber resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a ~2.6 mm-diameter optical ring resonator fabricated from a 7.2 mum-thick silica fiber with a CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser-fused coupling region for mechanical robustness. We experimentally obtain a Q-factor of ges25,000 at 1.55 mum.

articleTitle: Spectral characterization of heicoidal long-period gratings in photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report helicoidal long-period grating by twisting photonic crystal fiber under CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser irradiation and investigated its novel characteristics. The fabricated PCF-LPG endows unique resonance tuning capability with low polarization-dependent loss and thermal shift.

articleTitle: Observation of nontrivial 3-photon correlation of chaotic thermal light
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The reported experiment observed a nontrivial third-order temporal correlation of chaotic-thermal light in the joint-detection of three individual photodetectors. It seems that the thermal photons are always ldquobunchedrdquo in triples. In the view of quantum mechanics, ldquothree-photon bunchingrdquo is a three-photon interference effect.

articleTitle: Soliton interaction in dispersion-managed fibers: Formation of the soliton molecule
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a perturbation theory explaining the interaction of adjacent dispersion managed solitons. A stable equilibrium separation and oscillations around it are found. The model is validated by comparison to experimental and numerical results.

articleTitle: Self-assembled metal nanocluster metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A bottom-up approach based on template-directed colloidal self-assembly was used for fabricating metal nanocluster based matematerials and their optical properties were studied experimentally. Negative index material composed of nanoclusters and metal wires was numerically demonstrated.

articleTitle: Magnetic dipoles induced in dielectric spheres: Coupled interactions
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the coupling of magnetic dipoles, induced in dielectric spheres. The spheres are configured in chains and rings, which also form effective media. The results have applications toward more complicated metamaterials and plasmonic devices.

articleTitle: High aspect ratio metamaterials for enhanced tunability and sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a proton beam based lithography process, we fabricate and study high aspect ratio metamaterials, revealing distinct 3-dimensional resonances. Increased aspect ratio also leads to enhanced tunability and sensitivity for practical applications.

articleTitle: Tm:germanate fiber laser for planetary water vapor atmospheric profiling
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The atmospheric profiling of water vapor is necessary for finding life on Mars and weather on Earth. The design and performance of a water vapor lidar based on a Tm:germanate fiber laser is presented.

articleTitle: Polarization switching in a quasi-periodic nonlinear photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical intensity-dependent polarization switching, based on double phase-matched cascaded processes in a quadratic nonlinear photonic quasi-crystal. The efficiency is significantly better than that of devices based on cascaded cubic nonlinearities.

articleTitle: 1.88 µm InGaAsP pumped, room temperature Ho:LuAG laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A room temperature, directly diode pumped Ho:LuAG laser oscillated for the first time. Direct pumping of the Ho upper laser manifold maximizes efficiency, minimizes heating, and eliminates Ho:Tm energy sharing. Design and performance are presented.

articleTitle: Ethylene trace detection by quartz enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ethylene (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) absorption line intensity at 6172.95 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> was determined for trace gas detection. C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> trace concentration measurements were performed using quartz enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy (QEPAS) with a sensitivity of 1.3 ppmv (1σ) for τ=1s time constant. The effect of modulation frequency accuracy on QEPAS signal was investigated.

articleTitle: High fidelity quantum entanglement and spin-spin dynamics using multiple phonon modes of several trapped ions
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate quantum entanglement and global spin dynamics between a few trapped ions, using lasers that couple to all modes of transverse motion in a way that could be scaled to large numbers of spins.

articleTitle: Serial time encoded amplified microscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an imaging method that maps a 2D image into a serial time-domain waveform and simultaneously amplifies it optically. Continuous real-time images at a record frame rate of 6.1 MHz are captured using an oscilloscope.

articleTitle: Improved multiplexed infrared detectors for high-rate single-photon detection
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an actively-switched multiplexed infrared photon-counting system that increases counting rates at telecom wavelengths via deadtime, afterpulsing, and background-count reduction. We report a factor of 5 count-rate increase with just two multiplexed detectors.

articleTitle: Recombination dynamics of photogenerated carriers in 10.4 µm-cutoff photodiodes consisting of W-structured superlattices
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We used pump-probe technique to investigate recombination dynamics of photogenerated carriers in photodiodes consisting of InAs/GaInSb W-structured superlattices. Recombination time constants of 1.6 ns and 10 ns were measured under high and low powers, respectively.

articleTitle: Giant modal gain in a metal-semiconductor waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that a giant modal gain is achievable near surface plasmon resonance for guided modes in a metal-semiconductor-metal plasmonic waveguide. The giant gain is shown to originate from a reduction of average energy velocity.

articleTitle: Monolithic SHG ring resonator passively coupled to an external cavity enhanced broad area laser diode
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 126 mW visible light were generated by frequency doubling using bulk PPLN in a high finesse ring cavity pumped by a BAL ECDL. The locking between the two cavities is managed purely optical.

articleTitle: 100 GHz passively mode-locked Er:Yb:glass laser at 1.5 µm and identification of transverse cavity-mode degeneracies
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A fundamentally mode-locked Er:Yb:glass laser with a record high repetition rate of 101 GHz generates 30 mW average power in 1.1-ps pulses in the 1.5-mum telecom window. Frequency degeneracies of transverse cavity-modes are investigated.

articleTitle: RT Mid-IR random lasing of Cr2+ doped ZnS, ZnSe, CdSe powders, polymer liquid and polymer films
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate room temperature (RT) middle-infrared (Mid-IR) random lasing of chromium- (Cr) doped ZnSe, ZnS, and CdSe powders, the powders imbedded in perfluorocarbon liquid polymer solutions, and fluorocarbon polymer films.

articleTitle: Sawtooth grating-assisted-phase-matching
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A quasi-phase-matching method where the modulation has a sawtooth profile and the phase-mismatch is almost fully corrected is suggested. Schemes for implementing sawtooth grating-assisted-phase-matching in low-order as well as high-order harmonic generation are proposed.

articleTitle: Lasing on higher-order whispering gallery modes at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a direct method to observe higher-order whispering gallery modes in vertical cavity surface emitting lasers (VCSELs) at room temperature. Instead of introducing any defect mode, we show that suppression of lower-order cavity modes can be achieved by destroying vertical reflectors with a surface micro-structure. Perfect whispering gallery modes with an azimuthal number as large as 41 are observed in experiments through collecting near-field radiation patterns, as well as in numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Actively controlled tuning of an external cavity diode laser by polarization spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using polarization spectroscopy to control the shape of the diode current ramp while tuning an external cavity diode laser we achieved mode-hop free tuning of up to 105 GHz with an uncoated, off-the-shelf laser diode.

articleTitle: Quantitative analysis of Coulomb-induced nonlinearities in semiconductor quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report quantitative spectrally-resolved transient absorption in GaAs quantum wells for varying pump intensity. Comparison to microscopic modeling yields quantitative information about the Coulomb-induced nonlinearities and radiative coupling.

articleTitle: All-glass leakage channel fibers with fluorine-doped silica pump cladding
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Direct amplification of ultra short pulses at 1037 nm from fiber-oscillators to average powers of ~100 W at 48 MHz is demonstrated using single-stage amplifiers comprising new all-glass-leakage-channel-fibers, providing >70% slope efficiency and >33 dB gain.

articleTitle: Low finesse Fabry-Perot cavities for wide spaced frequency combs with large spectral bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use low finesse Fabry-Perot cavities in series to generate frequency combs with large mode spacing by simultaneously maintaining high spectral bandwidth. The attenuation of laser modes closest to the pass band exceeds 70 dB relative to the modes centered within the pass band for a 5 GHz Fabry-Perot filtering a 250 MHz frequency comb.

articleTitle: Fourier transform spectrometry with a near infrared supercontinuum source
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Near-infrared Fourier transform absorption spectrometry with a supercontinuum (SC) source is demonstrated for trace methane detection. The SC source allows for long distance propagation while exhibiting amplitude noise ten times greater than comparable incandescent sources.

articleTitle: Micro-joule energy, mid-IR pulses with 9-cycle duration from a 100 kHz OPCPA source
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel mid-IR OPCPA source generates 9.0 cycle pulses (96 fs at 3.2 mum) with 1.2 muJ energy at 100 kHz, and is expected to be intrinsically CEP stable. The minimum Fourier transform limited pulse duration is 45 fs, or 4.2 cycles.

articleTitle: Optical resonances created by photonic transitions
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A high-Q optical resonance can be created dynamically, by inducing photonic transition between a localized state and a one-dimensional continuum through refractive index modulation. This mechanism allows for complete control of an optical micro-resonance.

articleTitle: Experimental realization of quantum teleportation as cluster computation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate quantum teleportation of a coherent state as cluster computation using a four-mode linear cluster state. This is the first example of realization of cluster computation in continuous-variable systems.

articleTitle: Plasmon resonance variation from strongly interacting gold nanorods
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electron energy loss spectroscopy combined with spectral imaging in a transmission electron microscope is used to probe and map the energy distribution of the optical-frequency surface plasmons of coupled gold nanorods. Local field enhancement and spectral shift of the surface plasmon modes is observed when two nanoparticles are electromagnetically coupled.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon polaritons in silver-gold sandwich structure
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose to use silver/gold sandwich structures to combine the advantages of silver and gold - two materials of choice for nanoplasmonics and metamaterials. We report on the preparation, characterization, and theoretical modeling of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Colorful photonic band gap fiber-based textiles
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Polymer Bragg fiber-enabled, color changing photonic textiles are demonstrated. Such textiles show intrinsic and uniform lateral light extraction and evolutive visuals using both passive and active color control.

articleTitle: Full nonlinear conversion of a 200 nm comb produced by multiple four-wave mixing in a highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 100-nm comb of optical frequencies spaced by 400 GHz at 790 nm was obtained by second harmonic generation of an optical frequency comb produced by multiple four-wave-mixing in a highly nonlinear optical fiber.

articleTitle: GaSb-based laser diodes operating within spectral range of 2 – 3.5 µm
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the performance parameters of GaSb-based diode lasers operating in spectral region from 2 to 3.36 mum. CW output power levels of 120 mW at 3 mum, 60 mW at 3.1 mum, and 15 mW at 3.36 mum (285 K) are reported.

articleTitle: Single-photon traversal of dielectric stacks
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We examine single-photon bandgap traversal times. We see significant change in traversal times due to subtle differences in stack structures. We also analyze how propagation through inhomogeneous media affects Hong-Ou-Mandel visibility.

articleTitle: Ultrafast spin dynamics in spin-polarized vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser devices
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spin-polarized lasers offer new encouraging possibilities for future devices. We compare time-resolved luminescence measurements with theoretical models for spin dynamics in spin-polarized lasers and demonstrate ultrafast polarization switching during one short single-mode laser pulse.

articleTitle: Distributed sensing in a long-length FBG based on synthesis of optical coherence function with 1-kHz sampling rate
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Measurement of Bragg wavelength distribution inside a long-length fiber Bragg grating is demonstrated with a higher sampling speed based on synthesis of optical coherence function to realize a real time sensing. The local reflection spectrum is acquired with 1-kHz sampling rate and the total distribution is measured with 1-Hz measurement speed.

articleTitle: Phase shift of a weak coherent beam by a single atom
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measured the phase shift imposed by a single <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb atom to a light field. We observed a value of 1° for a focused Gaussian beam interacting near-resonantly with an atomic two-level system.

articleTitle: Laser performance at room-temperature of diode-pumped Yb3+ :YLF and Yb3+:CaF2 crystals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the laser performance of diode-pumped Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YLF and Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> crystals operating in continuous wave (CW) and quasi-CW lasing at room temperature with high efficiency power. Furthermore we probed thermal effects on the materials.

articleTitle: Frequency conversion of spontaneously emitted photons in a nonlinear photonic crystal nanocavity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically demonstrate high fidelity frequency conversion of a photon generated by a dipole-like emitter in a double mode nonlinear cavity irradiated by a classical field, and propose a realistic photonic crystal nanocavity implementation.

articleTitle: A versatile, single-waveguide, photon-pair source for chip-scale quantum communication
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a bright, bandwidth-engineerable, compact, quasi-phase-matched single-waveguide source generating photon pairs near 900 nm and 1300 nm. Coincidence spectra are measured for a periodically-poled KTiOPO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> waveguide for both type-0 and type-I spontaneous parametric down-conversion.

articleTitle: Large-area linear and nonlinear nanophotonics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Interferometric lithography provides a facile technique for the fabrication of large-areas of nanophotonic structures. Examples of both linear and nonlinear responses will be drawn from plasmonics, metamaterials, and photonic crystals.

articleTitle: Stereometamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce a novel concept to nano-photonics, namely stereometamaterials. Specifically, we study stacked twisted split-ring resonator metamaterials and demonstrate how their optical properties depend on the particular arrangement of the individual constituents.

articleTitle: Low-loss splicing of photonic crystal fibres by controlled hole collapse
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Low-loss splices have been formed between small-core photonic crystal fibres and fibres with much larger mode field diameters. The PCF's core is enlarged using controlled hole collapse before splicing with a conventional electric-arc fusion splicer.

articleTitle: Shannon dimensionality of quantum channels
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce the Shannon dimensionality D to quantify the capacity of quantum channels. This is applied to angular entanglement of photons. Experimentally, D varies from 3 to 6 and values up to 50 are feasible.

articleTitle: Sodium-yellow laser generation from a three-stage χ(2) process in an optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigated three-stage nonlinear frequency conversion in an optical parametric oscillator to generate laser radiation at 589 nm. We successfully demonstrated the sodium-yellow radiation at a threshold of 650 W by using a 1064-nm pump laser.

articleTitle: Near infrared optical upconverter based on i-In0.53Ga0.47As/C60 photovoltaic junction
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a near-infrared to visible-light optical upconverter by the integration of an i-In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.53</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.47</inf>As/C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</inf> junction and organic light emitting diode. This device shows the photovoltaic effect of i-In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.53</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.47</inf>As/C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</inf> junction and application in optical upconverter.

articleTitle: A high-optical quality supramolecular assembly for third-order nonlinear optics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an organic supramoleular assembly with a high off-resonant third-order susceptibility, easy fabrication into homogeneous thin films, and high-optical quality for ultra-fast all optical data processing.

articleTitle: A neglected noise source in quantum optics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In the nonlinear interaction of intense beams with a crystal inside an optical cavity, phonon scattering of the central carrier into sidebands acts as a source of extra phase noise for experiments in quantum optics.

articleTitle: Fire detection with a compact, 2.3 µm VCSEL-based carbon monoxide sensor
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel compact sensor approach utilizing the wide current tunability of VCSELs and employing reference gas in the photodetector is tested under diverse standard conditions for fire detection.

articleTitle: Coherent imaging nano-patterning with extreme ultraviolet laser illumination
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a high resolution extreme ultraviolet patterning approach based on Talbot self imaging and holographic projection imaging using for illumination a table top extreme ultraviolet laser.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon enhanced emission from InGaN single-quantum-well light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electrically injected surface plasmon LEDs have been demonstrated for InGaN light emitting diodes with emission at 460 nm. A seven times enhancement has been observed at high currents with larger enhancements observed at lower currents.

articleTitle: Spectral cleaning of few-cycle pulses via cross-polarized wave (XPW) generation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The nonlinear contrast filtering technique XPW is applied to sub-10 fs pulses. The process can dramatically improve the spectral quality of the seed pulses, opening the way to the production of high-temporal quality few-cycle pulses.

articleTitle: Direct evidence of intensity correlation of broadband incoherent cw sources at ultrashort timescale by second-order interferometry with a two-photon-absorption detector
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The second-order coherence properties of highly-incoherent cw sources (true blackbody and amplified spontaneous emission) are directly evidenced at femtosecond timescales by use of an interferometric autocorrelator based on a two-photon absorption in a GaAs phototube.

articleTitle: Incoherent surface-solitons in effectively- instantaneous nonlinear media
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study, theoretically and experimentally, random-phase surface-solitons in instantaneous nonlocal nonlinear media, where the key mechanism for self-trapping is played by the nonlocal nature of the nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Closed-loop optimization of the temporal duration of a 21fs, 4 mJ CPA laser system with high B-integral
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present automated optimization of the temporal duration of femtosecond pulses generated in a CPA laser system with high B-integral. Both phase measurement and correction were done by a single AOPDF within the CPA system.

articleTitle: High-precision contouring of rapidly oscillating optical surfaces with two-wavelength single-shot digital holography
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel method for contouring of optical surfaces with unprecedented dynamic range is presented. At an object depth >50 mum, surface deformations of a MEMS of some 10 nm are still unambiguously detectable.

articleTitle: Effect of laser transfer mechanism on damage to organic semiconducting molecules during laser direct-write printing
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By employing different laser forward-transfer techniques, we probe the effects of transfer mechanism on the damage of sensitive organic molecules. Thick-film polymer absorbing layers provide the maximum optical and thermal protection for the molecules.

IEEE Keywords: Active matrix organic light emitting diodes

articleTitle: Impedance of square and hexagonal photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We rigorously define an impedance for photonic crystals, which generally needs to be a matrix. We use it to design a two-layer anti-reflection coating for a frequency where the bulk crystal reflects over 50%.

articleTitle: Phase matching of high harmonic generation in the water window and beyond at high pressures using mid-IR lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that using longer-wavelength driving light in high-order harmonic generation requires moderately ionized larger-density atoms to perfectly phase match the process, scaling conventional phase matching at low ionization to extremely high photon energies.

articleTitle: Very-large-scale photonic crystal coupled cavity waveguides with large delay per pulse width ratio
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A pulse delay more than ten times the pulse width was experimentally achieved in low-loss coupled cavity waveguides formed by 300 photonic crystal nanocavities.

articleTitle: Efficient third-harmonic generation through tailored IR femtosecond laser pulse filamentation in air
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Third-harmonic generation during filamentation of IR femtosecond laser pulses in air experiences strong spatial reshaping and conversion enhancement when a thin plasma string created by another femtosecond pulse is introduced perpendicularly to the filament's path.

articleTitle: Passive synchronization between self-similar Yb-Fiber and stretched-pulse Er-fiber mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Passive synchronization is demonstrated between the self-similar Yb-fiber and the stretched-pulse Er-fiber mode-locked lasers. The pulse repetition rates of the two mode-locked lasers can keep locked when multiple-pulse bound states or periodic pulse collisions occur.

articleTitle: Low divergence single mode edge emitting double metal Terahertz quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the use of a third order distributed feedback waveguide for double metal THz quantum cascade laser as a successful design to obtain high slope efficiency of 50 mW/A, spectral emission control and narrow single lobed far field (5degtimes 8deg).

articleTitle: Optimization of microresonator parameters for a quartz-enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy sensor
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A quartz-enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy based gas sensor was optimized to improve its compact spectrophone design and performance. The impact of a 2-tube microresonator geometry on the detected signal and signal to noise ratio (SNR) was investigated. Experimental studies demonstrate that the l=4.4 mm long tubes (ID=0.5 mm) result in a significantly enhanced SNR.

articleTitle: Transform limited 100 µJ pulses non-linear fiber CPA with mismatched stretchers and compressor
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a fiber CPA system producing 100 muJ energy pulses with quasi transform limited duration of 267 fs at a repetition rate of 300 kHz leading to a peak power of 345 MW.

articleTitle: From molecular nonlinear optics to nano-biophotonics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Current advances in molecular nonlinear optics will be reviewed in the light of early concepts, so as to evidence continuity and evolutions. We will concentrate on all-optical orientation, the nanoscale and applications to bio-imaging.

articleTitle: Record-high powers for narrowband backward terahertz generation from periodically-poled lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have generated the backward terahertz pulses with record-high average powers of 2.3-11 muW and narrowest bandwidth of 6 GHz from multi-grating periodically-poled lithium niobate by optical rectification at room temperature.

articleTitle: Atomic nanofabrication of periodic structures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Metastable helium has 20 eV of internal energy that destroys a resist assembled on a wafer. An optical standing wave was used to channel and focus the He* atoms into lines separated by lambda /2.

articleTitle: Observation of high-frequency coherent vibrational motion with strongly chirped probe pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe time-domain coherent vibrational wavepackets at 1585-cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> frequency (21-fs period) using broadband probe pulses strongly chirped up to 150-fs duration. The results are explained theoretically using the Wigner representation of the chirped pulse.

articleTitle: Chaotic microcavity laser with high quality and unidirectional output
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a chaotic microcavity laser which not only produces unidirectional emission but also has a quality factor of 22000. The output beam has a divergence angle less than 40 degree for all lasing modes.

articleTitle: Optical torques guide cell motility
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Through systematic experiments and stochastic modeling we demonstrate that cell motility can be guided by optical torques exerted by the light polarization. This torque affects the actin network which is responsible for cell's movement.

Author Keywords: 000.5490 Probability theory, stochastic processes, and statistics

articleTitle: On the practicality of quantum interferometry using photonic N00N states
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that attenuated N00N states lead to a worse phase estimate than an equally attenuated N separable state unless the transmittance of the medium is very high.

articleTitle: Differentiation of three isotopic variants of nitrous oxide based on spectra of rotational transitions
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have identified 68 rotational transitions from three isotopic variants of nitrous oxide, among which 29 were never observed previously. By deducing and comparing the rotational constants, we have reliably differentiated among three isotopic variants.

articleTitle: Flow monitoring in optofluidic channels using planar Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An integrated pressure/flow sensor using a direct UV written planar Bragg grating situated inside a flexible diaphragm of thickness 200 mum has been fabricated. The diaphragm is created by etching away the underlying silicon support.

articleTitle: B-dot probe study of two-color laser-produced elongated air filaments
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The generation of transient electrical current and terahertz radiation in two-color laser-produced plasma filaments is studied with a B-dot probe. The diagnostic can monitor transient electrical currents induced by two-color photoionization.

articleTitle: Coherent control of quinquethiophene photoluminescence
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe torsional phonons of quinquethiophene in the time-domain and exploit the coherence for controlling the photoluminescence yield. We use the pump-dump scheme with visible femtosecond pulses, detecting the time-integrated photoluminescence versus pump-dump delay.

articleTitle: Kilohertz tunable dispersion compensation with a bimorph piezo deformable mirror
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a new technique for dispersion compensation with >10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> fs<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> range and kilohertz tuning speed, enabling high-speed focal plane scanning of two-photon excited fluorescence in a temporal focusing setup.

articleTitle: Broadband two-dimensional multicolored arrays generation in a sapphire plate
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Broadband 2D multicolored arrays with more than nine periodic columns and rows were generated in a sapphire plate. Each spot of the 2D arrays has a Gaussian spatial and spectral profile and less than 3.7% RMS power stability. 2D multicolored discrete solitons is expected to be obtained using this method.

articleTitle: Selective TM01 and TE01 mode operation of Nd:YAG laser based on cavity stability incorporating thermal effects
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By varying the length of a flat-flat cavity, polarization selective operation of a Nd:YAG laser was achieved only in a stable region of either TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> or TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> mode based on cavity stability incorporating thermally effects.

articleTitle: Ultra-smooth lithium niobate single crystal photonic micro-structures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Thermal treatment of micro-structured lithium niobate, at temperatures close to the Curie point, induces preferential surface melting and re-crystallization. This process yields ultra-smooth single crystal superstructures suitable for fabrication of low scattering loss photonic micro-components.

articleTitle: Enhanced surface third harmonic generation from gold nanorods
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use a tightly focused ultrashort laser pulse to produce a third harmonic signal from an air-dielectric interface containing gold nanorods. When the fundamental frequency is resonant with the longitudinal plasmon of the nanorods, the third harmonic signal can be enhanced by more than 3 orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Bacteria manipulation with optically controlled fluidic valves
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optically controlled fluidic valves are utilized to concentrate and detect bacteria, selectively switch the pathway of the bacteria, and demonstrate bidirectional fluidic flow within a microfluidic channel.

articleTitle: Electro-optical properties of n-InGaN/p-GaN LED with p-side down with varying indium composition
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The negative polarization charge at the n-InGaN/p-GaN interface of single heterojunction LEDs with p-side down are investigated for various In-compositions. We demonstrate peak emission wavelength blue-shift and intensity dependence on In-composition with increasing current density.

articleTitle: Observation of UV surface plasmon interference
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first direct observation of the UV SPPs using a UV compatible near field scanning optical microscope system. Subwavelength interference phenomenon in 1D and 2D are both observed.

articleTitle: Terahertz electrical measurement of single-walled carbon nanotube transistors
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe the first terahertz electrical measurements of single-walled carbon nanotube transistors. A picosecond ballistic electron resonance is directly observed in the time-domain. These results demonstrate a powerful new tool for directly probing picosecond electron motion in nanostructures.

articleTitle: Tunable, nanoscale free-electron source of photons and plasmons
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The passage of a free-electron beam through a nano-hole in a periodically layered metal/dielectric structure creates a new type of tuneable, nanoscale radiation source, analogous to the free-electron laser - a ‘light-well’.

articleTitle: Measurement of the oxygen (1-0) band at 690 nm using continuous-wave cavity ring-down spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have measured the (1-0) band of the b<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>Sigma<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-X<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>Sigma<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> system in molecular oxygen at pressures ranging from 25 torr to 500 torr using continuous-wave cavity ring-down spectroscopy (CW-CRDS).

articleTitle: Flexible wide angle terahertz resonant absorber based on perfectly impedance matched metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the design, fabrication and characterization of a highly flexible metamaterial absorber that experimentally obtains an absorptivity of 0.96 at 1.6 THz and operates over wide angular range for transverse electric and transverse magnetic radiation.

articleTitle: Near-infrared in vivo fluorescence sensor with integrated dielectric emission filter
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a monolithically integrated near-infrared fluorescence sensor incorporating a dielectric emission filter for in vivo applications. We successfully integrated a dielectric emission filter (OD3) onto a low-noise detector and sensed 50 nM fluorescent dye concentration.

articleTitle: Exploring the limits of single emitter detection in fluorescence and extinction
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show experimentally that the signal-to-noise ratio of extinction detection can be advantageous to fluorescence measurements of a single molecule. We discuss the prospects of detecting weak emitters such as rare earth ions.

articleTitle: Peak power scaling towards ultrashort pulses at high repetition rates
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present two scaling concepts for fiber based system. Ultrashort pulses with high peak power are generated while maintaining the advantages of fiber laser systems such as high repetition rate and good beam quality.

articleTitle: Numerical prediction of minimum sub-diffraction-limit image resolved by silver surface plasmon lenses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The minimum possible size of sub-diffraction-limit imaging by the surface plasmon polarition (SPP) induced in thin metal lenses has been analyzed with FDTD method, considering plasmon interference, reflection and transmission of evanescent fields.

articleTitle: Ultrafast dynamics of dense quantized magneto-plasmas in high magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Relaxation and emission dynamics of a dense quantized magneto-plasma excited by intense femtosecond laser pulses in In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>As/GaAs multiple quantum wells are probed by time-resolved transient absorption and time-resolved photoluminescence experiments in high magnetic fields.

articleTitle: Observation of EIT-like effect in a single high-Q microcavity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the coupling between a fiber-taper and two whispering-gallery modes simultaneously excited in a single PDMS-coated silica microtoroid theoretically and experimentally. The transmission spectrum of the fiber coupled two-mode resonator shows a sharp electromagnetically-induced-transparency-like window.

articleTitle: Bulky nanowire metamaterials for negative refraction at broadband frequencies from visible to NIR
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first bulk metamaterials at visible frequencies that shows intriguing negative refraction for all incident angles. The metamaterial is realized by growing silver nanowire in a porous alumina template.

articleTitle: Multifarious control of two-photon fluorescence intensities in multi-labeled cell using a single ultrabroadband light source
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that the spectral phase modulation of ultrabroadband laser pulses provides multifarious control of two-photon fluorescence intensities of multiple fluorophores in a HeLa cell.

articleTitle: Room-temperature photoluminescence in Er-doped deuterated amorphous carbon
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report strong room-temperature photoluminescence at ∼1.5µm in erbium-doped deuterated amorphous carbon for the first time. Deuteration, instead of hydrogenation, of amorphous carbon eliminates C-H and O-H bonds, significantly reducing the quenching of erbium emission.

articleTitle: Development of a compressive programmable array microscope
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a compressive programmable array microscope design, which incorporates the compressive sensing principle into the patterned illumination microscope design, so that single pixel detectors can be used to capture microscopic images without mechanical scanning.

articleTitle: How short can an adiabatic mode transformer be in a coupled waveguide system?
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We derive the shortest length of adiabatic mode transformers which keep the power scattered into unwanted modes below a certain level. The theory is well supported by the numerical results from a transfer matrix method.

articleTitle: Novel fabrication and enhanced photosensitivity of selenium filament arrays by optical-fiber thermal drawing
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
