abstract: Optical spectra of InAs quantum dot molecules show clear signatures of 2-photon absorption through sequential and simultaneous transitions. Biexcitons can be spatially direct or indirect, producing 2-photon transitions that are unique to molecules.

articleTitle: Ultrafast and nanoscale optics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The field of optics is finding myriad applications in information technology, health care, lighting, sensing and national security. This paper explores the role of nanotechnology with special focus on nanophotonics in dielectric and inhomogeneous metamaterials with applications for optical information processing in space and time, communications, and sensing.

articleTitle: Imaging fluorescence resonance energy transfer in scattering media using optical diffusion tomography
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experiments and simulations that show the microscopic fluorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET) donor-acceptor distance can be determined using a diffusion model. The approach could lead to deep tissue in-vivo FRET imaging.

articleTitle: Generation of visible 13-fs pulses using Raman-Nath like multiple CARS signals in KTaO3
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate Fourier synthesis of RN-like multiple coherent anti-Stokes Raman-scattering signals in a KTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> single crystal at room temperature. Isolated pulses with 13-fs duration and 520-690-nm wavelength range are generated without any active chirp compensator.

articleTitle: Hydrodynamic explosion of xenon clusters driven by intense XUV light from high harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Explosions of xenon clusters exposed to intense XUV pulses are analyzed by time-of-flight spectroscopy. Ion charge states and kinetic energy spectra indicate hydrodynamic, not Coulombic, plasma expansion, in contrast to intense infrared/cluster interactions.

articleTitle: Probing high-Q photonic crystal resonances with fluorescent molecules
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photonic crystal nanocavities with resonances in the visible and near-IR couple easily to nearby fluorescent molecules. Photoluminescence spectra demonstrate that the cavities, fabricated in a gallium phosphide membrane, have quality factors up to 11,000.

articleTitle: Diffraction enhancement via Bloch Surface Waves in a-SiN:H multilayers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using the excitation of a Bloch Surface Wave (BSW), we demonstrate a 45-fold diffraction enhancement for a protein grating printed on a-SiN:H multilayers. This may lead to a new generation of high sensitivity diffraction-based biosensors.

articleTitle: Beam shapers for high power lasers, fabricated by laser micro-machining
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Beam shaping by arbitrary shaped refractive surfaces is achieved with laser micro-machined and smoothed silica. The technique provides custom circular and rectangular flat-tops beams suitable for high intensity, modern fibre lasers.

articleTitle: Simultaneous measurement of structure and XUV dielectric constant of nanoscale objects using diffraction of high harmonic radiation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: XUV diffraction using radiation generated by high harmonic generation is used simultaneously to determine both the structure and the complex refractive index of a partially ordered array of 196 nm diameter polystyrene spheres.

articleTitle: Photon correlations in systems with strong light-matter coupling
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The appearance of the two-photon strong-coupling states is analyzed in atomic vs. semi-conductor quantum-dot microcavities. An identical excitation mechanism explains phenomena observed in photon-correlation measurements.

articleTitle: Ultra-short pulse compression for mode-locked Ti:sapphire laser by using a tapered fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultra-short pulse compression for tunable mode-locked Ti:sapphire lasers is demonstrated by utilizing a 1-µm-diameter tapered fiber with grating pairs. For 100 fs input pulses at the 880-nm center wavelength, the optical bandwidth is broaden from 14 nm to 45 nm after propagating through the 1-cm long tapered fiber. After passing through the grating pairs with 1.6 cm separation, the final pulse width is compressed down to 33 fs.

articleTitle: Towards a monolithic cavity soliton laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose an original design of a monolithic and integrated vertical cavity laser with saturable absorber and discuss experimental results showing the formation and fast writing/erasure of bistable laser spots.

articleTitle: Roadblocks to high efficiency solid-state lighting: Bridging the “green-yellow gap”
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Lighting applications are presently limited by the lack of efficient LEDs across the visible spectrum. We review materials challenges that underlie the ldquogreen-yellow gaprdquo in LED efficiency and describe emerging approaches for bridging that gap.

articleTitle: Polarization evolution of stimulated Brillouin scattering amplified signals in standard fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The polarization evolution of stimulated Brillouin scattering amplified signals in the presence of fiber birefringence is examined in analysis, simulation and experiment. The signal polarization is drawn towards the conjugate of the pump polarization.

articleTitle: Thin film p-ridge n-stripe III–V laser broad area metal-metal bonded to silicon
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A p-ridge single quantum well thin film laser has been metal/metal bonded onto silicon for good thermal dissipation and low threshold current. The threshold current density is 244 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Tuning of coherent interaction in a resonant photonic crystal using an external electric field
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the tunablity of coherent interaction between exciton-lattice-polaritons and photonic crystal bandedge states in a GaAs/Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.22</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.78</sub>As double-quantum-well based photonic crystal in the presence of a variable external electric field.

articleTitle: Random population of InAs/GaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally observe truly random to non-thermal to thermal distribution of population of InAs quantum dots with temperature using unamplified spontaneous emission and measure the impact on laser operation.

articleTitle: Nanosecond and femtosecond polarization resolved laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (PRLIBS) of aluminum
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report single-shot femtosecond and nanosecond polarization resolved laser-induce breakdown spectroscopy (PRLIBS) measurement results on aluminum. Compared with conventional LIBS, this technique can increase the signal to background ratio (SBR) even with non-gated time-integrated detection. The resolution and detection limit of PRLIBS is highly improved, making this technique especially useful for weak atomic and ionic transitions.

articleTitle: HEL-JTO programs in directed energy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The HEL-JTO was established to coordinate, advocate and communicate the development of HEL technology. The office manages a portfolio of HEL technology programs. The goals and status of these efforts are reported.

articleTitle: Trapping light in a crystal
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a protocol for quantum light storage in solids, taking advantage of the specific properties of rare earth ions doped crystals. As other protocols, light is slowed down, then stopped. Preliminary results are reported.

articleTitle: Stabilization of a two pulse intracavity pumped OPO
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experiments and simulation demonstrate an instability of the intracavity pumped optical parametric oscillator against bidirectional operation. It is shown that nonlinear losses inside the signal cavity can stabilize the bidirectional operation.

articleTitle: Generation of optical Schröinger cat states by number-resolved squeezed photon subtraction
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have generated and measured an approximation of an optical Schrodinger cat state by photon subtraction from a squeezed state. Using single-photon avalanche photodiode detectors and photon-number-resolving transition edge sensors, we were able to extract Wigner distributions for one or two photons subtracted from the squeezed state, resulting in both an odd and even cat state. The one-photon-subtracted Wigner distribution shows measured negative features (without any correction), indicating quantum character. The Wigner distribution of the two-photon-subtracted state is negative after correcting for homodyne losses. A full statistical analysis is under way to quantify the magnitude and fidelity of the cat states generated.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence enhancement by metal nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a simple yet rigorous theory of the enhancement of photoluminescence (PL) efficiency in the vicinity of metal nanoparticles that takes into account the enhancement during optical absorption and emission. Using an example of active InGaN quantum dots (QDs) positioned in close proximity to Ag nanospheres embedded in GaN, we show that strong enhancement can be obtained only for those QDs, atoms, or molecules that are originally inefficient in absorbing as well as in emitting optical energy.

articleTitle: Spatial and temporal magnetometry using cold atoms in dark optical tweezers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use Faraday spectroscopy of atoms confined to crossed hollow beam tweezers to map magnetic fields over several millimeters with 100 micron resolution. The traps permit several hundred measurements in a single loading cycle.

articleTitle: Analysis of two-photon absorption in tapered fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that the rate of two-photon absorption in atomic vapors can be enhanced in tapered optical fibers with diameters less than the wavelength of the incident light.

articleTitle: Dispersion-flattened holey fiber with an ultra-small mode area using a high index slot structure
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A holey fiber design with a high index nanostructure that can achieve an effective mode area not in excess of 0.3 mum<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and a flat dispersion at the 1.55 mum band is proposed and studied.

articleTitle: Photon pair generation via spontaneous four-wave mixing in birefringent optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate photon pair production in standard single-mode optical fibers via spontaneous four-wave mixing. The process utilizes birefringent phase matching to control the photon pair joint spectral structure.

articleTitle: Observation of strong second harmonic generation from a single wurtzite GaAs nanoneedle
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate second harmonic generation from a single GaAs nanoneedle with a wurtzite crystal structure. The optical anisotropy of the polar crystal results in strong nonlinear optical conversion compared to normal zincblende GaAs.

articleTitle: Semiconductor lasers with integrated plasmonic polarizers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report control of semiconductor laser polarization by patterning plasmonic structures on the laser facet. Linearly-polarized laser emission along an arbitrary polarization direction and a combination of linearly- and circularly-polarized laser emission are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope phase dynamics of octave-spanning titanium:sapphire lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The carrier-envelope phase dynamics of octave-spanning Ti:sapphire lasers are analyzed based on a one-dimensional laser. It is found that self-steepening is the major contributor to the energy dependent carrier-envelope phase and that center-frequency-shifts are negligible.

articleTitle: 31% DC to RF differential efficiency using monolithic quantum dot passively mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 31% DC to RF differential efficiency of the mode-locked laser's output electrical signal is reported for the first time. The external quantum efficiency of the saturable absorber and the operating regime are also analyzed.

articleTitle: Ultra-violet guiding in high-order transmission window of hollow-core optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A hollow-core fiber exhibiting three transmission windows from the NIR to the UV was designed and characterized. A good agreement between computed and measured loss was obtained. 2 dB/m loss was demonstrated at 0.355 mum-wavelength.

articleTitle: Cryogenic properties of optomechanical silica microcavities
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We expose cryogenic (1.6 K) optomechanical properties of high-Q toroidal silica microcavities. A thermally induced optical multistability and the influence of structural defects of amorphous materials on phonon propagation are described.

articleTitle: 4OD-mediated solitonic radiations in HC-PCF cladding
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe for the first time the simultaneous emission of two resonant radiation frequencies by optical solitons in a small waveguiding glass-feature within the cladding of a HC-PCF. We attributes this phenomenon to the unusually large 4th-order GVD coefficient of the waveguide.

articleTitle: Picosecond Ultrasonic measurements using an optical cavity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have implemented a new means of measuring very high frequency ultrasound in nanostructured materials (known as Picosecond Ultrasonics) by using a high-Q optical resonator that enables significant enhancement and detailed characterization of ultrasound signals.

articleTitle: Measurement of photodiode harmonic distortion using optical comb sources and high-resolution optical filtering
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical combs and high-resolution optical filtering are utilized for high-fidelity measurements of photodiode harmonic distortion. This new technique uses a single laser and phase modulation-alleviating requirements on laser frequency stabilization and modulator bias control.

articleTitle: A near-IR transmitting “black glass” synthesized from 70%TeO2-25%ZnO-5%ZnS
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new type of tellurite glass has been synthesized with composition 70%TeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-25%ZnO-5%ZnS. The glass is of black color, indicating a high absorption in the visible range. However, transmittance measurements show the same glass to be transmitting in the near-IR range, between 2 mum and 6 mum. XPS data reveal the existence of Zn-O-S and a reduction of tellurium oxide with formation of Te-Te bonds in the glass. Our preliminary experiments indicate an increased third-order susceptibility chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> at 1.5 mum.

articleTitle: A single-photon source based on diamond nanowires
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated single photon emission from diamond nanowires waveguides with embedded nitrogen-vacancy color centers. Diamond nanostructures were fabricated with e-beam lithography and inductively coupled plasma reactive ion etching (ICP RIE) processes.

articleTitle: Passive modification of free carrier lifetime in high-Q silicon-on-insulator optics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A simple chemical method for reducing free-carrier lifetime in silicon photonics while maintaining low optical loss is presented. Lifetimes of ~ 300 ps for optical losses of ~ 0.4 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> are achieved. Ramifications for nonlinear optics are discussed.

articleTitle: A 10 GHz optoelectronic oscillator continuously tunable by an intra cavity SOA based slow light element
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe the use of a semiconductor optical amplifier as an intra cavity, continuous phase tuning element in an optoelectronic oscillator. A tuning range larger than 3 MHz is demonstrated in a 10 GHz oscillator.

articleTitle: Picosecond pulse generation in narrow stripe mode-locked quantum dot master oscillator power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper reports a monolithically integrated mode-locked narrow stripe QD MOPA operating at 1300 nm generating a stable 20 GHz pulse train with an average power of 46.4 mW and a pulse duration of 8.3 ps.

articleTitle: Lossless negative dielectric constant optical material from a semiconductor quantum dot mixture
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that with sufficient gain, a mixture of two semiconductor quantum dots can produce an isotropic effective dielectric constant that is lossless and negative. This permits small-scale optical mode volume and lossless waveguides.

articleTitle: Type-II quasi-phase-matched second-harmonic generation in domain-disordered semiconductor waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Second-harmonic generation is demonstrated in periodically intermixed GaAs/AlGaAs superlattice waveguides by Type-II phase matching. Second-harmonic powers of 2.0 muW were generated at fundamental phase matching wavelength of 1577.4 nm.

articleTitle: Exact theory of interaction between whispering gallery modes in microspheres and a dipole scatterer
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Interaction of whispering gallery modes in a microsphere with a dipole scatterer is described exactly. The theory disproves the traditional understanding of this phenomenon and explains a real origin of doublets in spectra of microspheres.

articleTitle: Ultrafast-laser inscription of active devices in glass
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond laser-written active waveguide devices, namely waveguide amplifiers and DFB waveguide lasers were fabricated in doped phosphate glasses. Gain was achieved across the complete C-band and a laser with output power of 102 mW was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Depolarized guided acoustic wave Brillouin scattering in photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Guided acoustic wave Brillouin scattering (GAWBS) in PCFs is altered by the air-silica structure of the inner cladding and does not depend on the cladding diameter as with standard fibers. This dependence is investigated.

articleTitle: Coherence properties of optical frequency comb generated in large pitch HC-PCF filled with H2
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the coherence measurement of the ultra-broad optical frequency comb generated in a hydrogen-filled square-lattice HC-PCF. The visibilities of higher order Stokes and anti-Stokes lines are quantified indicating a high degree of coherence.

articleTitle: Advances in on-chip polymer optics for optofluidics
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present liquid-turned-solid lenses (Deltan~1.2) in polymer devices replicated from cryogenically-etched silicon molds, with estimated per surface losses of .2-.4 dB. The process creates optical-quality sidewalls (sigma<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">RMS</sub> ~ 30 nm) needed for sensitive optofluidic devices.

articleTitle: 200 fs, 50 W fiber-CPA system based on chirped-volume-Bragg-gratings
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Record-short pulses of 200fs have been obtained from a power-scalable-Yb-fiber-CPA system that uses chirped-volume-Bragg-gratings for the stretcher and compressor. The power was scaled up to 50W with a corresponding 33W of compressed power.

articleTitle: Frequency-tunable external cavity terahertz quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable terahertz quantum cascade laser using an abutted silicon lens and grating feedback. The device tunes discontinuously over 160 GHz with a center frequency of 4.4 THz.

articleTitle: Band-gap tuning with mechanical heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two surface quantum wells in a collapsed heterostructure couple across an air gap of variable width. Experiments demonstrate a tuning range of 22 nm with the potential for up to 225 nm.

articleTitle: Light emission from silicon nanostructures: Past, present and future perspectives
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this tutorial, I will review the main approaches developed so far to engineer efficient light emission from silicon-based materials. I will discuss the physics of radiative recombination in silicon nanostructures embedded in different dielectric matrices and I will picture the state of the art for on-chip optical amplifiers and silicon laser devices. In addition, I will introduce novel device concepts based on a-periodic photonic/plasmonic structures for the control and manipulation of localized light states on silicon-based chips.

articleTitle: Measurement of two-photon excitation spectrum of various fluorophores with Fourier transform nonlinear spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show a technique to measure the two-photon excitation spectrum of various fluorophores, based on Fourier transform nonlinear spectroscopy with the use of ultrabroadband laser (670-1100 nm).

articleTitle: High power, tunable thulium fiber laser system for atmospheric propagation experiments
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A system for multi-kilometer atmospheric propagation experiments including a master oscillator with ∼108 nm tunability and a power amplifier tested as an oscillator with ∼58% slope efficiency and stable 200 W output power is discussed.

articleTitle: Pulse shaper assisted characterization of single-cycle optical pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Shaper-assisted autocorrelation is developed to characterize single-cycle pulses. The correlation signal show significantly improved signal-to-noise ratio and thus accuracy in pulse characterization when compared to cross-correlation obtained by splitting the spectral components of the pulse.

articleTitle: Compact, wavelength-selective resonant photodetector based on III–V/silicon-on-insulator heterogeneous integration
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce a compact, resonant photodetector based on III-V/silicon-on-insulator heterogeneous integration. Wavelength-selective detection is demonstrated. >10 dB extinction ratio is obtained. The responsivity of the detector is ~1.0 A/W at the resonance wavelengths.

articleTitle: Room temperature lasing from subwavelength metal-insulator-semiconductor structures
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report pulsed room temperature lasing from optically pumped subwavelength metal-insulator-semiconductor structures. The lasers consist of InGaAsP gain disks embedded in a SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/aluminum bi-layer. Lasing at 1520 nm from a 730 nm gain core is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Modified PN codes for laser remote sensing measurements
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a modified pseudo noise code for laser remote sensing measurements. Our experiments show it improves receiver signal to noise ratio and time resolution and is well suited for lasers with limited peak power.

articleTitle: Photon-counting, 3D imaging lidars operating at megapixels per second
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a scanning, photon-counting, 3D imaging lidar which generates contiguous, high resolution, 3D maps at rates up to 2.2 megapixels per second and is readily scalable to high altitude aircraft or spacecraft.

articleTitle: Temperature response of photonic bandgap fibers based on high-index inclusions
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed spectral shifts for short heated lengths of photonic bandgap fibers based on high-index rods. Shifts are observed in even shorter lengths if the fiber is bent. Application as alternative distributed sensors is envisaged.

articleTitle: Plasmon-enhanced single photon emission from a nano-assembled metal-diamond hybrid structure
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the controlled assembly of diamond nanocrystals and gold nanoparticles, thus enhancing the emission properties of single nitrogen-vacancy color centers and realizing an efficient and stable single photon source at room-temperature.

articleTitle: Sub-kHz RF electrical linewidth from a 10GHz passively mode-locked quantum-dot laser diode
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A packaged 10 GHz monolithic two-section quantum-dot mode-locked laser is presented, with record narrow 500 Hz RF electrical linewidth for passive mode-locking. Single sideband noise spectra show 147 fs integrated timing jitter over the 4 MHz-80 MHz frequency range.

articleTitle: Detection of structural defects of extremely low concentrations in commercial synthetic silica glass
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Concentrations of intrinsic structural defects in synthetic silica glass, AQT, were measured by highly sensitive ESR and photoluminescence measurements. It was revealed that the defects, influential for 193 nm absorption, were less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup> pcs/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Optical frequency comb generated by four-wave mixing in highly nonlinear fibers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Efficient generation of a cascade of four-wave mixing products using a low-dispersion highly nonlinear fiber is demonstrated. The measured optical frequency comb (with a spacing of 100 GHz) spans over more than 350 nm.

articleTitle: Ytterbium-doped mode-locked fiber laser at hundreds of kHz repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A long ring-cavity, low repetition rate Yb-doped fiber laser was demonstrated. Pulses with repetition rate of about 381.3 kHz and single pulse energy above 300 nJ were obtained.

articleTitle: A Ge-on-Si laser for electronic-photonic integration
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate room temperature photoluminescence and optical gain from the direct band gap transition of tensile strained n-type Ge-on-Si around 1600 nm, which can be applied to a Si-based laser for optical interconnects and communications.

articleTitle: Fine (≪0.5 ps) and course tuning (≫15 ps) of optical delays using acousto-optic mixing with a 1-pm tunable laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a new technique for fine tuning of optical delays using cascaded acousto-optic modulators. A 256-ns delay with <0.5-ps resolution is shown for 40-Gb/s RZ-OOK with no system penalty.

articleTitle: Activation of a 1.1 Petawatt hybrid, OPCPA-Nd:glass laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the activation of the 1.1 Petawatt Laser (190 J, 170 fs) based on optical parametric chirped pulse amplification (OPCPA) and mixed Nd:glass amplification.

articleTitle: Enhancing wavelength selection for Quantum Cascade laser based chemical sensors by cavity length variation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Varying quantum cascade laser cavity length results in gain peak selection across a 118 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> range; a result of a change in threshold voltage, and applied electric field as a function of cavity length.

articleTitle: Compensation of thermal effect in high-Q toroidal microresonators by PDMS coating
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally demonstrate that thermal effect in ultra-high-Q silica toroidal microresonators can be compensated by applying a layer of polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS). The observed Q factor is 1.5times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> for coating thickness of 0.52 mum.

articleTitle: Interrogation of birefringent fiber sensors using fiber gyroscope technology
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel fiber interferometer, adapted from a Sagnac-type interferometer with non-reciprocal phase modulation, is used to measure the differential optical phase shift in birefringent fiber sensors. The interferometer is applied to voltage sensing.

articleTitle: Electro-optic integration of liquid crystal cladding switch with multimode passive polymer waveguides on PCB
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical switching functionality is demonstrated in PCB integrated multimode passive polymer waveguides using a localised liquid-crystal cladding structure. Waveguide switching contrast of 15 dB is achieved with only 0.5 dB of on-state excess loss.

articleTitle: Sub nanosecond electroholographic switching
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electroholographic switching with rise-time of less than a nanosecond is henceforth demonstrated. The switching was done in theg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">44</sub> configurationin which the Bragg condition is fulfilled for a single value of the electric field.

articleTitle: Novel 2D high-contrast grating hollow-core waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Hollow-core waveguides based on high contrast gratings are analyzed using exact analytical formulation. We obtain dispersion diagrams and propose a planar geometry similar to a heterostructure to confine the light two dimensionally in these waveguides.

articleTitle: Current status and most recent developments of industrial high power disk lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This report described a 1.5 kW source with a beam parameter product of 2 mm*mrad and a >10 kW system out of two disks with a BPP of 8 mm*mrad among other disk laser developments.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of active devices for enhanced luminescence from silicon nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate enhanced photoluminescence from silicon nanocrystals using a DBR microcavity. We also show a candidate electroluminescent device which can be embedded into a similar DBR cavity for enhancement.

articleTitle: Terahertz generation using a two-frequency highly-doped ceramic Nd:YAG microchip laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Stable, continuously tunable, beat-frequency generation of microwave frequencies up to 150 GHz, with narrow linewidth, is demonstrated from a dual-frequency ceramic Nd:YAG microchip laser, using optical and radio-frequency spectra.

articleTitle: Room temperature InGaAs-AlAsSb quantum cascade lasers operating in 3 - 4 µm range
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first room temperature strain compensated InGaAs/AlAs(Sb)/InP quantum cascade lasers operating down to 3.15 mum. The lasers with selective incorporation of AlAs barriers in the active regions emit hundreds of milliwatts peak optical power.

articleTitle: Realization of high-speed distributed sensing based on Brillouin optical correlation domain analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel method is proposed to demodulate the output of Brillouin optical correlation domain analysis by using an analog signal processing unit free from the update rate limitation of the conventional method. The distributed Brillouin interaction per pump-probe frequency offset is continuously recorded during linearly sweeping the sensing positions. In experiment, we realize ~20-Hz distributed sensing over the entire 50-m fiber with 5-cm spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Opto-mechanical oscillations in a double-disk microcavity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate giant opto-mechanical oscillations in a silica double-disk where the optical gradient force creates dramatic dynamic back action in comparison to radiation pressure.

articleTitle: Optical cavity cooling of a large ensemble of molecules
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study optical cooling of a large ensemble of particles. We derive a new scaling law with respect to particle number and show a high density molecular cloud are cooled from 10mK to 700µK.

articleTitle: Wide-bandwidth, high-resolution ADC scalable to continuous-time operation
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A photonic front-end is used with a commercial digital oscilloscope to create a 2-channel, 7-effective bit, 10-GHz input bandwidth ADC that can be scaled to continuous-time operation by adding commercial components for 10 more channels.

articleTitle: Comparison of birefringent metamaterials and meanderline structure as quarter-wave plates at terahertz frequencies
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We compare a single layer metamaterial quarter-wave plate with a meanderline polarizer. They achieve 99.9% and 99.6% circular polarization at 639 GHz, respectively. These results highlight the large degree of birefringence exhibited by metamaterial structures.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical imaging with Sub-12fs pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Transform limited ultrashort pulses are used in a laser-scanning two-photon microscope for imaging of various biological specimens, demonstrating the importance of dispersion-free imaging system. Pulse characterization, qualitative and quantitative data are presented.

articleTitle: Wireless/photonics interfaces based on resonant tunneling diode optoelectronic oscillators
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We employ phase synchronization for converting low power wireless signals to the optical domain and optical injection locking for converting optical sub-carrier signals to the electric domain by using resonant tunneling diode oscillator circuits.

articleTitle: Glass hybrid OPCPA scale test bed laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Glass Hybrid OPCPA Scale Test bed (GHOST) Laser combines OPCPA with two types of Glass amplifiers to reduce gain narrowing and allow compression of a glass amplified pulse to almost 100 fs.

articleTitle: Undistorted terahertz pulses propagation in slightly curved parallel plate waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is proposed and investigated the 8-cm-long slightly curved parallel plate oversized waveguide as wideband THz interconnecting line. Its use in waveguide TDS is demonstrated by measuring absorbance of tiny amount of water vapor.

articleTitle: Demonstration of cloaking at optical frequencies
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a wideband invisibility cloak in the optical regime composed of nanometer scale non-resonant dielectric structures. The cloak conceals a deformation on a reflecting surface, under which an object can be hidden.

articleTitle: Ultrabroad frequency comb spanning 0.4∼4.2 µm from a Ti:sapphire laser by difference frequency technique
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An ultrabroadband frequency comb covered from 400 nm to 4.2 mum was demonstrated by shaping femtosecond Ti:sapphire laser to enhance the DFG in PPLN crystal, as our best knowledge it is the broadest comb with monolithic scheme.

articleTitle: In vivo micron scale arthroscopic imaging of human knee osteoarthritis with OCT: Comparison with MRI and arthroscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this study, we perform in vivo OCT human arthroscopic imaging in patients undergoing menisectomy. Results are compared to MRI and arthroscopy.

articleTitle: All-optical clock recovery using temporal Talbot effect followed by SOA-based fiber ring laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 10-Gbit/s all-optical clock recovery using the temporal Talbot effect in single-mode fibers with subsequent optical pulse injection into an SOA-based fiber ring laser. The clear clock is recovered from 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">31</sup>-1 PRBS optical pulses.

articleTitle: Highly alignment tolerant 10 Gb/s links using very large core plastic optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate error-free 10 Gb/s transmission over the largest core size fiber ever reported. A transverse tolerance of plusmn30 mum is demonstrated for both the VCSEL source and PIN diode receiver.

articleTitle: Coherent pulse synthesis between a femtosecond optical parametric oscillator and its pump laser: Towards isolated attosecond optical pulses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate coherent synthesis between pulses from an optical parametric oscillator and its Ti:sapphire pump laser with a mutual timing-jitter of 30 attoseconds in 20 milliseconds, sufficient for attosecond waveform synthesis.

articleTitle: 1-µm waveband, 12.5-Gbps transmission with a wavelength tunable single-mode selected quantum-dot optical frequency comb laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 1-mum waveband, 12.5-Gbps transmission over a 1.5-km single-mode holey-fiber is demonstrated with clear eye-openings. A wavelength tunable single-mode selected quantum-dot optical frequency-comb laser is used as the optical-source potentially capable of wavelength division multiplexing (WDM).

articleTitle: Self-similar and stretched-pulse operation of erbium-doped fiber lasers with carbon nanotubes saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report self-similar and stretched -pulse operations in an all-fiber erbium-doped laser using carbon nanotube saturable absorber, for the first time. Pulses as short as 115 fs are achieved in the stretched-pulse regime.

articleTitle: OSNR requirements for optical multicarrier generator for short range radio-over-fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an optimized and compact optical multicarrier generator for radio-over-fiber (ROF) systems. We verify that the generator meets the OSNR and optical carrier power requirements for good quality OFDM signals.

articleTitle: Red and UV generation using frequency-converted GaInNAs-based semiconductor disk laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the intracavity frequency-doubling of a GaInNAs/GaAs disk laser. The laser operated at 1220 nm and delivered 4.6 W of power at ~610 nm. The red emission was further frequency-doubled to 305 nm.

articleTitle: CMOS-compatible multiple wavelength source
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate parametric oscillation in a complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) compatible silicon nitride ring resonator. We generate up to 40 wavelengths with a threshold power as low as 50 mW.

articleTitle: Optimized pulse shaping for mitigating optical nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new pulse shape for optical nonlinearity mitigation is proposed. Realistic simulations show that a 2.3 dB increase in launch power can be obtained, at no extra cost.

articleTitle: 2.3 kW cryogenically cooled Yb:YAG laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present our 2.3-kW Yb:YAG master oscillator power amplifier (MOPA) which has shown optical wall-plug efficiencies above 30-% with excellent beam quality. In addition, we will present our all-cryogenic Yb:YAG laser.

articleTitle: Imaging through thick random media with a speckle intensity correlation over excitation position
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that imaging through thick random media can be facilitated by intensity correlations with respect to input beam location. Example results suggest that the approach could lead to new imaging opportunities.

articleTitle: Linear and nonlinear optical response of aligned gold nanorods
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The optical properties of gold nanorods suspended in toluene are studied as a function of orientation by aligning them with a low frequency electric field. The nonlinear optical response is consistent with a 2-level saturation model.

articleTitle: Assessment of dual ammonia and ozone open-path sensing with a quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a theoretical assessment of two open-path quantum cascade laser (QCL) approaches (mono/bi-static and backscatter) to measure ambient ozone and ammonia concentrations to within 1-10% accuracy at distances up to 10 km.

articleTitle: 100W, fiberised, linearly-polarized, picosecond ytterbium doped fiber MOPA
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a PM, fully-fiberised, picosecond fiber MOPA delivering 20 ps pulses at repetition rates up to 970 MHz and at average powers of up to 100 W.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic waveguides and devices
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Several silicon photonic waveguide geometries for both near- and mid-infrared wavelength regions are presented. These waveguides are basic building blocks of more complex photonic circuits such as modulators, detectors, filters, couplers or light sources. In this paper, the application of waveguide structures in both passive and active devices is given.

articleTitle: Single and dual-mode injection locked quantum-dot mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum-dot mode-locked lasers are injection locked by single and two-tone master sources. Narrow linewidth, improved time-bandwidth product and wavelength control are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Room temperature power scalability of the diode-pumped Er:YAG eye-safe laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Laser performance of the Er:YAG resonantly end-pumped by a high-brightness InGaAsP/InP 10-bar stack is reported. Achieved 80 W power is believed to be the highest CW power ever reported from diode-pumped room-temperature Er:YAG laser.

articleTitle: Coherent state preparation and observation of Rabi oscillations in a single molecule
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the observation of up to 5 Rabi cycles in a single molecule. A pi-pulse excitation is achieved with 500 photons, marking an important step towards preparation of coherent superposition states with few photons.

articleTitle: Characterizing the modes of a core-pumped, large-mode area Er fiber using spatially and spectrally resolved imaging
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Higher-order-modes of a 70-mum core-diameter, Er-doped-fiber are characterized over a broad wavelength range using a supercontinuum with spatially and spectrally resolved imaging. Pumping the Er-doped-fiber with 1480-nm in the fundamental mode decreases the higher-order-mode content.

articleTitle: Temporal imaging system with simple external clock synchronization
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a temporal imaging system that allows simple synchronization to an external clock by using a spectrally broadened time-lens-based pump laser. We integrate this pump laser into an ultrafast oscilloscope scheme and demonstrate 2 ps resolution with 130 ps record length.

articleTitle: Single-drive electro-optic modulator for duo-binary modulation utilizing non-periodically polarization-reversed structure
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new electro-optic duo-binary modulator is proposed. Utilizing non-periodic polarization reversal structures, a pair of Gaussian-like modulation frequency responses with an opposite sign is obtainable. It operates with a single duo-binary signal without electrical/optical filters.

articleTitle: Role of interface roughness in the transport and lasing characteristics of quantum-cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A density-matrix based theory of transport and lasing in quantum-cascade lasers reveals that large disparity between lasing linewidth and tunneling broadening changes the design guidelines to favor strong coupling between injector and upper laser level.

articleTitle: High efficiency single photon source: The photonic wire geometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a single-photon-source design based on the emission of a quantum dot embedded in a semiconductor (GaAs) nanowire. The nanowire ends are engineered (efficient metallic mirror and tip taper) to reach a predicted record-high collection efficiency of 90% with a realistic design. Preliminary experimental results already show a measured efficiency of 44%.

articleTitle: Optical auto-correlation peak discriminator for optical CDMA signal detection
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a compact optical auto-correlation peak discriminator based on four-wave mixing in a highly-nonlinear bismuth-oxide fiber. The discriminator rejects cross-correlation peaks, thus improves the detection of optical CDMA signal and removes the error-floor.

articleTitle: Two distinct types of dark-line defects in a failed InGaAs/AlGaAs strained quantum well laser diode
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: TEM characterization of accelerated life-test failed InGaAs/AlGaAs quantum well 980nm laser diodes, prepared by FIB sampling following EBIC, found two distinct types of dark-line defects providing insight for physics of failure models.

articleTitle: Optimizing injection into large-mode-area photonic crystal-fiber amplifiers by spatially resolved spectral interferometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spatially resolved spectral interferometry is used to measure the mode content of a Yb-doped photonic crystal-fiber amplifier having a 2300-mum<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> mode area. The impact of misalignment at signal injection on the relative mode powers is quantified.

articleTitle: MEMS based speckle reduction obtain by angle diversity for fast imaging
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a cheap, compact and generic approach for suppressing speckle effect, allowing laser illumination for fast imaging. The speckle reduction is obtained by angular diversity using MEMS.

articleTitle: Long-wavelength VCSEL arrays with partly coherent emission
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a monolithically integrated, InP-based 2D long-wavelength VCSEL array with coupling near fields. These lasers, utilizing a buried tunnel junction for current confinement, show partly coherent emission at 1.55 mum wavelength.

articleTitle: Towards athermal slotted silicon microring resonators with UV-trimmable PMMA upper-cladding
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that PMMA upper cladding on the slotted silicon micoring resonators can reduce the resonance thermal dependence from 91 pm/° to 27 pm/°C. UV trimming can shift the resonance wavelength 0.5 nm.

articleTitle: High-power, few-cycle, phase-stabilized 2.2-µm optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a high-peak-power, 1-kHz, 2.2-µm OPCPA for long-wavelength-driven high harmonic generation that produces 9-GW, 3-optical-cycle, CEP-stabilized pulses, allowing tunneling-ionization-threshold intensity with low Guoy phase shift.

articleTitle: Conformal P-N junctions for low energy electro-optic switching
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that a conformal pn junction can reduce the switching energy of resonant devices to below 100 aJ.

articleTitle: Nanometer-scale machining by laser ablation with a focused extreme ultraviolet laser beam
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the ablation of 200 nm-top wide (130 nm FWHM) trenches on PMMA photoresist by focusing the extreme ultraviolet output from a table-top capillary discharge laser with a Fresnel zone plate lens.

articleTitle: Pilot decision-aided maximum likelihood phase estimation in coherent optical QPSK and 8PSK systems with nonlinear phase noise
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose pilot decision-aided maximum likelihood phase estimation for nonlinear-phase-noise-dominant coherent optical phase-shift-keying (PSK) systems. The receiver sensitivity is shown to be improved by ~1 dB compared to the differentially encoded PSK counterparts.

articleTitle: Laser Altimeter measurements from MESSENGER's recent Mercury flybys
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The performance of the Mercury Laser Altimeter is reported from MESSENGER's flybys of Mercury in January and October 2008. The instrument ranged to 600 km at ≫60° incidence angle and 1600 km in nadir direction.

articleTitle: Dual-frequency switching Liquid Crystal based tunable THz Filter
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The controllable permittivity of liquid crystals is utilized to realize a tunable THz filter. By employing dual-frequency switching liquid crystals, we achieve pure electrical steering of filter. This facilitates both, measurement setup and filter implementation.

articleTitle: Solid-state conical refraction laser
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present ultra-efficient conical refraction Nd:KGW laser providing multi-watt output with excellent beam quality independent of resonator design and slope efficiency close to the theoretical maximum, offering the ultimate route for brightness-scaling in solid-state lasers.

articleTitle: When and how coupled-mode theory fails in high-index contrast arrayed and multi-slot waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a method of reconstruction for investigating the validity of coupled mode theory in deriving the coupling coefficients of high index contrast (silicon-on-insulator) arrayed waveguides. For three material systems (silicon and air, oxide, and nitride) we quantify at which separation distances the next-to-nearest-neighbor coupling becomes significant, and the precise way in which coupled-mode theory breaks down, by reconstructing a coupling matrix from the fields and propagation constants.

articleTitle: Stability of an acetylene frequency reference inside kagome structured hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A continuous-wave laser has been stabilized to an acetylene transition inside kagome photonic crystal fiber. Stability as measured with a carbon nanotube fiber laser frequency comb is better than 1times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> at 10 s.

articleTitle: Tunable pulse compression technique using optical pulse synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate tunable pulse compression technique using an optical pulse synthesizer. The technique showed tunability of compressed pulse widths and shapes by line-by-line manipulation of initial pulses.

articleTitle: Temperature distribution during heat accumulation in femtosecond laser processing inside glasses
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The temperature distribution after 250 kHz fs laser irradiation inside a glass as well as the characteristic temperature for determining the boundary of the heat modification were determined by analyzing the heat modification.

articleTitle: Silicon single-photon detector with 5 Hz dark counts
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report operation of a passively quenched silicon single-photon avalanche photodiode (SPAD) at extremely low dark count rate of 5 Hz. This was achieved by lowering the temperature of a PerkinElmer C30921S SPAD down to -77degC. We found that the quantum efficiency at 780 nm remained constant over a wide range of cooling temperatures from -32degC down to -77degC. The after-pulsing characteristics, however, depended on the cooling temperature.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of a strong fiber Bragg grating's complex coupling coefficient in erbium doped fiber with optical space domain reflectometry
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An improved implementation of optical space domain reflectometry is presented using an interferometric characterization method and deconvolution technique. Reconstruction of a strong Bragg grating written in erbium fiber, with a qL ∼ 8:6 is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Cascaded third-harmonic generation in a single two-dimensional nonlinear photonic crystal with a short-range order
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Short-range ordered nonlinear photonic crystals (SRO-NPC) are new, promising class of materials for optical frequency conversion. We describe a method for designing such SRO-NPC for efficient collinear third-harmonic generation (THG) at arbitrary wavelength. The method was used to prepare a LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> sample in which THG at 526.7 nm with 12% efficiency was achieved.

articleTitle: Thermal dissipation dynamics in an optically pumped Photonic Crystal nano-cavity
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The heat dissipation time in an InP-based photonic crystal nano-cavity was measured. Our method is based on time-resolved reflectivity of a cw beam coupled through a tapered fiber. Dissipation times around 2 mus were obtained.

articleTitle: InP based terahertz quantum cascade lasers with 4 quantum well active region design
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a terahertz quantum cascade laser based on InGaAs/InAlAs/InP material system with double metal waveguide that reaches operating temperature of 123 K with continuous wave power output 4.5 mW at 10 K and slope efficiency comparable to GaAs/AlGaAs counterparts.

articleTitle: Confocal thermoreflectance for spatially resolved surface thermography of transparent LEDs
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the use of confocal thermoreflectance for accurate surface temperature measurement of transparent LEDs. Confocal thermoreflectance effectively suppresses light from beneath the LED surface, compared to widefield measurements, for a red GaP LED.

articleTitle: Planar integration of a long range surface plasmon waveguide with an inverted metal-semiconductor-metal photodetector on silicon
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A long range surface plasmon polariton (LR-SPP) insulator-metal-insulator waveguide was integrated with a thin film In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>As-based photodetector (PD) on silicon for planar detection of LR-SPPs, and demonstrated coupling from the LR-SPP to the PD.

articleTitle: Study of a narrowband optical parametric oscillator at degeneracy with a transversely chirped Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2009 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2009 Conference on Quantum electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the energy and spectral properties of a narrowband (0.9 nm) optical parametric oscillator, tunable around the degeneracy point from 1055 to 1066 nm, by usage of a transversely chirped volume Bragg grating.
